0c6df82e.title: Solution Architect (Upto 25 LPA)
0c6df82e.description:
**Solution Architect**
**Location:** 
 Hybrid (Surat, Gujarat)
   

  

**Salary Range:** 
 ₹20,00,000 \- ₹25,00,000 per annum
   

  

**Experience:** 
 6\+ Years
   

  

**Job Overview**
 We are seeking a skilled and experienced
 **Solution Architect** 
 to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will design end\-to\-end scalable technology solutions, align technical strategies with business objectives, and guide engineering teams in implementing robust system architectures. This position requires a strong combination of technical expertise, solution design capabilities, and stakeholder collaboration skills to drive successful project execution across enterprise and product\-based environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architecture Design: Define and design scalable, secure, and high\-performing system architectures that meet business requirements.
* Technical Strategy Alignment: Collaborate with stakeholders to align technical strategies with business objectives and ensure successful project execution.
* Team Guidance: Lead and guide engineering teams in the implementation of architectural standards and best practices.
* Technology Evaluation: Evaluate and recommend technology stacks that are future\-ready and aligned with industry trends.
* Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive architecture documentation and standards.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment and understanding of architectural decisions.


**Required Skills \& ExperienceCore Technical Skills**
* Experience: 8\+ years of software engineering experience with at least 2\+ years in an Architecture role.
* Architecture Expertise: Strong experience in Solution Architecture, System Design, and Enterprise Architecture.
* System Understanding: Strong understanding of system architecture, solution design, and enterprise application integration.
* Cloud Platforms: Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure cloud architecture.
* Caching Technologies: Experience with caching technologies such as Redis.
* Queue Systems: Experience with queue systems such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, or Service Bus.
* Microservices Knowledge: Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, REST APIs, and distributed systems.
* Database Familiarity: Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and modern backend/application frameworks.
* Optimization Principles: Understanding scalability, security, reliability, and performance optimization principles.


 Functional Strengths
   

  

* Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze business problems and design practical, scalable technical solutions.
* Problem\-Solving: Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities.
* Security Knowledge: Strong understanding of security architecture, authentication, authorization, and OWASP best practices.
* Agile Experience: Experience working in Agile and cross\-functional development environments.
* Project Management: Ability to manage multiple projects and architecture initiatives simultaneously.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certifications such as TOGAF, AWS, Azure, or Solution Architecture.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.


 What We Offer
   

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunity to work in a hybrid environment.
* A collaborative and innovative work culture.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.


 If you are passionate about technology and have a proven track record in solution architecture, we encourage you to apply and join our team in shaping the future of technology solutions.
   

  

 Skills: redis,aws,solution architecture,azure,owasp,rest apis,rabbitmq

1d02b86c.title: Solution Architect II
1d02b86c.description:
**About Zuora**
 At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage\-based pricing to AI\-driven and outcome\-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.
   

  

 We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI\-ready foundation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The solution architect is a key member of the professional services team responsible for the design and architecture of Zuora solutions. The position requires strong consulting skills with the ability to effectively command a room. The solution architect plays a lead role during the implementation, identifying and documenting client business requirements, mapping and configuring the Zuora solution to meet the client’s requirements and providing guidance to the client to achieve a successful implementation. They must identify potential issues and risks early in an implementation to develop mitigation strategies and contingency plans. A solid candidate will have an innate ability to simplify complex technology concepts and to plan, prioritize and seamlessly integrate all moving parts to deploy successful solutions.
   

  

 This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely while occasionally getting together with your team for office visits, events, or offsites. Of course, you’re welcome to come into the office more often if you’re nearby.
   

  

**What You’ll Achieve**
* Solution design using the full Zuora product portfolio
* Design and validate that the proposed solution architecture supports the stated and implied business requirements
* Review technical team deliverables for compliance with architecture standards, guidelines and leverages best practices
* Articulate and present different point of views on various technologies
* Present Architecture deliverables such as Ecosystem and Integration diagrams, ERD, Business Process Flows, Swim lanes, Visio and Mock\-ups
* Exhibit strong executive presence and ability to interact and effectively communicate with key project sponsors from CXO to end users.
* Deliver Expert Services to the Zuora Partners


**About You**
* Must have enterprise level experience, within a professional services organisation, as a Solution Architect and/or Business Consultant with a leading technology consulting or product company, delivering moderate to complex ERP, billing, revenue, procurement and/or CRM solutions.
* Demonstrated leadership abilities to lead business discussions with customers and architect the value of our solution and the best practices to implement it
* Experience in requirements gathering, use cases documentation, business analysis, systems design and integration, user interface design and implementation
* Experience in data analysis, conversion and migration, interfaces and reports
* Experience with system design using configuration and/or customization, integration, testing and support
* Experience in delivering end to end solutions through the entire SDLC \- right from running the client facing workshops, design, build, test, deployment, UAT and handover
* Experience in Waterfall and Agile methodologies
* Must be a strong team player with excellent communication skills at the business and technical level, able to collaborate as part of a diverse and distributed team to deliver exceptional customer results in a rapid paced implementation environment
* Experience with accounting and be able to converse effectively with Finance teams
* Experience managing tasks on multiple projects simultaneously


**Benefits**
 Zuora offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support ZEOs’ wellbeing, growth, and flexibility. While specific offerings may vary by country, we typically provide:
   

  

* Competitive compensation, variable bonus and performance\-based reward opportunities, and retirement programs
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Generous, flexible time off, plus paid holidays, wellness days, and a company\-wide year\-end break
* Paid parental leave (including fully paid leave for eligible ZEOs, subject to local policy)
* Learning \& development stipend to support ongoing growth
* Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation matching where available
* Mental wellbeing resources and support
* Benefits may vary by location; details will be shared during the interview process


 \#ZEOLife at Zuora
   

  

 ZEOs (our employees) are empowered to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and make a real impact. We:
   

  

* Collaborate deeply across teams and regions
* Learn constantly and iterate often
* Build an inclusive, high\-performance culture where people feel inspired, connected, and valued


 Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace
   

  

 Think, be and do you.
   

  

 At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences, and contributions matter — everyone counts.
   

  

 Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of, and consider individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regard to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to
 **assistance@zuora.com** 
 (or local equivalent, where applicable).

cdd5e5fa.title: Tech Lead – Automation Solutions (Power Platform, K2) - Husky (Guindy, Chennai)
cdd5e5fa.description:
At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.



Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state\-of\-the\-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.



Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

  


**Job Description**



Are you ready to shape the next generation of enterprise automation while keeping mission\-critical workflows running smoothly?



As Tech Lead for the Automation Team, you will play a pivotal role in Husky’s transition from legacy workflow platforms to a modern, scalable automation landscape centered on the Microsoft Power Platform. You’ll lead by example—guiding your team in designing, governing, and delivering Power Apps and Power Automate solutions—while also ensuring the reliability, continuity, and evolution of existing automation solutions such as K2\.



This role sits at the intersection of innovation and responsibility: driving modernization, setting technical standards, and mentoring engineers, while safeguarding the automation backbone that supports our global business operations.



If you enjoy combining hands\-on technical leadership, platform thinking, and pragmatic enterprise automation, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.


**Responsibilities**


**Technical Leadership**


* Understand the E2E high level architecture (big picture)
* Translate the HLD (high level design) into the LLD (low level design) in collaboration with architects and own the LLD
* Technical direction for the product area
* Contribute to coordinating cross\-team dependencies and integration points


**Delivery \& Execution Excellence**


* Contribute to the feature definition and review
* Generate concepts and facilitate the concept selection
* Breaking down complex features into actionable tasks
* Helping with estimation and sprint planning
* Addressing technical impediments
* Own production readiness (incl. non\-functional requirements)


**Quality, Governance \& Security**


* Ensuring quality
* Conducting meaningful reviews and ensuring adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) / DoD (Definition of Done) criteria
* Ensure adherence to applicable standards, policies, and practices (e.g. DevSecOps)


**Incident Response**


* Leading incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post\-mortems


**Mentorship \& Team Growth**


* Mentoring team members
* Documenting key design decisions
* Participate in interviews and hiring decisions
* Promoting engineering best practices and driving continuous improvement


**Collaboration \& Communication**


* Act as the primary technical point of contact across Product, Architecture, and Platform teams
* Clearly communicate technical decisions and trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.
* 10\+ years professional experience in software development, 5\+ years’ experience with Power Platform
* **Power Platform Expertise**
* Deep, hands\-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including: Power Apps (Canvas \& Model Driven)
* Power Automate (cloud flows, approvals, error handling)
* Dataverse (data modeling, security, performance)
* Proven ability to design enterprise\-scale Power Platform solutions
* Strong understanding of solution layering, Application Lifecycle Management, and environment strategies
* **Power Platform Governance**
* Hands\-on experience implementing Power Platform governance, including DLP policies, environment strategies, Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit
* Strong understanding of: Role\-based security in Dataverse
* Tenant\-level Power Platform administration
* Experience working in regulated or enterprise environments (e.g., GDPR, ISO, SOC)
* **Azure \& Microsoft Ecosystem**
* Solid experience in integrating Power Platform with Azure services (Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Entra AD) and Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive)
* Experience with authentication and authorization: Entra AD, OAuth, service principals, managed identities
* **DevOps \& ALM**
* Proven experience with Power Platform ALM, including: Managed vs unmanaged solutions
* Versioning and deployment strategies
* **Experience with:**
* Azure DevOps or GitHub
* CI/CD pipelines for Power Platform
* Automated testing strategies (where applicable)
* Familiarity with source control best practices for low\-code assets
* **Development \& Customization Skills**
* Strong proficiency in: Power Fx
* JavaScript (for model\-driven apps)
* Understanding data modeling best practices and normalization
* Experience working with web services / APIs (e.g., SOAP, REST)
* Working knowledge of Agile development practices
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team
* Fluency in English (spoken and written)
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Ability to adjust quickly to changing assignments, and priorities


**Assets**


* K2 Five / K2 BlackPearl – Workflows, Smart Objects, Forms and Views, Administration \& Troubleshooting, End\-to\-End testing
* Certifications: PL 600 \- Microsoft Power Platform Solution Architect Expert
* Experience setting up or running a Power Platform Center of Excellence
* Prior experience in citizen development enablement
* Exposure to AI Builder, Copilot Studio, or Power Platform \+ AI scenarios
* Background in enterprise integration


**Why Husky?**


**Regulated Working Hours:** Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work\-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well\-being.


**Visible Impact:** Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency.


**Strategic Influence:** Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape.


**Empowered Involvement:** Take an active role in decision\-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy.


**Valued Contributions:** Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services.


**Impactful Role:** Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability.


**Cutting\-Edge Projects:** Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer’s business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements.


**Supportive Community:** Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members.


**Collaborative Environment:** Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success.

  

  



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

0e255196.title: Senior Solutions Architect (Cloud & Connectivity)
0e255196.description:
**Who are we?**
 Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
   

  

 A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
   

  

 A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Supports strategic pre\-sales engagements, drives thought leadership in a cross functional manner and supports the global sales strategy of Equinix to drive revenue in an assigned territory. The role is responsible for providing technology and solution\-based thought leadership, bridging the network, Datacenter and Cloud/IT infrastructure into repeatable offers. Key focus areas include, but are not limited to, strategic sales engagements, development of offers, repeatable solutions, and use cases, focused on the five sales verticals within the Equinix Ecosystem (Network, Financial, Cloud, Content/Digital Media, and Enterprise).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Strategic Pre\-Sales Support \& Solution Development
   

  

* Provides advanced technology solutioning support to Equinix global field and channel sales
* Acts as a trusted technical advisor in pre\-sales engagement, translating customer requirements into scalable interconnection and cloud solutions
* Develops the account technology strategy with Sales team
* Prepares and conducts Customer workshops, and delivers customer presentations
* Design and propose hybrid and multi\-cloud connectivity architectures leveraging Equinix platform and ecosystem
* Demonstrates Equinix values through the provision of credible and convincing reasoning through compelling solutions to have a customer choose Equinix


 Research and Development
   

  

* Keeps up to date with the state of the art by utilizing the Equinix's Solution Development Framework
* Research relevant technology trends and analyses technology impacts
* Recommend stakeholders based upon research finds and implements new technologies, standards, processes, tools and techniques


 Subject Matter Expertise
   

  

* Maintains Industry awareness through training, reading, research, collaboration and industry event attendance


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Close collaboration and partnership with key stakeholders in the Finance, Sales, Legal, IT and Operations teams on technology and service initiatives, new product introductions, technology roadmap, and commercial concerns


 Technology and Innovation Insights
   

  

* Provides technical subject matter expertise to Sales, Marketing and the Industry through participation in creating, developing and delivering content for proposals, marketing studies and marketing events
* Supports the briefing of Sales teams on the impact of new technology
* Supports the briefing of Sales teams on the features, restrictions and selling points of new Equinix products and offers


**Qualifications**
* 10\+ Years in the functional domains of Network, Datacenter or Cloud Infrastructure domains, including strategic pre\-sales and technical support preferred
* 7\+ Years of solutions selling in a commercial pre\-sales position preferred
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related engineering discipline preferred
* Advanced industry certifications (i.e. Cisco, VMware, MS, AWS) preferred
* Strong background in enterprise networking preferred
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals including Layer/Layer 3 concepts and experience with Ethernet WAN services
* Familiar with Enterprise Cloud Connectivity models, including public internet and private connectivity
* Experience in cloud platforms and their connectivity solutions
* Understanding of hybrid and multi\-cloud architecture and experience designing hybrid or multi\-cloud connectivity solutions preferred
* Experience designing or supporting interconnection solutions within datacenter environments is highly preferred
* Ability to articulate the business value of connectivity solutions to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Basic awareness of modern workloads such as AI/ML is a plus


 Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.
   

  

 Equinix is an Equal Employment Opportunity and, in the U.S., an Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to unlawful consideration of race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, place of birth, citizenship, sex, pregnancy / childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic partnership status, age, veteran or military status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, political / organizational affiliation, status as a victim or family member of a victim of crime or abuse, or any other status protected by applicable law.

328486e7.description:
**About Us**

Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. a49aefea.title: Senior Technical Architect , Data Context Layer
a49aefea.description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**
* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.


 Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
   

  

 A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 This role is part of a broader enterprise initiative to establish a
 **Data Context Layer (DCL)** 
 — a foundational capability designed to provide consistent, reusable, and scalable context across enterprise data products.
   

  

 The DCL is intended to address challenges related to
 **data fragmentation, lack of shared semantics, and inconsistent interpretation of data across systems and products** 
 . It establishes a unified layer for representing context, relationships, and meaning, enabling downstream products to operate with greater consistency, interoperability, and intelligence.
   

  

 In addition, the DCL plays a critical role in enabling
 **agentic AI capabilities across the enterprise** 
 by providing the structured context and semantic grounding required for intelligent agents to operate reliably. This includes ensuring that agent\-driven workflows and decisions are based on
 **consistent, governed, and interpretable data context** 
 , reducing risks associated with fragmentation, ambiguity, and lack of control.
   

  

 Within this initiative, we are seeking a Senior Technical Architect to design and implement the technical foundation for an enterprise platform that enables teams to
 **publish, discover, and consume standardized data context through self\-service** 
 . This role is responsible for translating architecture principles into concrete technical patterns, integration designs, and implementation guidance that ensure the platform is scalable, secure, and production\-ready.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has strong hands\-on experience in platform architecture, data systems, semantic technologies, and AI\-enabled workflows. Familiarity with
 **ontologies, OWL, metadata\-driven systems, agentic AI, prompt engineering, and context engineering** 
 is required, as the platform must support both human and AI consumers of context.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement technical architecture patterns for the enterprise data context self\-service platform.
* Define solution\-level technical approaches for
+ context publishing
+ discovery
+ access control
+ versioning
+ validation
+ lineage and provenance
+ monitoring and observability

* Collaborate with product, lead architecture, engineering, service design, security, and governance teams to turn platform requirements into implementable designs.
* Develop technical standards and reference implementations that can be reused by delivery teams.
* Evaluate and integrate enabling technologies such as
+ ontology and semantic modeling approaches
+ OWL/RDF stacks
+ knowledge graphs
+ semantic layers
+ MCP, A2A, and timbr\-like technologies where relevant

* Ensure the platform supports both self\-service human workflows and AI/agentic consumption patterns.
* Define technical requirements for deployment, scaling, security, resilience, and maintainability.
* Support development teams through design reviews, implementation guidance, troubleshooting, and architecture decisions.
* Ensure context services can move from development to production with robust release, testing, and operational controls.
* Contribute to the design of APIs, data contracts, and integration patterns that make context reusable across the enterprise.
* Help shape how the platform supports agentic AI workflows, including structured prompt context, tool access, and reliable grounding data.


**Required Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of experience in technical architecture, solution architecture, data architecture, or senior engineering roles.
* Strong hands\-on experience with data platforms, APIs, distributed systems, or platform engineering.
* Familiarity with ontologies, OWL, RDF, knowledge graphs, and semantic layer concepts.
* Experience designing and implementing scalable, secure, production\-grade platform capabilities.
* Working knowledge of agentic AI, prompt engineering, and context engineering concepts.
* Ability to translate architecture requirements into practical technical designs and implementation patterns.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and experience working closely with engineering teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with MCP, A2A, timbr, or similar context\-serving or semantic interoperability technologies.
* Background in enterprise metadata management, data governance, or knowledge platform design.
* Experience supporting AI\-enabled platforms or agentic workflows.
* Knowledge of CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, observability, IAM, testing, and lifecycle management.
* Experience building reusable reference implementations or technical accelerators.
* Familiarity with regulated or security\-sensitive enterprise environments.


**What Success Looks Like**
 Success in this role means
   

  

* technical designs are clear, reusable, and implementable
* the platform is reliable, scalable, and production\-ready
* teams can build on common patterns rather than custom one\-off solutions
* context is delivered consistently to both applications and AI/agentic consumers
* development\-to\-production transitions are smooth and governed
* architecture decisions improve maintainability, interoperability, and adoption


**Who we are** 
 We are known as Merck \& Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
   

  

**What we look for** 
 Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. 81b4818b.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
81b4818b.description:
**Summary**
 Guidewire provides outstanding software for the second\-largest financial services industry in the world: insurance. We deliver the core applications that Property and Casualty (P/C) insurers use to build their products, sell policies, settle claims, and bill their customers. We deliver SaaS solutions via Guidewire Cloud that enable our customers to rapidly innovate and drive measurable value. Our Application Platform helps internal developers and customers build innovative insurance applications with the aim to boost developer productivity, establish a vendor ecosystem and leverage the latest cloud technologies.
   

  

 As a Technical Program Manager, you will play a key role within Application Platform organization, driving projects internally (and with other teams). You will be responsible to drive and coordinate major platform and cloud service initiatives with the highest degree of complexity. Your impact will be felt across the organization. You will spend a significant proportion of your time developing the capabilities of the team as a whole.
   

  

**Job Description**
 What you’ll do
   

  

* Lead end‑to‑end planning and execution of complex, multi‑team technical programs across platform, cloud operations, product engineering, data, and security to support PDO’s goals in reliability, security, and gross margin improvement.
* Partner with engineering, product management, design, QA, business stakeholders, and infrastructure teams to define scope, problem statements, success metrics, and delivery milestones for initiatives such as GenAI “lifts,” cloud reliability improvements, and new platform capabilities.
* Develop, maintain, and continuously refine integrated program plans—including timelines, dependency maps, risk registers, and release plans—to ensure programs land on time, within scope, and with clearly defined business outcomes.
* Manage cross‑functional dependencies, proactively identify and remove blockers, and escalate risks with data‑driven options so teams can move quickly while maintaining quality, compliance, and customer trust.
* Facilitate agile ceremonies, technical deep dives, architecture and design discussions, and regular program syncs that align teams around priorities, trade‑offs, and delivery commitments across loosely coupled domains.
* Implement and evolve program governance, reporting cadences, and operational best practices that improve transparency, decision‑making, and execution efficiency across PDO and partner organizations.
* Define and own program‑level KPIs (e.g., reliability, incident metrics, development velocity, technical debt reduction, cloud and data platform adoption, infrastructure stability), track variances, and drive course‑corrections based on data and continuous feedback.
* Ensure technical readiness for production releases—including security posture, scalability, performance, disaster recovery dependencies, and operational health—aligned with Guidewire’s security and compliance standards.
* Collaborate with leadership to drive change management, refine processes, and align programs with Guidewire’s broader vision to embed AI and GenAI across products and operations, including initiatives like the Agentic AI Platform and cloud adoption accelerators.
* Influence platform and tooling direction by identifying opportunities to streamline developer workflows, improve operational efficiency, and better support AI, cloud, and data platform adoption across PDO and other teams.
* Manage relationships with vendors and third‑party service providers where applicable, including contract and SLA considerations, to ensure external dependencies support program outcomes and service reliability.
* Act as the “glue” that connects high‑velocity, distributed teams, ensuring alignment with Guidewire’s mission to transform how P\&C insurers operate through a secure, scalable, AI‑enabled cloud platform.
* At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data\-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 12\+ years of total professional experience, including 5\+ years in technical program management driving complex, multi‑team software initiatives, preferably in cloud, infrastructure, or platform environments.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and agile or hybrid delivery models, with the ability to work effectively with engineering, product, operations, and security teams.
* Solid grasp of modern software architecture, cloud systems (e.g., distributed, multi‑tenant SaaS), and platform engineering concepts such as reliability, observability, and scalability.
* Proven track record of designing and running metrics‑driven programs: defining KPIs, building dashboards or reporting mechanisms, and using data to guide decisions, communicate impact, and improve program performance.
* Hands‑on experience with engineering planning and tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, Aha!, Confluence, Google Sheets) to manage backlogs, dependencies, and status reporting at scale.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex technical topics for executives and non‑technical partners, and to drive alignment among diverse viewpoints.
* Proficiency with change management principles and techniques—able to guide teams through new processes, tools, and ways of working while minimizing disruption and resistance.
* Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data\-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.


**Preferred Skills \& Experience**
* Experience leading programs related to cloud operations, platform reliability, AI/ML or GenAI features, or large‑scale data platforms.
* Background in or exposure to P\&C insurance or other highly regulated industries, particularly in cloud or SaaS environments.
* Experience with vendor management, including understanding of SLAs, contract implications, and how external partners fit into critical program paths.
* Prior experience in organizations undergoing significant cloud, AI, or data platform transformation, especially where operational excellence and innovation must be balanced.
* BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field—or equivalent demonstrated technical proficiency through experience.


 Your Impact
   

  

 We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first months, you’ll immerse yourself in PDO’s FY26 VPMOM, understand our AI, cloud, and data platform priorities, and take ownership of one or more high‑impact programs—such as reliability and security improvements, GenAI‑enabled product capabilities, or cross‑region disaster recovery and readiness initiatives.
   

  

 You’ll establish program structures, clarify goals and KPIs, and build trusted relationships with engineering, product, security, operations, and go‑to‑market leaders. As your programs mature, you’ll be accountable for measurable outcomes like improved service reliability, faster time‑to‑market for AI‑infused features, increased adoption of cloud and data platform capabilities, and reduced operational toil. Your work will directly support Guidewire’s mission to combine digital, core, analytics, and AI into a cloud platform that helps P\&C insurers operate more efficiently and deliver better experiences to their customers worldwide.
   

  

**About Guidewire**
 Guidewire is the platform P\&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540\+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.
   

  

 As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600\+ successful projects, supported by the largest R\&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.
   

  

 For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC.

 RTS is a growing SAP Services organisation specialising in SAP ECC\-to\-S/4HANA transformations, SAP ECC and S/4HANA AMS support, and global SAP consulting services. We partner with customers across industries to deliver business transformation, application managed services, and continuous improvement initiatives using SAP technologies. Our organisation is focused on building strong SAP competencies, delivery excellence, reusable accelerators, and customer\-centric AMS and transformation models
 



  





 The ideal candidate will be responsible for working cross\-functionally to understand architecture needs by multiple business units. To be effective in this position, you must feel comfortable owning the entire architecture development process from inception to completion.
 



  





**Job Description** 




 We are looking for a senior OTC Solution Architect / Competency Lead to lead our SAP OTC practice in India. This role requires a strong mix of solution architecture, delivery leadership, AMS expertise, organization building, pre\-sales support capabilities, and an AI\-first mindset across all aspects of SAP ERP delivery and transformation services. The ideal candidate must have extensive experience in SAP ECC and S/4HANA implementation programs as well as AMS support engagements. The individual should be willing to play a hands\-on delivery role initially while helping establish broader organizational capabilities, methodologies, accelerators, automation frameworks, and AI\-enabled best practices for the OTC competency. The candidate should help drive adoption of AI\-led delivery models, intelligent automation, predictive support approaches, and productivity\-enhancing tools across both SAP ERP Delivery and SAP ERP Transformation practices.This is a strategic leadership role requiring strong client\-facing skills, team leadership, and the ability to “walk the talk” in a fast\-growing SAP services environment. The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping a modern, AI\-enabled SAP practice focused on innovation, delivery excellence, operational efficiency, and customer success.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Responsibilities include leading architecture initiatives from inception to completion, collaborating with business users to create architecture in alignment with business need, acting as a technical subject matter expert for business users, championing the adoption of reusable architecture assets to improve efficiency, and producing documentation to aid in the understanding of existing architecture solutions.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Lead SAP OTC solution architecture and delivery for ECC and S/4HANA programs
* Support SAP ECC and S/4HANA AMS engagements including governance and escalations
* Drive end\-to\-end OTC processes including Sales, Pricing, Billing, Shipping, Credit Management, and integrations with Finance and Supply Chain
* Participate hands\-on in solution design, issue resolution, and critical delivery activities
* Build and lead the OTC competency in India
* Define methodologies, accelerators, templates, tools, and delivery standards
* Mentor and develop OTC consultants and delivery teams
* Support SAP transformation and AMS pre\-sales activities including solutioning, estimations, proposals, and client presentations
* Act as a trusted advisor for customers and leadership teams
* Manage offshore/onshore coordination and delivery governance



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer science, Engineering, or Mathematics



  





**Required Skills** 



* Minimum 15\+ years of SAP experience with strong focus on OTC/SD processes
* Immediate joiner
* AI first mindset for both solutions and practice development and delivery
* Proven experience in:
* SAP ECC implementations
* SAP S/4HANA implementations
* SAP ECC AMS support
* SAP S/4HANA AMS support
* Deep expertise in SAP SD/OTC processes and integrations with FICO, MM, PP, WM/EWM, and Supply Chain functions
* Strong understanding of AMS delivery and support models
* Experience leading global SAP delivery teams and customer engagements
* Strong client\-facing communication and stakeholder management skills
* Experience in organization building, competency development, and mentoring
* Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands\-on delivery responsibilities
* Experience supporting pre\-sales and SAP transformation pursuits



 SAP S/4HANA certification, PM Certification, Industry Certification are advantage but not required
 



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Opportunity to build and lead a growing SAP OTC competency
* Strategic leadership role with high visibility and impact
* Work on global SAP ECC and S/4HANA transformation programs
* Entrepreneurial and growth\-oriented environment
* Ability to shape delivery methodologies, accelerators, and best practices
* Opportunity to influence business growth through delivery excellence and customer success



  





  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




 We are committed to diversity and inclusivity.

35126a43.title: Enterprise Architect
35126a43.description:
**Location:** IN \- Bangalore 24/7 \| **Job\-ID:** 219581 \| **Contract type:** Standard \| **Business Unit:** IT Consulting **Life on the team**

Create and maintain current and target enterprise architecture views for Global Business Services (e.g. Finance, Human Resources, Legal) and Global Information Services (our internal IT division) capabilities. Connect business strategy, technology direction and portfolio priorities into clear capability roadmaps, investment choices and architecture guidance. Ensure governance, standards and decision\-making support coherent, value\-led and sustainable technology change across these corporate functions.
**What you'll do**
* Act as the Enterprise Architecture lead for Global Business Services which covers both our Business Services (e.g. Finance, HR, Legal, Property) and Information Services (Cyber, Platforms, Delivery) divisions. You will be helping business and technology stakeholders make informed decisions that support strategy, value delivery and risk reduction.
* Partner with Business Services and GIS stakeholders and work with Solution Architecture and delivery teams to define a shared architecture vision and roadmap for our services and investments in your scope.
* Assure solution options against enterprise architecture principles, guardrails, commercial considerations and business outcomes before they progress into delivery.
* Support annual and quarterly planning by ensuring initiatives align to agreed strategies, architecture direction, dependencies, risks and value priorities.
* Maintain effective architecture governance, decision records, standards and tooling so stakeholders can make transparent and consistent decisions.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of the Enterprise Architecture practice by improving EA information quality, reusable artefacts, tools and ways of working.


**What you'll need**
* Enterprise Architecture experience across corporate functions such as Finance, HR, Legal, as well as technology capabilities in associated with Cyber, Cloud Platforms and Workspace.
* Strong understanding of business applications, integration, data, controls, risk, compliance and technology operating models.
* Ability to translate business strategy into technology strategy, capability roadmaps, architecture principles and portfolio guidance.
* Knowledge of frameworks and methods including TOGAF, ArchiMate, SAFe, ITIL, FinOps, DevSecOps, Responsible AI principles, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001 and ISO 27001\.
* Experience with enterprise architecture and modelling tools such as LeanIX, Ardoq, Bizzdesign, ArchiMate or Sparx EA.
* Credible stakeholder influencer who can engage, challenge and guide senior business, GIS and delivery stakeholders.
* Technology\-neutral and outcome\-focused, with the judgement to balance value, cost, risk, complexity and sustainability.
* Strong analytical, planning, facilitation, negotiation, communication and organisational skills.
* Experience using EA repositories, architecture models, roadmaps and decision artefacts to improve governance and decision\-making.


**Leadership Requirements**
* Bridges business and technology conversations with clear, practical communication.
* Turns strategic direction into executable roadmaps, decisions and governed change.
* Influences senior stakeholders through credibility, facilitation and constructive challenge.
* Focuses on business outcomes, value delivery, risk reduction and sustainable decisions.
* Builds trust by helping stakeholders navigate complexity, ambiguity and change.


**Critical Success Factors**
* Clear architecture direction adopted by Finance, HR, Legal and GIS stakeholders.
* Roadmaps and decision artefacts that support portfolio prioritisation and delivery choices.
* Technology decisions demonstrably aligned to business outcomes, value, risk and sustainability.
* Effective governance that improves transparency, consistency and delivery confidence.
* Strong stakeholder confidence in the EA role, practice and recommendations.

  


**About us**

Computacenter is a leading independent provider of IT infrastructure services, with about 21,000 employees worldwide. We work at the heart of digitisation, advising organisations on IT strategy, implementing the most appropriate technology and managing our customers’ infrastructures.  



We offer a friendly, open working environment without too much fuss about hierarchy. We are looking for professionals with diverse competencies, personalities and strengths who want to live our shared value of teamwork and performance.  



Interested in joining a company with a strong sense of community?  



We’re growing. We’re hiring. We encourage. We empower. We support.  

\#winningtogether \#peoplematter

41dd2b71.description:
**Job Description – Data Architect (Contract)**

**Position** \- Data Architect

**Experience** \- 10\+ Years

**Location** \- Remote

**Employment Type** \- Contract

**Duration** \- Contract Role

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Data Architect to lead enterprise data architecture initiatives for large\-scale healthcare data transformation programs. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in enterprise data architecture, cloud data platforms, SAP ERP, Salesforce CRM, and enterprise data modeling. This role requires designing scalable, secure, and high\-performing data solutions while driving data standardization and modernization across global commercial operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define enterprise data architecture strategy and solution design.
* Design integration architecture across SAP ERP, Salesforce CRM, and cloud data platforms.
* Develop data harmonization strategies across global commercial data domains.
* Define enterprise data models, governance frameworks, and architecture standards.
* Drive enterprise\-wide data standardization and data consolidation initiatives.
* Align data architecture with global commercial operating models and business objectives.
* Establish architecture principles focused on scalability, security, reliability, and performance.
* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to data engineering and data modeling teams.
* Review solution designs, ETL frameworks, and implementation approaches to ensure architectural best practices.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, technical teams, and leadership to deliver enterprise data solutions.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* 10\+ years of experience in Enterprise Data Architecture.
* Strong expertise in SAP ERP and Salesforce CRM data architecture.
* Experience designing enterprise\-scale data platforms.
* Strong understanding of data harmonization, data standardization, and enterprise data modeling.
* Experience with AWS cloud data platforms (preferred).
* Experience in Healthcare, Manufacturing, or Life Sciences domains.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.
* Ability to drive enterprise architecture decisions and mentor technical teams.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with modern cloud\-based data architecture.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise integration patterns and ETL frameworks.
* Experience with large\-scale data transformation and modernization initiatives.
* Understanding of data governance, metadata management, and master data management (MDM).

Pay: From ₹70,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Work from home

* Your Current CTC
* Your Notice Period

Experience with AI/ML architecture patterns and system integration

Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or Node.js
  
Experience with AI/ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-learn, etc.)

0a8b042f.title: Hybrid Cloud Architect
0a8b042f.description:
**About Us**
**PHINIA:** 
 Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow.
   

  

 PHINIA is an independent, market\-leading, premium solutions and components provider with over 100 years of manufacturing expertise and industry relationships, with a strong brand portfolio that includes DELPHI®, DELCO REMY® and HARTRIDGE™. With over 12,500 employees across 43 locations in 20 countries, PHINIA is headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan, USA.
   

  

 At PHINIA, we Provide fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket products and solutions of the highest quality — developed and manufactured responsibly — that are designed to enhance efficiency and reduce the environmental impact of vehicles, industrial machinery, and other applications. In doing so, we contribute to a cleaner tomorrow, treat our people and surrounding communities with respect, and hold ourselves accountable to robust ethical standards.
   

  

**Our Culture**
 PHINIA promotes and cultivates an inclusive culture and diverse perspectives, strives to maintain its reputation for excellence, thrives on the power of collaboration, and fosters the development of our talented employees. We believe in making a positive impact through our business and actions, and we take our collective responsibility seriously.
   

  

**Career Opportunities**
 We believe in building a brighter tomorrow for our employees as well as our customers and encourage you to learn about our long history, strong culture, new technologies, and future vision. We offer a strong local presence and interesting global opportunities. Join us on this shared journey toward a brighter tomorrow.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 PHINIA is seeking a Hybrid Cloud Architect to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of PHINIA’s hybrid cloud ecosystem, spanning on‑premises infrastructure, private cloud, and public cloud platforms. This role ensures secure, scalable, cost‑efficient cloud architectures that align with PHINIA’s digital transformation strategy. The architect will guide cloud migration initiatives and governance standards while partnering closely with infrastructure, security, application, and business teams to deliver resilient hybrid cloud capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect hybrid cloud environments across on‑prem, private cloud, and public cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP).
* Lead hybrid infrastructure modernization, including cloud migration strategies and data center integration.
* Establish and enforce hybrid cloud governance models, compliance controls, FinOps principles and security standards in collaboration with PHINIA Security and IT governance teams.
* Develop disaster recovery, business continuity approaches, and hybrid failover patterns.
* Create and maintain hybrid cloud architectural documentation, integration diagrams, interface specifications, and operational runbooks.
* Evaluate emerging cloud technologies, recommend enhancements, and lead proof‑of‑concept initiatives.
* Collaborate with DevOps, Infrastructure, and Application teams to drive automation, IaC adoption, and CI/CD integration.
* Modernize workloads (ERP, MES, PLM, custom apps) using containers, Kubernetes, and cloud\-native services.
* Design secure OT/IT integration, industrial edge compute, and data pipelines (OPC‑UA, IoT, analytics).


**What we’re looking for:**
* Bachelor’s or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent work experience.
* 7\+ years of IT infrastructure experience with 4\+ years in cloud or hybrid architecture.
* Strong expertise in Azure (preferred), plus working knowledge of AWS/GCP.
* Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation), automation, CI/CD tooling and containerization (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Experience with OT systems and industrial protocols.
* Foundation in cloud security, Zero Trust, networking, and governance.
* Background in manufacturing/automotive environments is a strong preference.
* Certifications such as Azure/AWS Architect, TOGAF, or FinOps are plus.


**What We Offer**
 We provide compensation and benefits programs intended to attract, motivate, reward, and retain an incredibly talented, globally diverse workforce at all levels within our organization. Our compensation programs are informed by market data and business needs, and we are committed to providing equitable and competitive compensation. We are committed to providing our team with quality and competitive benefit programs, including health and well\-being resources, family\-centric policies, and an agile workplace program, where not precluded by collective bargaining agreements or national statutory plans. Plans are benchmarked for competitiveness and value.
   

  

 We provide formal development opportunities at all levels and stages of employee careers. These opportunities are delivered in a variety of formats to make our portfolio of solutions agile, sustainable, and scalable to support our employees in developing the skills needed to succeed.
   

  

**What We Believe**
* Product Leadership \- Innovation that brings value to our customers
* Humility \- Seeking out diverse perspectives and working collaboratively
* Inclusivity \- Recognizing our differences makes us stronger; we are bold and intentional
* Net\-Zero \- Committed to energy efficiency, waste reduction and beneficial reuse
* Integrity \- Taking responsibility for our decisions and doing what is right
* Accountability \- Taking ownership of our actions and driving results


**SAFETY**
 You will consistently hear us say Safety First! We are committed to continually improving our strong safety performance supporting the health and wellness of our employees!
   

  

 We also believe employee health and safety is everyone’s responsibility. We encourage safety learning and collaboration to help employees understand and follow applicable safety policies, standards, and procedures and identify opportunities to minimize or eliminate risk. Work is expected to be conducted in a manner that stresses the importance of preventing incidents and illnesses, including attending all required safety meetings and trainings. It is expected that all incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions are immediately reported to the direct manager, Human Resources, or Safety Representative.
   

  

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**
 PHINIA is an equal employment opportunity employer such that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.
   

  

**VISA SPONSORSHIP**
 PHINIA does provide sponsorship for employment visa status based on business need. However, for this role, applicants must be currently authorized to work on a full\-time basis, in the country where the position is currently based.
   

  

**NO UNAUTHORIZED REFERRALS FROM RECRUITERS \& VENDORS**
 Please note that PHINIA does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or offers from third party recruiters or staffing agencies associated with any published or unpublished employment opportunities. Any unsolicited information sent to PHINIA will be considered as unencumbered and free from any fee or charge whatsoever. Only members of our Human Resources Team have the authority to engage or authorize recruiting services, which must be agreed upon before the unsolicited resume or offer is received.
   

  

**GLOBAL TERMS OF USE AND PRIVACY STATEMENT**
 Carefully read the PHINIA Privacy Policy before using this website. Your ability to access and use this website and apply for a job at PHINIA are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms.
   

  

 Please access the linked document by clicking here, select the geographical area where you are applying for employment, and review.
   

  

 Before submitting your application you will be asked to confirm your agreement with the terms.
   

  

***Career Scam Disclaimer:***
*PHINIA makes no representations or guarantees regarding employment opportunities listed on any third\-party website. To protect against career scams, job applicants should take the necessary precautions when interviewing for and accepting employment positions allegedly offered by PHINIA. Applicants should never provide their national ID numbers, birth dates, credit card numbers, bank account information or other private information when communicating with prospective employers or responding to employment opportunities online. Job applicants are invited to contact PHINIA through PHINIA’s website to verify the authenticity of any employment opportunities.*
 Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow. Join us on this shared journey to a brighter tomorrow. For more information about PHINIA, please visit www.phinia.com.

21d5a776.title: Program Manager, WHS CPT
21d5a776.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Central Programs Team, India (CPT India) leads cross\-functional projects that requires collaboration and partnership with Amazon businesses, geographical units and technical subject matter experts (SMEs). The projects are focused on initiatives to continually reduce risks and improve network WHS standards and procedures. Individuals gather business requirements, document functional and design specifications, identify appropriate resources needed, assemble the right project team, assign individual responsibilities and develop the milestones and launch schedules to ensure timely and successful delivery of the project. The team members measure and report progress, anticipate and resolve bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs with the technical constraints. This is a program management role responsible for executing per direction, the management of the WW WHS programs (standards, procedures, best practices) development, training and continuous improvement projects. The role involves hands\-on work in the areas of understanding stakeholder needs and expectations, WHS regulatory research, global stakeholder engagement, data analytics and document technical writing. The candidate must be a self\-starter and detail\-oriented. They must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Program/Process Improvement, Project Management
* Clearly and timely communicate findings, determinations, and recommendations to compliance management and business partners, both at periodic intervals and as needed regarding escalated or high\-risk compliance issues.
* Guide management in the development/review of applicable policies, procedures and business practices.

Engage in frequent written and verbal communication with management and business partners to accomplish goals.
  

* Execute and drive audits to completion per SOP. This includes drafting audit reports, stakeholder reviews of audit reports, finalizing and tracking audit reports in database and tracking issues in system ( Associate Safety Committee \- ASC Inspection, Simple Issue Management, Trouble Ticket).
* Owns weekly/monthly reports and metrics.
* Identifies gaps in audit programs and processes and escalates to manager.
* Follows confidentiality rules with the documents reviewed.
* Drafts documents and revisions on audit reports per manager direction.
* Performs deep dive analysis/research on data/information/literature and creates recommendations/corrective actions based on identified deviations and recommends appropriate solutions.
* Earns trust of peers by understanding audit processes and programs.
* Makes recommendations to managers for input into roadmap strategic discussions and continuous improvement projects to drive program efficiencies.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
* 5\+ years of managing stakeholders in cross\-functional project experience
* Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior leadership
* Bachelor’s degree in Safety, Environment related field or Engineering.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
* Experience in MS Access and SQL
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
* Experience using Microsoft Projects software
* Experience working in an analytical environment with cross\-functional teams
* Experience using managed ML/AI solutions

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

* Build and deliver compelling technical demonstrations of the Freshworks products.

* Be a lifelong learner and develop your skills continuously.
* Evangelize a refreshing user experience on the Freshworks platform.

* Significant experience in technology sales with a demonstrated aptitude for technology at the business and technical level.
* Demonstrated operations and organizational skills implementing and driving best practices in multi\-office, cross\-functional organizations.
* Extensive expertise supporting mid\-market customers and creating service/support strategies.
* Strong organisational and analytical skills.
* Outstanding interpersonal skills, with a proven record of successfully building collaboration around important initiatives.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Successful track record of working and influencing matrixes organizations.

0345a11f.title: Solution Architect
0345a11f.description:
**Strength in Trust**
 OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016\. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
   

  

**Strength in Trust**
 OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down \- it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016\. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like.
   

  

 OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
   

  

**The Challenge**
 As a Solution Architect within the Design Partner Program, you will serve as the technical leader responsible for translating strategic customer requirements into scalable, secure, and reusable platform solutions across OneTrust’s AI\-Ready Governance Platform. You will operate at the intersection of Product Management, Customer Engineering, Architecture, and Software Development, helping shape the future of Privacy, Consent, Risk, AI Governance, and Compliance solutions.
   

  

 You will work directly with strategic customers, Product Specialists, Engineering leaders, and Product Management teams to understand business objectives, identify architectural patterns, validate technical approaches, and accelerate delivery of customer\-driven innovations. Your role is not simply to solve today's customer problem, but to design solutions that scale across the broader OneTrust platform and customer base.
   

  

 Success in this role means accelerating customer adoption, reducing implementation complexity, improving product quality, influencing architecture strategy, and transforming customer requirements into differentiated platform capabilities that create long\-term competitive advantage.
   

  

**Your Mission**
* Define Scalable Solution Architectures: Design and evolve scalable architectures spanning Privacy, Consent \& Preferences, Risk \& Governance, AI Governance, and Compliance solutions. Establish architectural patterns that balance customer flexibility with platform standardization and long\-term maintainability.
* Partner with Strategic Customers: Serve as the trusted technical advisor for Design Partner customers. Lead architecture workshops, solution reviews, integration assessments, and technical discovery sessions to understand complex business requirements and translate them into scalable solution designs.
* Bridge Product Vision and Technical Execution: Collaborate closely with Product Specialists, Product Management, and Engineering teams to validate designs, refine requirements, and ensure technical feasibility. Help transform customer feedback into product capabilities, reference architectures, and roadmap investments.
* Drive Platform and Integration Excellence: Define integration patterns, API strategies, data models, identity architectures, event\-driven workflows, and governance controls that enable customers to seamlessly connect OneTrust with their broader technology ecosystem. Ensure solutions are secure, scalable, and operationally resilient.
* Accelerate AI\-Powered Solution Innovation: Partner with engineering teams to apply AI\-driven approaches that simplify implementation, improve architecture decisions, accelerate troubleshooting, and enhance operational efficiency. Identify opportunities to leverage AI across customer solutions while maintaining governance, security, and compliance requirements.
* Establish Technical Standards \& Best Practices: Drive architecture governance, design reviews, technical standards, and reusable implementation patterns across Customer Engineering and Product Engineering teams. Mentor engineers and architects while helping establish long\-term architectural consistency across the platform.


**You Are**
* A systems thinker who can balance customer requirements, product strategy, and platform scalability.
* Passionate about solving complex enterprise challenges through elegant technical solutions.
* Comfortable engaging with architects, engineers, product leaders, executives, and customer stakeholders.
* Customer\-obsessed and motivated by delivering measurable business outcomes through technology.
* Deeply technical while able to communicate architectural decisions in business terms.
* A collaborative leader who drives alignment across Product, Engineering, and Customer teams.
* Energized by creating reusable solutions that benefit both strategic customers and the broader market.


**Your Experience Includes**
* 8 \-12 years of software engineering, solution architecture, or enterprise architecture experience.
* Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise\-scale SaaS platforms and cloud\-native architectures.
* Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event\-driven architectures, and integration frameworks.
* Experience working directly with enterprise customers on solution architecture, requirements analysis, and technical strategy.(Recommended enhancement for DPP alignment.)
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms, container technologies, Kubernetes, messaging systems, and modern application architectures.
* Experience designing secure, scalable, and highly available systems for enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated ability to influence product direction through architecture leadership and customer insights.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to present to executives, customers, and technical teams.
* Experience with Privacy, Consent, Risk, Governance, Security, Compliance, Data Management, or AI Governance domains preferred.
* Experience mentoring engineers and establishing architecture standards across multiple teams.


 Where we Work
   

  

 We are embracing an office\-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
   

  

 Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
   

  

**Benefits**
 As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14\+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company\-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
   

  

 Resources
   

  

 Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:
   

  

* OneTrust Careers on YouTube
* @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram


 Your Data
   

  

 You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview
 **.** 
 You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.
   

  

 Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse\-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.
   

  

**Our Commitment to You**
 When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.
   

  

 OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.
