5f9c3d57.title: Enterprise Solution Architect (Technology)
5f9c3d57.description:
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the world's largest independent IT and business consulting services firms. With 94,000 consultants and professionals globally, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services, and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion, and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.  

  

Job Title: Enterprise Solution Architect (Technology)  

Experience: 15 to 20 years of experience  

Job location: Bangalore  

Position ID: J0726\-0080  

Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent  

Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.  

  

Role Overview:
  

  

CGI is seeking a highly experienced Technology Expert to provide strategic technology leadership for the Utilities Sub Business Unit. The role will be responsible for defining solution architectures, technology strategies, and enterprise technology roadmaps that enable successful client engagements across the utilities sector.  

  

The Technology Expert will serve as the primary technology advisor to the Utilities sub business unit, providing architectural guidance for strategic pursuits, complex transformation programs, and technology modernization initiatives. The role will work closely with business stakeholders, domain experts, delivery teams, and CGI Prime BUs to develop differentiated technology solutions, address complex technical challenges, and strengthen CGI's Utilities technology capabilities.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**


1\. Technology Leadership \& Architecture
  

. Serve as the technology authority for the Utilities Sub Business Unit, providing strategic guidance on enterprise architecture, solution architecture, and technology strategy.  

. Define end to end solution architectures that align business requirements with enterprise technology platforms and industry best practices.  

. Develop technology roadmaps supporting digital transformation initiatives across utility organizations.  

. Ensure solution architectures are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with CGI's architectural standards and governance.  

. Provide architectural oversight across strategic client engagements and transformation programmes.  

  

2\. Solutioning \& Business Development
  

. Lead technology solutioning for strategic pursuits, proposals, and RFP responses.  

. Define technical approaches, architecture blueprints, integration strategies, and implementation roadmaps for client opportunities.  

. Support client presentations, architecture discussions, technical workshops, and executive engagements during sales and solutioning activities.  

. Provide technology leadership during bid reviews, solution assurance, and commercial evaluations.  

  

3\. Technology Consulting \& Advisory
  

. Act as the primary technology advisor during discussions with CGI Prime BUs, ensuring alignment on enterprise architecture, technology direction, and delivery approaches.  

. Provide expert guidance on technology selection, modernization strategies, cloud adoption, application transformation, and enterprise integration.  

. Resolve complex technical and architectural challenges encountered during solution design and project delivery.  

. Recommend innovative technologies and architectural patterns that improve business outcomes while reducing implementation risk.  

  

4\. Innovation \& Technology Enablement
  

. Evaluate emerging technologies and assess their applicability within the Utilities industry.  

. Drive adoption of Cloud, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Data \& Analytics, Internet of Things (IoT), Automation, Digital Platforms, and API led integration capabilities.  

. Develop reusable reference architectures, technology accelerators, frameworks, and best practices for the Utilities practice.  

. Collaborate with Prime BUs to leverage CGI's enterprise capabilities and technology assets.  

  

5\. Practice Development
  

. Strengthen the technical capability of the Utilities Sub Business Unit through mentoring, architecture reviews, and knowledge sharing.  

. Establish architecture governance, technology standards, and design principles across Utilities engagements.  

. Foster collaboration across consulting, delivery, engineering, and architecture teams to continuously improve solution quality and innovation.
  

  

Desired Skills \& Expertise  

  

1\. Architecture \& Engineering
  

. Enterprise Architecture  

. Solution Architecture  

. Technology Architecture  

. Cloud Architecture  

. Integration Architecture  

. Microservices  

. API led Integration  

. Event Driven Architecture  

. Enterprise Integration Patterns  

. Security Architecture  

. Application Modernization  

  

2\. Cloud \& Platforms
  

. Microsoft Azure  

. Amazon Web Services (AWS)  

. Google Cloud Platform (GCP)  

. Kubernetes  

. OpenShift  

. Containers  

. Platform Engineering  

  

3\. Digital Technologies
  

. Artificial Intelligence (AI)  

. Generative AI  

. Data \& Analytics  

. Internet of Things (IoT)  

. Automation  

. Digital Engineering  

. Enterprise Integration Platforms  

  

4\. Utilities Technology
  

. Customer Information Systems (CIS)

d7169e36.title: Senior Consultant Solutions
d7169e36.description:
**Job Summary**
 The
 **Senior Consultant – Solutions** 
 is responsible for supporting the development of differentiated procurement solutions, proposals, RFx responses, and sales pursuit materials for ProcureAbility’s internal stakeholders and external clients. This role works closely with the US Solutions Team, delivery leaders, subject matter experts, sales stakeholders, and leadership teams to translate client requirements into compelling procurement solutions and high\-quality client\-facing deliverables.
   

  

 The Senior Consultant – Solutions will support both
 **business development** 
 and
 **sales solutioning** 
 activities. Business development responsibilities include supporting lead qualification, prospect research, sales campaign execution, market research, and pipeline documentation. Sales solutioning responsibilities include developing opportunity\-level solution strategies, creating proposals, supporting pricing and commercial documentation, preparing RFx responses, and coordinating inputs from delivery and functional experts.
   

  

 This position acts as a client\-facing and internal consultant on ProcureAbility’s procurement services, capabilities, operating models, delivery approaches, and solution offerings. The role requires strong procurement understanding, excellent communication skills, PowerPoint and documentation expertise, and the ability to work across time zones with US\-based and global stakeholders.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Supports the development of differentiated procurement solutions for prospective and existing clients across procurement consulting, managed services, analytics, market intelligence, digital enablement, sourcing, category management, and procurement operations.
* Works alongside the US Solutions Team to respond to RFPs, RFIs, proposals, sales presentations, client requests, and other pursuit\-related deliverables.
* Engages with prospects and internal sales stakeholders to understand client business needs, procurement pain points, buying priorities, and potential solution fit.
* Supports client discovery discussions by listening to requirements, asking clarifying questions, documenting client needs, and identifying relevant ProcureAbility capabilities.
* Translates client requirements into structured solution narratives, operating models, service descriptions, scope documents, process flows, and proposal content.
* Develops high\-quality, professional proposals, RFx responses, presentation decks, solution documents, case study inserts, executive summaries, and other sales collateral.
* Coordinates with procurement delivery leaders and subject matter experts to gather inputs on delivery approach, staffing, methodology, assumptions, timelines, and value proposition.
* Supports opportunity\-level sales strategy by helping define the solutioning approach, win themes, differentiation, client messaging, delivery model, and commercial positioning.
* Documents sales solutioning approach, pricing strategy, proposal assumptions, client notes, meeting outputs, action items, and key decisions throughout the sales cycle.
* Supports the creation and maintenance of reusable solutioning assets, proposal templates, capability decks, service descriptions, standard responses, and knowledge repositories.
* Conducts market research, company research, prospect research, procurement maturity research, and industry analysis to support sales pursuits and client conversations.
* Assists in qualifying opportunities by assessing client fit, scope relevance, service alignment, procurement needs, potential deal size, and readiness to engage.
* Supports the end\-to\-end sales cycle from inbound opportunity through proposal development, client presentations, follow\-ups, negotiations, and closure.
* Helps shorten the sales cycle by producing timely, accurate, and client\-relevant solution materials.
* Works with internal stakeholders to ensure solution quality, consistency, commercial viability, and alignment with ProcureAbility’s service offerings.
* Interfaces with Legal, Finance, Sales, and Delivery teams to support contract triage, negotiation inputs, scope clarification, and proposal assumptions.
* Maintains accurate opportunity documentation in CRM tools such as HubSpot, including pipeline notes, sales activities, proposal status, next steps, and forecasting inputs.
* Supports sales metrics tracking, dashboard updates, reporting, and internal stakeholder communication related to pipeline and pursuit progress.
* Drives standardization and continuous improvement in solutioning processes, proposal development, RFx response quality, sales documentation, and pursuit governance.
* Supports internal review meetings, proposal readouts, pursuit strategy discussions, client presentation preparation, and executive briefings.
* Helps develop strong storytelling and differentiated value propositions for C\-suite and senior procurement stakeholders.
* Represents ProcureAbility professionally in client interactions, conferences, webinars, and business development discussions as required.
* May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.


**Management \& Supervisory Responsibilities**
* Typically reports to Management. Direct supervisor job title(s) may include: Manager – Solutions, Senior Manager – Solutions, Director – Solutions, Director – Sales Solutioning, or Head of Solutions.
* This role is generally an individual contributor position but may be required to coordinate workstreams with analysts, consultants, SMEs, delivery teams, or proposal support resources.
* May provide guidance, coaching, review comments, and quality oversight to junior team members supporting proposal development, research, documentation, and CRM updates.
* May lead specific pursuit workstreams, proposal sections, solution development activities, or internal coordination efforts depending on opportunity size and complexity.

 Experience Requirements
   

  

* Minimum of 10 years of experience in procurement consulting, procurement operations, business development, sales solutioning, proposal development, or related professional services roles.
* Experience working in or supporting the procurement consulting or procurement managed services environment.
* Experience supporting US\-based and global clients across different time zones.
* Experience developing proposals, RFx responses, client presentations, sales collateral, and executive\-ready documentation.
* Experience supporting business development, lead qualification, solution design, opportunity pursuit, and sales cycle management.
* Experience in procurement solution areas such as strategic sourcing, category management, procurement operations, supplier management, market intelligence, analytics, digital procurement, or managed services.
* Experience supporting negotiations, contract reviews, scope definition, commercial assumptions, or contract administration is preferred.

**Knowledge Requirements**

* Strong knowledge of procurement consulting and managed services delivery models.
* Ability to understand client procurement challenges and translate them into practical, structured, and differentiated solutions.
* Strong business development mindset with the ability to identify client needs, shape opportunities, and support sales conversion.

* Strong ability to create compelling PowerPoint presentations, solution documents, executive summaries, and RFx responses.

* Self\-starter with strong ownership, initiative, confidence, and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.


 CORE COMPETENCIES

* Proposal and RFx development

* Business development support
* Executive communication
* Storytelling and presentation development
* Stakeholder management
* Active listening and consultative questioning

d1c93eb0.title: Solution Sales Consultant (Account Executive) – US Healthcare SaaS
d1c93eb0.description:
**About HealOS** 




  





 HealOS builds AI agents for US medical practices — AI scribe, front\-desk receptionist, benefit verification, prior authorization, fax/referrals, and billing. Specialty practices across the US run on our agents daily. We're an early\-stage, fast\-growing team, and this is a founding sales hire with direct access to the founders.
 



  





**The Role — Solution Sales Consultant (Account Executive), US Healthcare SaaS** 




 This is not a cold\-calling role. US doctors and practice managers book demos with us proactively. Your job is to run a sharp, credible product demo, handle their questions ("will this work with my EHR?"), and convert them into paying customers. You own the demo\-to\-close journey: pre\-call research, live demo, follow\-ups, and closing — with clean CRM hygiene throughout.
 



  





**Who should apply — this role is built for you if you're currently at:** 



* **Adit, CareStack, or Zenoti** 
 — running demos or closing US SMB/practice accounts
* **Innovaccer, HealthArc, or any health\-tech SaaS** 
 — in SDR/inside\-sales roles, ready to own closing
* **Omega Healthcare, Access Healthcare, AGS Health, GeBBS, CorroHealth, Medusind** 
 or similar RCM companies — in business development / client acquisition selling to US practices
* Clinical backgrounds (BDS/BHMS/BPharm) who've moved into health\-tech sales — we value your credibility with physicians


- 


**What you'll need** 



* 1–4 years selling software or services to US customers on US hours (night shift, IST)
* Excellent spoken English; comfortable demoing to US physicians and practice owners
* US healthcare vocabulary — payers, prior auth, front\-desk workflows, EHRs — or the ability to learn it fast
* Track record of hitting quota in a demo\-heavy or full\-cycle role; CRM discipline



  





**Details:** 
 Full\-time, remote (India), US hours. Competitive fixed pay \+ uncapped incentives tied to closed revenue. Hiring process: short async assignment (mock demo) → interview with founders → offer. We hire on demonstrated work.

2039fb27.title: Solution Architect
2039fb27.description:
**Life at UiPath**
 The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category\-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.
   

  

 To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self\-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast\-moving, fast\-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.
   

  

 Could that be you?
   

  

**Your mission**
 As a
 **Solution Architect** 
 you work with businesses and Partners to help them leverage full potential of UiPath Automation Platform. You would involve in Designing, Developing, Testing and Building world class robots that impacts revenue growth, operational efficiencies, customer/Employee satisfaction of our end customers. You will be part of a group of elite Developers in UiPath Professional Services and will lead a team of Automation developers.
   

  

**What You'll Do At UiPath**
* Design, code and test automation workflows using UiPath Automation Platform.
* Develop a stable/reusable and scalable Automation solution design using UiPath.
* Decide on the development methodologies and best practices.
* Verifying and leveraging appropriate UiPath components from UiPath Product Suite.
* Provide solution designs to customers throughout the deployment of new deals, during POCs (Proof of Concept) and project implementation phase.
* Oversee the development of the automation projects and components according to the solution design and requirements.
* Oversee the testing, deployment, hyper care, and monitoring stages.
* Review the crucial pieces of code and facilitate knowledge transfer in the project team.
* Develop workflows and custom activities using C\#/.NET, with Python for custom coded workflows.
* Design and deliver agentic automation solutions using UiPath Agent Builder, Maestro (agentic orchestration), and Autopilot.
* Leverage AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and OpenAI Codex to accelerate solution design, development, code reviews, and documentation.
* Responsible for the overall testing cycles
* Deliver technical training, demos, and blueprints and provide necessary support for new/existing clients.
* Mentor budding Developers and Architects.


**What You'll Bring To The Team**
* Graduate/Postgraduate in Computer Science/IT or equivalent Degree.
* 10\+ years of experience in the IT industry with code development background.
* Minimum of 4 years of experience in developing and implementing automation workflows in UiPath.
* Experience leading a Team is a Plus.
* Strong technical skills on UiPath, and end to end UiPath Product Suite.
* Understanding of workflow\-based logic and hands on experience with RE\-framework,
* Orchestration Framework and DU (Document Understanding) Framework.
* Working knowledge of UiPath IXP / Document Understanding, Computer Vision, and Action Center
* Experience working with Mainframe Automation, SAP Automation or Citrix Automation is a plus.
* Experience working with other RPA tools is a plus.
* UiPath Automation Solution Architect Professional certified are preferred.
* Excellent communication skills are a must.
* Strong programming/scripting knowledge in C\#, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript is a must
* Knowledge in cognitive automation with OCR (Optical Character Recognition) tools, AI/ML skills is a plus.
* Understanding UiPath Infrastructure requirements is a plus.
* Experience Working with Test Suite, Apps, Insights is a plus.
* Hands\-on understanding of Generative AI and UiPath agentic automation – Agent Builder, Maestro (agentic orchestration), Autopilot, AI Trust Layer, and Context Grounding.
* Hands\-on experience with AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Claude Cowork, OpenAI Codex, or GitHub Copilot is a plus.
* Familiarity with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI), prompt engineering, and agent frameworks / Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a plus.
* Understanding of Cloud services like Azure/AWS/GCP is a plus


 Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.
   

  

 Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office\-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.
   

  

 We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

* Own pre\-call discovery: prospect's EHR, clearinghouse, payer mix, call volume — and write a fit assessment before anything is promised
* Answer security and compliance questions (HIPAA, BAA, SOC 2, data handling) confidently, without escalating to founders
* Feed lost\-deal technical objections back to product every week



  





**How we'll measure you** 



* Demo → pilot/close conversion rate
* Demo incident rate (broken flows, wrong data, dead air) — target zero
* % of demos that convert without a founder in the room



  





**What you'll need** 



* **Exceptional spoken English** 
 — you'll present live to US physicians and practice owners daily; skeptical clinical buyers must find you credible. This is a hard requirement and the first thing we screen. (Your first interview round is a live mock demo in English.)
* 2\+ years in a solutions engineering, sales engineering, product demo, or implementation role at a healthcare SaaS / health\-tech company — RCM or practice\-operations background strongly preferred over generic SaaS
* Working knowledge of US healthcare: EHRs, payers, prior authorization, clearinghouses — or demonstrated ability to master domain vocabulary fast
* Comfortable with technical Q\&A: integrations, APIs at a conceptual level, security/compliance
* Willing to work US business hours (night shift, IST) consistently



  





**Who should apply:** 
 solutions/sales engineers and senior implementation folks from athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, Veradigm, NextGen, Innovaccer, CitiusTech, Adit, CareStack — or RCM leaders from Omega, Access Healthcare, AGS Health who can demo, not just operate.
 



  





**Details:** 
 Full\-time, remote (India), US hours. Competitive fixed \+ variable tied to demo conversion. Hiring process: async assignment (10\-min recorded demo walkthrough \+ written fit assessment \+ objection responses) → interview with founders → offer. We hire on demonstrated work.

a4bcc859.title: Solutions Architect , AGS India Public Sector
a4bcc859.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.  

  

This job opening is for a Solutions Architect role within the public sector team of AWS, India. We work with the central government ministries, state and local governments, public sector units, education institutions, EdTechs, nonprofits, and healthcare. Our vision is to help public institutions in India to make a significant impact to the lives of citizens, by taking a technology generation leap through use of AWS cloud services within the domains of Skilling, Smart Infrastructure, Healthcare and Inclusion (Physical, Digital and Financial).  

  

As a solutions architect you will provide a consistent approach for customers and partners to evaluate architectures, and implement designs that will scale over time based on five pillars of the AWS Well\-Architected Framework — operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization.  

  

Diverse Experiences  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship and Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

This job opening is for a Solutions Architect role within the public sector team of AWS, India. We work with the central government ministries, state and local governments, public sector units, education institutions, EdTechs, nonprofits, and healthcare. Our vision is to help public institutions in India to make a significant impact to the lives of citizens, by taking a technology generation leap through use of AWS cloud services within the domains of Skilling, Smart Infrastructure, Healthcare and Inclusion (Physical, Digital and Financial).  

We are known for our unwavering customer obsession. Our solutions architecture teams are on the front line of helping customers succeed using AWS technologies. Our team members leverage their deep knowledge of AWS technologies in collaboration with our sales and partner teams to impact how solutions are proposed, architected and implemented for clients. Helping make customer success a reality and seeing the impact in real\-time drives our teams to explore new frontiers in leveraging AWS cloud for both commercial and public sector organizations.  

If you have worked with Amazon Web Services technologies or have AWS certifications you would like to leverage, we will help you maximize the impact of your skills and knowledge.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 13\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 10\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* 6\+ years of responding to requests for proposals (e.g., determining requirements, matching requirements to technical approach and solutions, developing solutions against requirements) experience
* Experience working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Knowledge of SAP systems (like SAP Business Suite, S/4HANA, SAP Business Warehouse, SAP HANA, SAP Business Objects, etc.) and their architecture and infrastructure needs
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* Experience managing relationships with SAP customers and partners
* Experience in SAP S/4HANA, SAP Cloud Platform, SAP Cloud ERP and Cloud ERP Private
* Experience in SAP clean core design concepts, including design and build using non\-SAP technologies in domains such as Generative / Agentic AI, and data \& analytics

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

8591c2b1.description:
**Overview**
 With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer Experience and Success (CE\&S) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. We drive cross\-company alignment and execution, ensuring that we consistently exceed customers’ expectations in every interaction, whether in\-product, digital, or human\-centered. CE\&S is responsible for all up services across the company, including consulting, customer success, and support across Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions and products. Join CE\&S and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world.
   

  

 The Global Customer Success (GCS) organization, an organization within CE\&S, is leading the effort to enable customer success on the Microsoft Cloud by harnessing leading, AI\-powered capabilities and human expertise to deliver innovation solutions that accelerate business value, drive operational excellence and nurture long term loyalty.
   

  

 We are looking for a Global Solution Architect (GSA) manager, specializing in AI Business Solutions, who is passionate about driving our customers’ AI transformation on the Microsoft platform. This role will be part of the Customer Success AI Business Solutions team and is designed to engage in the execution of consumption within key accounts.
   

  

 The ABS GSA Manager is a senior people and business leader responsible for driving AI innovation, incubation, and scale across strategic customers. This role leads a team of GSAs (incl Early in Career GSAs) and works in close partnership with Sales, CSAMs, and global peers to validate AI scenarios, shape repeatable offerings, and accelerate platform wins across Microsoft’s AI stack.
   

  

 This is a high impact leadership role requiring strong execution, cross group influence, and the ability to operate effectively across multiple countries, cultures, and time zones.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 People Leadership
   

  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of GSAs across multiple countries
* Build a high performing, inclusive team with strong technical depth and customer empathy
* Drive clarity on priorities, capacity, and role expectations across geographies
* Partner with Global and Regional leaders on talent planning, hiring, and succession


 Business \& Delivery Leadership
   

  

* Own ABS GSA execution across strategic accounts and priority initiatives \- lead the Digital Copilot and Agents Accelerator initiative for your geo
* Ensure customer engagements align to ABS objectives: Win the Platform, Agents for All, and scale innovation
* Balance hands on customer engagement with effective delegation and team empowerment
* Act as a senior escalation and decision point for complex customer scenarios


 Innovation \& Incubation
   

  

* Lead the incubation and validation of AI and agent based scenarios
* Partner with global IP, Product, and Engineering teams to shape scalable offerings
* Ensure learnings are captured and fed back into global solutions and playbooks
* Drive reuse, standardization, and repeatability across customer engagements


 Cross Group Collaboration
   

  

* Work closely with Sales, CSAMs, and Business Value teams to align execution
* Partner with other GSA leaders globally to ensure consistency and leverage global best practices


**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications:
   

  

 Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 10\+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience. 7\+ years people management experience, including managing consultant practice managers, technical sales managers, and/or technical architect managers.
   

  

**Additional Preferred Qualifications**
* Proven experience leading senior technical or solution architecture teams in a matrixed environment
* Strong background in enterprise technology, cloud, or AI led transformation
* Demonstrated ability to lead across multiple countries and cultures
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills
* Track record of driving clarity, focus, and results in complex environments


 Leadership Expectations
   

  

* Models Microsoft culture, values, and leadership principles
* Creates clarity and focus in ambiguous, fast moving environments
* Builds trust with customers and internal partners
* Develops future leaders and invests in long term capability building
* Balances short term execution with long term strategic impact
* Experience with Microsoft platform technologies (Azure, Copilot, agents, data, M365\)
* Prior experience in customer facing roles (architecture, consulting, delivery, or technical sales)
* Experience building or scaling innovation programs or technical incubation models


 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about

People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.
   

  

**We are looking for: Software Architect**

219733d1.title: IT Architect
219733d1.description:
Imaging Endpoints (IE) is an Imaging Technology and Imaging Clinical Research Organization (iCRO). We are passionately focused on our vision to
 *Connect Imaging to the CureTM* 
 . Everything we do is aligned with this singular purpose. We work every day excited to advance imaging science, technology, and services to bring curative technologies to humankind. We have supported many of the most impactful new drug approvals in oncology, and we are seeking the most talented individuals globally that are passionate in their desire to assist us in our mission to customize each clinical trial’s imaging to optimize the opportunity to demonstrate efficacy.
 



  





 Imaging Endpoints is based in Scottsdale, Arizona, with offices in Cambridge, Massachusetts; London, UK; Leiden, Netherlands; Basel, Switzerland; Hyderabad, India and Shanghai, China. We are an affiliate of HonorHealth, one of the largest healthcare systems nationally, and Scottsdale Medical Imaging Limited (SMIL/RadPartners), the largest private radiology group in the United States. We are recognized as the world’s largest and most preeminent iCRO in oncology.
 



  





 The IT Solution / Enterprise Architect translates business needs, operational challenges, and strategic objectives into secure, scalable, and cost\-effective technology solutions. This role collaborates with business stakeholders, IT teams, security, vendors, and leadership to develop technology roadmaps, solution designs, integration strategies, and implementation plans aligned with company policies, industry best practices, regulatory requirements, and digital transformation goals.
 



 The architect provides leadership across infrastructure, cloud, enterprise applications, data, security, and integration domains by evaluating current\-state technology, defining future\-state architecture, guiding solution delivery, and ensuring solutions are secure, reliable, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business objectives.
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES**



* **Solution Design and Implementation** 
 : Analyze business requirements, workflows, risks, and constraints to design secure, scalable, interoperable, and supportable technology solutions.
* **IT Architecture Governance and Standards** 
 : Define, maintain, and enforce architecture standards, reference designs, documentation expectations, and technology governance controls.
* **Cloud, Infrastructure, and Application Architecture** 
 : Support architecture across infrastructure, cloud platforms, PaaS, SaaS, virtual desktop technologies, enterprise applications, databases, integrations, and medical imaging\-related systems.
* **Security, Compliance, and Risk Management** 
 : Collaborate with IT security, compliance, and operations teams to address cybersecurity, data protection, availability, resiliency, and business continuity requirements.
* **System Optimization and Problem Management** 
 : Assess systems, configurations, monitoring, workflows, and support processes to reduce complexity, eliminate redundancy, improve reliability, and optimize cost.
* **Technical Leadership and Delivery Guidance** 
 : Guide engineering, infrastructure, application, security, and support teams throughout design, implementation, validation, release, and operational transition.
* **Documentation and Knowledge Management** 
 : Ensure architecture diagrams, solution designs, installation guides, operational procedures, support models, risk assessments, and technical documentation remain complete, accurate, and current.



  





**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**



* **Experience** 
 : Requires 18\+ years of progressive information technology experience, including technology implementation, enterprise application delivery, infrastructure and cloud architecture, solution design, system integration, vendor coordination, and technology operations management.
* **Leadership and Delivery Experience** 
 : Experience should include leading or supporting complex technology rollouts, modernization initiatives, security\-conscious solution design, and cross\-functional collaboration with business, IT, compliance, and vendor stakeholders.
* **Education** 
 : Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline is preferred. A
 **bachelor’s degree** 
 in a relevant technical field with equivalent enterprise architecture, solution architecture, cloud, infrastructure, or application delivery experience may also be considered.
* **Certifications** 
 : Relevant professional certifications in AWS, Microsoft Azure, Citrix, Cybersecurity, ITIL, or enterprise architecture frameworks are strongly preferred.



  





**TECHNICAL SKILLS**



* **Cloud Platforms \& Services:** 
 Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, PaaS, SaaS, cloud architecture, migration, cost optimization, and secure cloud solutions.
* **Infrastructure \& Virtualization:** 
 Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure, servers, storage, networking, virtualization, disaster recovery, high availability, Citrix, and Azure Virtual Desktop.
* **Enterprise Applications \& Integrations:** 
 Experience with enterprise applications, modernization, system integrations, APIs, middleware, workflow automation, and application dependencies across infrastructure and security layers.
* **Database \& Data Management:** 
 Knowledge of SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, database architecture, data modeling, reporting, and data visualization concepts.
* **Security \& Compliance:** 
 Understanding of cybersecurity, IAM, data protection, risk assessment, vulnerability management, regulatory compliance, and secure solution design.
* **Architecture Documentation:** 
 Ability to create architecture diagrams, solution designs, technical specifications, implementation plans, operational procedures, and support documentation.
* **IT Service Management \& Governance:** 
 Familiarity with ITIL practices, change management, incident/problem management, service transition, architecture governance, technical standards, and operational controls (preferred).
* **Financial \& Vendor Management:** 
 Experience evaluating technology costs, licensing models, vendor solutions, TCO, budgeting, and cost optimization opportunities (preferred).
* **Domain Knowledge:** 
 Experience with DICOM and imaging applications preferred.



  





**SOFT SKILLS**



* **Executive Communication:** 
 Ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively with business leaders, technical teams, vendors, and stakeholders.
* **Strategic \& Analytical Thinking:** 
 Ability to assess business needs, evaluate technology options, identify risks, and recommend practical solutions.
* **Problem Solving \& Decision\-Making:** 
 Ability to analyze complex issues, identify root causes, evaluate trade\-offs, and make informed decisions.
* **Leadership \& Influence:** 
 Ability to lead through influence, align teams, guide technical decisions, and promote architecture standards.
* **Organization \& Presentation Skills:** 
 Ability to manage priorities, prepare presentations, facilitate discussions, and communicate risks, decisions, and recommendations.
* **Stakeholder \& Vendor Management:** 
 Strong collaboration skills with business teams, IT, security, compliance, partners, and vendors to align expectations and deliverables.
* **Documentation Skills:** 
 Ability to create clear and structured architecture documents, technical specifications, procedures, decision records, and implementation plans.
* **Continuous Improvement Mindset:** 
 Focus on process improvement, technology simplification, risk reduction, and service quality enhancement.



  





**SKILLS**



* Strong understanding of DLP concepts, policies, and technologies, including DLP solutions from leading vendors.
* In\-depth knowledge of Microsoft 365 suite, including Azure AD, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and associated security controls.
* Strong understanding of ISO 27001 implementation and auditing
* Strong understanding of PAM solutions
* Good understanding of AWS network security concepts
* Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to data privacy and protection (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS).
* Experience with security incident response, threat intelligence, and vulnerability management processes.
* Flexible to work in shifts to provide round\-the\-clock security coverage, including nights, weekends, and holidays (On demand).
* Proficient in analyzing security logs, identifying anomalies, and responding to security incidents effectively.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to think critically in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey complex security concepts to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.



  





**IMAGING ENDPOINTS’ TEAM CHARACTERISTICS**



* Passion to
 *Connect Imaging to the CureTM* 
 and pursue a meaningful career by improving the lives of cancer patients through imaging.
* Strong desire to be part of a dynamic, global team working closely together and growing year after year in a rewarding environment to help humanity through imaging.
* Commitment and caring for our fellow team members, their families, and the communities IE serves \- see more information about Caring Endpoints at https://caringendpoints.org/.
* Integrity and high ethical standards; we always do the right thing.
* High intellect and ingenuity; we enjoy solving problems, finding a better way, and the challenge of making a difference by improving lives.
* Structured, organized, detail\-oriented, and self\-motivated; we approach each day with a detailed plan and excitement to accomplish the day’s objectives while striving to improve ourselves and IE.
* Accountable; we do what we say and communicative effectively to meet deadlines; we enjoy advancing clinical trials, helping patients, and celebrating success.
* High standard for excellence; we proof our own work, hold high standards for ourselves and our team, and always prioritize quality above all else.



  





**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**




 While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms and talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to sit. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, ability to adjust focus.

**Description**
 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Database Specialist Solution Architect to join the India WWSO Specialists team and help customers modernize their database estates on AWS. In this role, you will be the hands\-on technical expert who works directly with customers to plan, design, and execute database migrations \- moving workloads from commercial databases like Oracle and SQL Server to AWS purpose\-built databases including Amazon Aurora, Amazon DynamoDB, and Amazon RDS.
   

  

 You will engage across the full migration lifecycle: from discovery and schema assessment through proof\-of\-concept validation and production cutover planning. This is a deeply technical, customer\-facing role for someone who thrives on solving complex database challenges and enabling customers to achieve better performance, scalability, and cost efficiency on AWS.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Engage with customers to assess existing database environments, identify migration candidates, and recommend target AWS database services.
   

  

* Design database migration architectures using AWS DMS, Schema Conversion Tool (SCT), and native replication approaches.
* Conduct hands\-on proof\-of\-concept engagements demonstrating performance, compatibility, and operational benefits of AWS databases.
* Provide technical guidance on schema conversion, stored procedure refactoring, and application compatibility for Oracle/SQL Server to Aurora/RDS/DynamoDB migrations.
* Develop migration runbooks, cutover plans, and rollback strategies for production database migrations.
* Support competitive technical evaluations against Oracle, SQL Server, and other cloud database offerings.
* Collaborate with Database Sales Specialists to qualify opportunities and accelerate deal closure through technical validation.
* Create and deliver technical workshops, immersion days, and enablement sessions for customers and partners.
* Contribute to the development of reusable migration tools, scripts, and best\-practice documentation.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 2\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working within software development or Internet\-related industries
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

8a2c0ee1.title: Delivery Lead
8a2c0ee1.description:
HMH is a learning technology company committed to delivering connected solutions that engage learners, empower educators and improve student outcomes. As a leading provider of K–12 core curriculum, supplemental and intervention solutions, and professional learning services, HMH partners with educators and school districts to uncover solutions that unlock students’ potential and extend teachers’ capabilities.
   

  

 HMH serves more than 50 million students and 4 million educators in 150 countries. For more information, visit www.hmhco.com
   

  

 As a Delivery Lead, you will drive end\-to\-end project execution across multiple Agile teams, enabling the delivery of high\-impact, complex solutions. You will be responsible for ensuring alignment, removing obstacles, and maintaining a clear path to value delivery. You are a seasoned leader who understands both the technical and business landscapes and can bridge the gap between strategy and execution.
   

  

 You’ll work across cross\-functional teams, supporting not just Agile practices but also full lifecycle project delivery—from planning and tracking to stakeholder management and release execution. Experience in handling AI or machine learning\-based projects is a plus.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead two or more Agile teams in delivering complex, end\-to\-end technology solutions
* Collaborate across product, engineering, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment with goals and priorities
* Provide delivery leadership across the entire project lifecycle—from initial planning, backlog grooming, and sprint execution, to release planning and post\-delivery retrospectives
* Foster a high\-performance environment through mentoring, coaching, and supporting team growth and innovation
* Identify and resolve cross\-team dependencies and risks early, keeping delivery on track
* Use data and delivery metrics (e.g., velocity, burndown, throughput) to drive transparency and predictability
* Effectively communicate project status, blockers, and progress to stakeholders at all levels
* Champion a “Quality First” approach and promote continuous improvement within and across teams
* Handle shifting business priorities and navigate conflicting demands with calm, focused leadership
* Encourage creative problem\-solving and challenge short\-term thinking in favor of long\-term value
* Bring structure and direction to highly complex and ambiguous problem spaces
* Cultivate a delivery culture of accountability, ownership, and measurable outcomes
* Contribute to broader organizational improvements by identifying process and structure enhancements across teams
* (Nice to have): Experience delivering AI/ML projects or working closely with data science/AI teams


**Skills \& Experience**
* 5\-8 years of experience leading software development and product delivery teams
* Proven success managing end\-to\-end delivery of complex technical projects—not just as a Scrum Master or Agile coach, but with full ownership over planning, tracking, and stakeholder engagement
* Experience working with multiple cross\-functional Agile teams in a scaled environment
* Strong command of Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence)
* Experience in navigating business priorities and influencing stakeholders to achieve project goals
* Excellent communication (written, verbal, and presentation) and interpersonal skills
* Ability to build trust, support team dynamics, and encourage high performance
* Knowledge of the education technology (K–12\) sector and user needs of educators, students, and administrators (preferred)
* High attention to detail and a bias for action
* Comfortable making tough decisions and asking for support when needed


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in education, business, or technical discipline
* Agile Scrum Master Certification


 The Information Technology organization is transforming to realize our mission: Become a leader in HMH’s digital transformation, and as a strategic partner, innovate and deliver highest value, competitive advantage solutions across all corporate and business functions. Our ambition is to be a digital leader through innovation and develop and deliver leading edge technology such as robotic process automation and artificial intelligence to solve some of HMH’s greatest operational business challenges. Our professionals will have business relevant skills to connect our HMH partners to technologies that propel the businesses to deliver the greatest value for HMH and our customers.
   

  

 We are building a team of IT professionals with an insatiable appetite to learn, a relentless focus on customer service, a technological curiosity toward future possibilities, and a creativity in solving business challenges with leading technologies. Our team will find ways to work together, create a sense of community where it’s safe to take risks and learn together, develop our careers, and all have an opportunity to work on new technologies. We will work together, learn together and have fun together. As a team, we will lead HMH’s digital transformation.

2ee17b76.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
2ee17b76.description:
Instrumental builds the manufacturing acceleration platform behind the world’s most complex electronics. We capture digital exhaust and engineering context from assembly lines—images, test logs, BOM data, performance, repair cycles—and our AI engines identify insights that are difficult or impossible for human engineers to find. We accelerate the companies building the AI era by improving manufacturing yield, throughput, and ramp. NVIDIA, Meta, L3Harris, and their manufacturing partners rely on Instrumental to accelerate new product introduction and production.
   

  

 Instrumental is seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager to lead and service strategic customer programs across Taiwan (and partner with our team in China to deliver solutions for Vietnam and other APAC regions as needed). As our sole on\-the\-ground representative, you will work directly with customers and contract manufacturers (CMs) to integrate, optimize, and expand Instrumental’s AI\-powered manufacturing solutions. This is a high\-impact, customer\-facing engineering role supporting some of our fastest\-growing accounts during a period of rapid company growth.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a seasoned professional with a background in manufacturing design, automation, or technical program management — someone who thrives at the intersection of engineering excellence and customer engagement. You’ll have the autonomy to drive outcomes while collaborating with a global team to ensure customers achieve transformative value.
   

  

 Come join our team if you are passionate about improving electronics manufacturing, love working with a global team, and are energized when traveling to factories across Taiwan, Asia Pacific, and the world. The ideal candidate is multi\-faceted, technically savvy, organized, and deeply customer\-oriented.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Own end\-to\-end program delivery for strategic accounts. In this role, you’ll travel to customer factory sites to accomplish company\-critical missions, such as deploying Instrumental hardware/software into manufacturing environments and accelerating customer “time to value” by hand\-tuning Instrumental algorithms and software. You’ll have support from our global team, but will be accountable for program success.
* Build relationships with customers and factory stakeholders. While on\-site, you’ll build rapport with the various stakeholders who are critical to Instrumental’s success and pave the way for further adoption. You’ll leverage these relationships to complete your missions quickly and effectively. You’ll cement a strong technical and dependable reputation for yourself and Instrumental at large.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams across time zones to resolve challenges. Act as the central point of communication between engineering, product, and customer teams worldwide, ensuring alignment and timely resolution of technical or operational issues. By bridging time zones and disciplines, you’ll keep projects moving forward smoothly and develop customer confidence in Instrumental’s solutions.
* Leverage Instrumental’s software to drive value. You’ll quickly become an expert in Instrumental’s software and technology, including many non\-customer\-facing functionalities. This will enable you to quickly identify how to get the most performance out of the system – whether that’s by making a physical tweak in the real world, adding training labels, or replicating customer tests. You’ll use your engineer’s understanding of how our customers derive value to rapidly achieve results.


**What You Have**
* Experience getting things done in electronics factories. 5\+ years of professional experience in electronics manufacturing, doing engineering or operations – either on the “brand” or EMS side. You understand factory environments, processes, and politics and can leverage that expertise to get things done quickly.
* Demonstrated ability to complete missions. You can share countless stories of mission ownership and completion, where you were able to deliver despite unforeseen or challenging circumstances. You love the idea of applying your diverse engineering and operations skillsets to critical company missions.
* Love the factory floor more than an office. This role is based out of a customer factory site. You will also be expected to travel to other factory sites on a regular basis, including transiting in the evenings and on weekends.
* Strong relationship\-building skills. You naturally develop trust and rapport with customers, suppliers, and partners. You enjoy representing the company externally, aren’t afraid to tactfully challenge those in senior positions, and foster long\-term, collaborative relationships that help drive mutual success.
* Excellent written and spoken English communication. This role will require rapid and effective communication with a variety of global stakeholders, representing Instrumental with our most important customers.
* Project Management. Excellent hands\-on experience', and 'strong execution and follow\-up project schedule and assigned tasks
* Bonus. Mandarin Speaking


 You’re encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn’t precisely match the job description.
   

  

 At Instrumental, protecting company and customer information is a shared responsibility. All employees are expected to comply with company security and privacy policies and promptly report suspected security incidents or policy violations.

 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as project management discipline, risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking.
   

  

 This role is for Pune Location.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To manage the efficient delivery of large\-scale technical projects and capabilities across the bank and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand their needs and expectations throughout the software product lifecycle, adhering to agreed time, budget and quality requirements.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Management of the delivery, resource allocation and improvement of complex technical project capabilities across the bank using Agile/Scrum methodologies for planning, stand\-ups, demos, retrospectives and the execution of sprints.

They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

**Description**
 Scope of Work
   

  

 The Technical program Manager will be responsible for a variety of innovative projects, including but not limited to:
   

  

 Initiatives focused on improving large\-scale data ingestion and processing systems.
   

  

 Projects centered on extracting, structuring, and validating information from unstructured and semi\-structured digital content.
   

  

 Programs designed to ensure high levels of data accuracy and quality for consumer\-facing web applications, particularly in the travel and e\-commerce sectors.
   

  

 Supporting the creation and maintenance of large\-scale knowledge bases that provide intuitive and visually appealing information to users.
   

  

 Overseeing quality assurance and automation initiatives to drive efficiency and reliability.
   

  

**Requirements**
 GlobalLogic is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Technical program Manager to lead a dynamic portfolio of technical projects. This individual will be responsible for overseeing a diverse set of initiatives at the forefront of data processing and web technologies. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, exceptional leadership skills, and a proven track record of managing complex operations in a fast\-paced environment. A key requirement for this role is excellent communication skills, as you will be the central point of contact for multiple stakeholders, including clients, engineering teams, and senior management.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Proven Experience: A minimum of 10 years of experience in a technical operations or project management role, with at least 3 years in a managerial capacity.
   

  

 Mandatory Technical Skills: Strong, hands\-on proficiency with Regular Expressions, HTML, and JavaScript is required.
   

  

 Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of web crawling, data parsing, quality assurance, and project management methodologies. Familiarity with technologies like Python and SQL is a plus.
   

  

 Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to lead and motivate a diverse team of technical professionals.
   

  

 Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills are a strict mandate. The ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences is essential.
   

  

 Analytical and Problem\-Solving Skills: A data\-driven approach to problem\-solving and a demonstrated ability to make sound decisions under pressure.
   

  

 Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders at all levels.
   

  

 Financial Acumen: Experience with budget management, forecasting, and financial reporting.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

 The Technical Program Manager will be expected to:
   

  

  

* Project Leadership \& Delivery: Oversee the successful execution of all assigned projects, ensuring timely delivery and high\-quality outcomes.
* Team Management: Lead and mentor a team of technical professionals, including software engineers, analysts, and project leads, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Technical Oversight: Provide technical guidance on projects involving large\-scale data extraction, data parsing, process automation, and quality assurance.
* Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for all project\-related communications, ensuring clear and consistent updates to both internal and external stakeholders.
* Process Optimization: Continuously evaluate and improve operational processes to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve the overall quality of project deliverables.
* Financial Management: Manage project budgets, forecasts, and resource allocation to ensure projects are delivered within budget and financial targets are met.
* Recruitment \& Onboarding: Participate in the hiring and onboarding of new team members, ensuring that the team has the necessary skills and expertise to meet project goals.


 What we offer

 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.

 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.

 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.

Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

**Job Description**
 Join a team shaping the future of data management and governance at JPMorganChase. Lead transformative initiatives and grow your career.
   

  

 As a Strategic Program Manager at JPMorganChase within the CDO Strategy and Execution team, you will deliver new and enhanced products, solutions, operating models, and processes aligned to data across the Firm. You will coordinate strategic initiatives from initiation to completion, partnering with Product and Technology teams and engaging stakeholders. Your role is critical in modernizing data management and governance practices and meeting regulatory commitments. You will help foster a collaborative and innovative team culture.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Lead strategic change initiatives with stakeholders across Product, Technology, lines of business, corporate functions, and external partners
* Gather, synthesize, and prioritize requirements from lines of business, corporate functions, and firmwide stakeholders
* Partner with Product and Technology to design solutions, define product roadmaps, and deliverables
* Support business case development and funding acquisition for strategic programs
* Provide governance and oversight, ensure stakeholder engagement and alignment, and deliver status updates
* Identify and escalate potential roadblocks and emerging risks
* Establish and drive PMO capabilities for large programs, ensuring effective governance, reporting, and stakeholder management
* Develop and implement standardized project management processes, tools, and templates for consistency and efficiency
* Develop and maintain program reporting and metrics, and communicate progress to senior executives
* Coach team members and contribute to broader group objectives

* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and driving organizational change through new capabilities, products, or solutions
* Expertise in program governance and advanced project management methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall) with hands\-on experience in enterprise planning, execution, and tracking tools
* Proven ability to manage tight timelines and multiple high\-impact deliverables with strong prioritization and risk management skills
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and influencing skills with ability to drive alignment across senior stakeholders and executive leadership
* Demonstrated adaptability, resilience, and customer\-centric mindset with ability to navigate ambiguity and changing priorities
* Skilled in management and status reporting, delivering clear, actionable messages and insights to leadership and steering committees
* Ability to identify process improvement opportunities and implement best practices to strengthen execution and team effectiveness
* Proactive self\-starter with strong problem\-solving orientation and ability to address diverse, cross\-functional challenges
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Microsoft Project, and other project management tools
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* Experience in a data and analytics organization with understanding of data and analytics processes and data governance practices
* Familiarity with data lineage, classification, and lifecycle management concepts
* Technical understanding of data management, governance, big data platforms, and data architecture
* Familiarity with program management and collaboration tools such as Monday.com, Jira, Confluence, Tableau, Alteryx, or similar platforms
* MBA and/or advanced degree from a top\-tier program

Morgan and Chase brands.  We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.
   

  

 The Strategy team manages mission\-critical projects ranging from developing growth strategies, to assessing and planning entry into new markets, to implementing organizational restructurings and operational efficiencies, and more. Projects are typically team\-based and include close collaboration with senior executives.

f8ca799b.title: Presales Solutions Architect - ServiceNow
f8ca799b.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.

At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.

***We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.***  

Become a thought leader and team member of an established and growing Elite ServiceNow partner. Being part of an elite team, you will take your career to the next level. Members of our Intelligent Operations team have the opportunity to work within our ServiceNow practice and enhance their skill set, by learning and leveraging not only ServiceNow but the other technology partners in our portfolio. This allows our team to develop the proper solutions to meet our customer’s desired business outcomes.

Our customers may be new to the ServiceNow platform, replacing an existing solution, have extended ServiceNow solutions or created high\-value business processes using the ServiceNow platform, to support their journey towards digital transformation. The ideal candidate is an independent, self\-driven thought leader, who enjoys interfacing with customers and desires to drive innovative business solutions by applying their technical and business skills.
This role partners with sales, delivery, solution engineering peers, to achieve customer success, through thought leadership and driving awareness. The role takes a consultative approach with our customers and prospects to discover and map business outcome\-driven solutions. The role also may require demonstration and prototyping of platform capabilities and in select cases identify the specific requirements needed to develop innovative application prototypes. The Senior ServiceNow Pre\-Sales Solutions Engineer will also provide solutions and enablement to the technical salesforce and provide prospective customers with product and solution advice during pre\-sales discussions.
### **Responsibilities:**

* Drive innovative business solutions and digital transformation with our customers
* Consult with customers and prospects to understand their needs and pain\-points and evangelize the business value of the ServiceNow platform.
* Architect solutions on the ServiceNow platform both independently and collaboratively
* Demonstrate live to customers and prospects the ServiceNow platform highlighting it’s features and functionality
* Conduct business process and/or technical workshops that may include enablement sessions.
* Interact with the ServiceNow community as a thought leader on solutioning on the ServiceNow platform
* Interface with customers, sales, and delivery teams to translate business challenges into requirements and deliverables.
* Thrive in a fast paced growing company
* Develop documentation, pricing and statements of work for customers
* Learn other technologies from a high level that may integrate with ServiceNow to produce a holistic outcome
* Obtain and maintain pre\-sales ServiceNow certifications for the different product lines available
### **Qualifications:**

* 7\+ years experience as a solution/sales engineer or a consultant for a software company
* College degree (or equivalent experience) in the fields of Software Engineering, Computer Sciences, or related discipline
* Strong functional knowledge of the ServiceNow platform across multiple modules
* ITIL Foundations v3 or higher certification and/or working knowledge of ITIL concepts.
* Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodology.
* Passion for problem\-solving to solution selling
* Knowledge of web development or mobile app development, business modeling, database concepts and project management – preferably using Agile Development Methodologies
* Exceptional oral, written and presentation skills, with ability to organize and present technical material in an easily understood manner
* Deep insight on technical architectures, IT products and product positioning
* ServiceNow certifications and accreditations are strongly desired
* Experience on other SaaS platforms such as: Tanium, Atlassian, Big Panda, Splunk, Data Dog, Logic Monitor etc. a plus
* Understanding of JavaScript, HTML and libraries/frameworks such AngularJS, jQuery, Prototype and bootstrap fundamentals a plus
* Experience with monitoring solutions, end point collection, IoT, machine learning and other emerging technologies a plus
* Understanding of web services (e.g. SOAP, REST, WSDL, XML) a plus
**Why AHEAD:**

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.

We fuel growth by stacking our office with top\-notch technologies in a multi\-million\-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

**India Employment Benefits include:**
**Comprehensive health insurance** coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents
**Paid time off and company holidays**, along with additional leave benefits as per policy
**Flexible work arrangements**, supporting work\-life balance
**Learning and development opportunities** to support continuous growth and upskilling
**Employee wellness initiatives** and programs focused on physical and mental well\-being
**Retirement and statutory benefits** in line with India regulations
**Inclusive and people\-first culture**, with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
