a5881a34.title: SOLUTION CONSULTANT - PLANNING
a5881a34.description:
**About Impact Analytics**
 Impact Analytics is an agentic\-first AI software company transforming retail merchandising through cutting\-edge AI, LLMs, and Generative AI technologies. As a fast\-growing Series D company with deployments across five continents, it is building both industry\-leading merchandising solutions and foundational AI agents that are redefining how retail decisions are made. What makes Impact Analytics unique is its combination of deep retail domain expertise, strong innovation culture, and global presence. It is one of the few India\-born AI companies recognized globally by organizations like Fortune, Gartner, and the Inc. 5000\.
   

  

 For candidates looking to work on next\-generation AI products with global scale and real\-world impact, Impact Analytics is an exciting place to build your career. Here’s a link to our website: www.impactanalytics.co.
   

  

**The impact that you will be making**
 In this role, you will help retail and CPG customers optimize their merchandising financial plans and assortment processes through scalable SaaS solutions that drive measurable business impact. You will partner with customers and cross\-functional teams to translate business needs into effective, scalable solution designs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**What lands you in this role**
* Develop strong breadth and depth across Impact Analytics planning solutions, including PlanSmart, AssortSmart, and ItemSmart, and articulate how each solution supports customer business objectives.
* Independently lead discovery and design workshops with customer business and functional stakeholders to understand current\-state processes, pain points, decision flows, and operational constraints.
* Translate customer As\-Is processes into clear To\-Be workflows within the product, aligning business needs with platform capabilities and best practices.
* Ask the right diagnostic and probing questions to uncover requirements, edge cases, dependencies, and decision criteria needed to shape an optimal solution.
* Evaluate and communicate trade\-offs between flow simplicity, user experience, scalability, configurability, and engineering effort while recommending the most practical path forward.
* Partner with product and delivery teams to identify repeatable, high\-value use cases and contribute to broadly applicable solution patterns that can benefit multiple customers.
* Build a strong understanding of the forecasting engine, downstream integrations, data flows, and related operational processes to anticipate delivery risks and advise on implementation considerations.
* Support client delivery and product delivery teams by proactively highlighting complications, edge cases, data dependencies, and process impacts that should be addressed during solution planning and rollout.
* Drive SIT (System Integration Tests) and UAT (User Acceptance Tests) with customer users using the train\-the\-trainer model deployed by Impact Analytics, ensuring users can effectively validate core business flows and gain confidence before go\-live.
* Address customer knowledge gaps during training and testing phases, driving outcomes by focusing users on the most relevant use cases and business problems based on the client’s context.
* Influence customer stakeholders and secure buy\-in for process changes that improve adoption, simplify workflows, and enable a more effective migration to the platform.
* Meaningfully contribute to assessments of the Planning suite P\&L to understand the trade\-offs and business implications involved in client\-specific customizations, major product upgrades, and differentiated upgrade paths based on customer tiering.
* Contribute to customer presentations, solution recommendations, and internal alignment discussions with clear, structured communication.
* Maintain clear accountability boundaries with Delivery/Implementation and Customer Success teams, particularly at discovery handoff, design review, and UAT sign\-off.


**Desired Profile**
* Experience in solution consulting, implementation consulting, business consulting, pre\-sales consulting, or a similar customer\-facing SaaS role.
* Prior experience with SaaS implementations or consulting engagements in retail or CPG environments is strongly preferred.
* A good understanding of merchandising, assortment, or adjacent retail planning processes is a must\-have.
* Experience in analytics roles or analytics\-led projects is a strong plus, especially where data\-driven recommendations informed business process changes.
* Ability to facilitate workshops, synthesize business requirements, and convert ambiguous needs into structured solution designs.
* Experience driving SIT, UAT, knowledge transfer, and train\-the\-trainer enablement in enterprise software implementations is highly valuable.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to challenge constructively, build trust, and influence customer decision\-making.
* Comfortable working cross\-functionally with product, engineering, delivery, and commercial teams in a fast\-moving SaaS environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex concepts in a simple and business\-relevant way.
* Commercial awareness and the ability to understand the business impact of solution choices, especially in relation to customization and product investment decisions.
* Willingness to travel based on customer and project needs.


**What Successful Outcomes Would Look Like**
* Customers gain clarity on how their planning and assortment processes should operate in the platform.
* Delivery teams receive solution designs that are practical, scalable, and mindful of downstream dependencies.
* UAT, SIT, and training activities improve user readiness, adoption confidence, and implementation quality ahead of go\-live.
* Product teams benefit from structured feedback on common customer use cases, customization implications, and enhancement opportunities.
* Customer stakeholders align around process changes needed for successful implementation and long\-term value realization.
* Design gaps are caught during discovery and design review rather than surfacing during UAT or after go\-live, reducing rework and schedule risk.
* Time from discovery kickoff to signed\-off solution design is tracked against methodology phase gates and completed within expected timelines.


**What We Offer**
* An opportunity to be part of some of the best enterprise SaaS products to be built out of India.
* Opportunities to quench your thirst for problem\-solving, experimenting, learning, and implementing innovative solutions.
* A flat, collegial work environment, with a work hard, play hard attitude.
* A platform for rapid growth if you are willing to try new things without fear of failure.
* Remuneration with best\-in\-class industry standards with generous health insurance cover


**Some Of Our Accolades Include**
* Ranked as one of America's Fastest\-Growing Companies by Financial Times for five consecutive years: 2020\-2024\.
* Ranked as one of America's Fastest\-Growing Private Companies by Inc. 5000 for seven consecutive years: 2018\-2024\.
* Voted \#1 by more than 300 retailers worldwide in the RIS Software LeaderBoard 2024 report.
* Ranked \#72 in America’s Most Innovative Companies list in 2023—by Fortune—alongside companies like Microsoft, Tesla, Apple, IBM, etc.
* Forged a strategic partnership with Google to equip retailers with cutting\-edge generative AI tools.
* Recognized in multiple Gartner reports, including Market Guides and Hype Cycle, spanning assortments, merchandising, forecasting, algorithmic retailing, and Uniﬁed Price, Promotion, and Markdown Optimization Applications.

**Your Job**
As a Cloud Engineer, you will design and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure, facilitate seamless API integrations, and ensure efficient service delivery, supporting our global digital transformation initiatives. You will work closely with the project management team to align cloud solutions with business goals, systems architecture, and organizational standards. Additionally, you will contribute significantly to the continuous enhancement of technical standards and best practices for all aspects of cloud deployment and operational processes.
  

**Our Team**


The Molex Cloud Team is dedicated to securely and efficiently provisioning multi\-cloud resources for all Molex operations. We are accountable to the entire enterprise for designing innovative cloud services, developing and sharing best practices, and providing comprehensive support. We strive to work as a cohesive global team, break down silos, and leverage individual and team strengths to create a competitive advantage and exceptional value for our customers.


What You Will Do  

  



* Design, build, and maintain a stable and efficient infrastructure to optimize service delivery across environments throughout the development lifecycle.
* Utilize a consistent DevOps and DevSecOps approach to improve all phases of the process and ensure end\-to\-end quality across functions.
* Contribute to the adoption of DevOps practices by building CI/CD pipelines and automating deployments.
* Implement automated infrastructure capabilities like backups, security tools, monitoring systems.
* Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, maintain, and improve processes for building, packaging, and deployment.
* Implementing various development, testing, automation tools, and IT infrastructure.
* Set up and manage cloud\-based tools, infrastructure, services, and environments required for development, testing, and production.
* Apply diagnostic techniques to identify and resolve system issues, debug code, and implement fixes to improve performance and efficiency.
* Manage and Resolve incidents, conduct root cause analysis, implement fixes, and collaborate to enhance system reliability and response processes.
* Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field or equivalent work experience.
* Experience with the following technology and services: Terraform, REST APIs, Python or NodeJS, API Gateway, Lambda, S3, RDS, IAM.
* Experience with core AWS networking services, including VPC, Transit Gateway, Route 53 (DNS), and network connectivity design.
* Experience with AWS messaging and streaming services such as Amazon MSK (Kafka).
* Experience with AWS security services, including Secrets Manager, AWS KMS, and IAM roles, policies, Service Control Policies (SCPs), and Resource Control Policies (RCPs).
* Experience with AWS storage and file services, including EBS, EFS, FSx, and Storage Gateway.

* Experience with API Development \& Integration.

* Demonstrated ability to evaluate and apply AI thoughtfully to cloud engineering workflows, using sound judgment to improve infrastructure automation, and operational outcomes.

  

* Experience in designing and implementing automated CI/CD pipelines, streamlining software delivery to ensure efficient and reliable deployments across multiple environments.
* Experienced in developing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) processes and monitoring systems to optimize performance, while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience with Git or other version control systems.
* Excellent teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Strong documentation skills, couple with analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* In\-depth understanding of Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban.

  

What Will Put You Ahead
  

* Experience with cloud\-native observability platforms and technologies such as Grafana, Loki, Mimir, and Tempo.
* Experience with Platform Engineering practices, including building and supporting internal developer platforms and self\-service infrastructure capabilities.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and multi\-cloud environments.

50aa688d.title: Field Architect
50aa688d.description:
MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.
   

  

 The Field Architect role at MinIO is a senior customer\-facing technical leadership position focused on defining, validating, and guiding AIStor architectures for AI, analytics, cloud\-native applications, and large\-scale data infrastructure. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, partners, and internal teams, translating business and application requirements into robust technical designs that deliver measurable outcomes.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with the broader MinIO team to ensure customers are successful through technical discovery, architecture design, proof\-of\-value execution, production onboarding, performance validation, and long\-term expansion. Success in this role requires deep technical curiosity, hands\-on architecture skills, strong communication, and the ability to connect AIStor’s capabilities to the data\-intensive workloads that matter most to our customers.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Technical Leadership \& Architecture
   

  

* Technical Architecture and Discovery: Lead technical discovery with customers and partners to understand their business goals, application requirements, data architecture, infrastructure constraints, and success criteria. Define scalable AIStor architectures that map directly to those requirements.
* AI and Analytics Workload Design: Define and validate AIStor architectures for AI/ML training and inference, analytics platforms, data lakehouse environments, high\-performance data pipelines, large object workloads, and modern application data services.
* Object Storage and S3 Expertise: Serve as a subject matter expert in object storage, S3\-compatible architectures, distributed systems, metadata, replication, erasure coding, security, performance tuning, and large\-scale namespace design.


 Customer Engagement \& Advisory
   

  

* Customer Technical Advisor: Build trusted relationships with customer technical stakeholders, including infrastructure, platform, analytics, AI, security, application, and operations teams. Guide customers toward informed architecture decisions and proactively identify opportunities to improve performance, resilience, scale, and operational efficiency.
* Proof\-of\-Value Execution: Lead technical evaluations, system configurations, performance testing, interoperability validation, and proof\-of\-value engagements that demonstrate AIStor’s value in real customer environments.
* Customer Success Beyond the Win: Partner with Customer Engineering, Product Management, and Engineering teams to help customers move from evaluation to production and from initial deployment to broader adoption across additional workloads, teams, and use cases.


 Ecosystem, Enablement \& Field Operations
   

  

* Cloud\-Native and Kubernetes Guidance: Provide technical leadership on Kubernetes, containers, automation, and cloud\-native deployment patterns, including hybrid cloud, private cloud, public cloud, and edge infrastructure models.
* Solution Integration and Ecosystem Collaboration: Work with technology partners, reseller partners, and customer teams to support complete solutions involving analytics engines, AI platforms, Kubernetes distributions, data protection tools, identity systems, observability platforms, and public cloud services.
* Technical Presentations and Enablement: Build and deliver compelling architecture presentations, whiteboard sessions, demonstrations, best practices, workshops, and technical enablement sessions for customers, partners, and internal teams.
* RFP, RFI, and Technical Response Support: Contribute to or lead technical portions of RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, security reviews, architecture questionnaires, and competitive evaluations.


 Product Intelligence \& Market Expertise
   

  

* Product and Engineering Feedback: Advocate for customer requirements internally by capturing field feedback, competitive insights, workload patterns, integration needs, and enhancement opportunities. Work with Product and Engineering teams to help inform roadmap priorities and improve customer outcomes.
* Competitive and Market Expertise: Stay current on object storage, data lakehouse, AI infrastructure, analytics, Kubernetes, cloud, and competitive storage trends. Help internal teams and customers understand where AIStor is differentiated.


**Your Skills And Experience**
* Strong background in enterprise storage, object storage, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, or high\-performance data\-intensive applications.
* Strong understanding of object storage concepts and S3\-compatible architectures; experience with HTTP, REST APIs, JSON, security models, replication, data protection, and scale\-out system design is highly valuable.
* 10\+ years of experience in a senior customer\-facing technical role such as Field Architect, Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Systems Engineer, or Technical Consultant.
* Hands\-on experience with Linux, networking, storage systems, virtualization, containers, Kubernetes, and modern data center infrastructure.
* Experience designing or supporting AI, machine learning, analytics, data lakehouse, or large\-scale data pipeline environments.
* Familiarity with ecosystem technologies such as Databricks, Starburst, Spark, Trino, Iceberg, Delta Lake, Kafka, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or other AI and analytics frameworks is a strong plus.
* Experience with public cloud and hybrid cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, or private cloud platforms.
* Ability to conduct technical discovery, design architectures, build demonstrations, guide proof\-of\-value execution, analyze performance, and communicate tradeoffs clearly.
* Comfortable working with heterogeneous enterprise environments involving compute, storage, networking, security, identity, observability, backup, disaster recovery, and application teams.
* Strong verbal, written, whiteboarding, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and executive audiences.
* Ability to work collaboratively across customers, partners, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Engineering teams.
* Strong customer\-success orientation, intellectual curiosity, sense of ownership, and ability to prioritize effectively in a fast\-moving environment.
* Willingness to travel as needed to support customers, partners, field events, and internal team activities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.


**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
 MinIO is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

0fd601d1.title: Enterprise Architect - Infrastructure
0fd601d1.description:
How to contribute to our vision
   

  

 As an Enterprise Architect for Infrastructure, you will be a senior strategic leader responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the comprehensive infrastructure architecture for the entire organization. You will play a pivotal role in designing enterprise infrastructure architectures that span both Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT) environments, enabling secure, reliable, and high\-performance connectivity between enterprise systems, industrial assets, IoT platforms, and cloud services. The core of your responsibilities will involve creating and managing the enterprise infrastructure roadmap, from evaluating the current state ('as\-is') to defining the target state ('to\-be') architecture.
   

  

 What You Need To Make a Difference
   

  

* 40% Architecture \& Strategy
+ Analyze industry trends, emerging technologies, and infrastructure best practices to continuously evolve the enterprise infrastructure architecture and create business value.
+ Define and communicate the target Infrastructure Architecture vision and strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives, digital transformation initiatives, and enterprise architecture principles.
+ Develop and maintain the Infrastructure Transformation Roadmap, assessing current\-state capabilities and defining future\-state architectures across cloud, data center, network, workplace, and edge environments.
+ Shape the enterprise strategy for: Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS) Data Centers and Hosting Compute and Storage Networks and Connectivity End User Computing and Workplace Services Infrastructure Automation Platform Engineering Observability and Monitoring Backup, Recovery, and Business Continuity
+ Define architecture requirements for infrastructure services supporting Data, AI, Engineering, PLM, ALM, IoT, Digital Twin, and OT workloads.

* 40% Digital Transformation
+ Establish enterprise\-wide infrastructure architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, design patterns, and technology guardrails.
+ Drive the modernization and simplification of infrastructure platforms, reducing complexity, technical debt, and operational risk while improving scalability and performance.
+ Lead architecture assessments and evaluate infrastructure solutions, balancing business requirements, operational resilience, security, performance, sustainability, and cost optimization.
+ Define the target operating model for cloud and hybrid infrastructure services, enabling self\-service, automation, standardization, and platform\-based delivery.
+ Ensure infrastructure platforms are resilient, scalable, sustainable, and capable of supporting current and future business demands.

* 20% Collaboration \& Leadership
+ Collaborate with Enterprise Architects, Solution Architects, Security Architects, Platform Teams, and IT Operations to ensure alignment between business requirements and infrastructure capabilities.
+ Contribute to technology portfolio management, lifecycle planning, investment prioritization, and vendor strategy decisions.
+ Mentor architects and technology leaders while promoting infrastructure architecture best practices and knowledge sharing across the organization.


 Certifications
   

  

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* TOGAF
* VMware Certified Professional (VCP) or Red Hat Certified Architect (RHCA) or Cisco CCNP Enterprise or Cisco CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure
* ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader
* Kubernetes (CKA)
* Terraform Associate
* FinOps Practitioner


 Education
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure Architecture, Cloud Architecture, Platform Architecture, or related IT leadership roles.
* Proven experience designing and governing large\-scale enterprise infrastructure environments in global organizations.
* Experience leading infrastructure modernization, cloud transformation, data center transformation, or platform engineering initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience aligning infrastructure investments with business objectives and enterprise architecture strategies.
* Strong background in infrastructure strategy, technology roadmaps, architecture governance, and operating model transformation.


**Skills**
* Architectural Frameworks \& Methodologies
+ Enterprise Architecture Management (EAM)

* Technical Expertise
+ Cloud Platforms and Services
+ Data Center Technologies
+ Server, Compute, and Storage Platforms
+ Enterprise Networks and Connectivity
+ Workplace and End User Services
+ Virtualization and Container Platforms
+ Platform Engineering
+ Infrastructure Automation
+ Observability and Monitoring
+ Backup, Recovery, and Business Continuity

* Leadership \& Communication Skills
+ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business outcomes and executive\-level recommendations.
+ Strong consulting, facilitation, and influencing capabilities across business, architecture, engineering, and operations teams.
+ Proven ability to lead cross\-functional initiatives and drive alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.
+ Collaborative mindset with a passion for mentoring architects and enabling technology communities.
+ Open\-minded, curious, and committed to continuous learning and innovation.

**Software Product Design/Architecture:** 
 Knowledge of software product design; ability to convert market requirements into the software product design.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Demonstrates experience with the architecture and design of major or multiple products.
* Describes major software architecture alternatives and considerations.
* Explains design considerations for commercial database systems, operating systems and web.
* Displays experience in estimating the cost of a specific design of a proposed product.
* Facilitates design reviews and walkthroughs.
* Analyzes benefits and drawbacks of specific software designs and architecture.


**Application Modernization** 
 : Knowledge of the concepts, processes and technologies of application modernization; ability to design, develop and deploy modernized applications in various business scenarios.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Creates and customizes cloud application modernization plans based on specific business requirements.
* Consults on security issues and problems regarding application migration.
* Coaches others on the modernization approach for microservice based application.
* Leads discussions on the challenges and risks in developing cloud\-native based applications.
* Provides insights on complex technical problems of co\-existence of legacy and new application systems.
* Compares and contrasts the benefits and drawbacks of various application modernization approaches.


**Architecture Modeling:** 
 Knowledge of Architecture Modeling; ability to develop and modify enterprise architecture through conceptual, logical and physical approaches.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Consults on architecture framework design; verifies operational objectives for each framework design procedure.
* Determines corresponding indicators for each technology layer and evaluates the operational performance of each layer.
* Decides on specific roles and responsibilities of engineers within business, information and data architecture modeling.
* Coordinates materials for architecture design modeling.
* Evaluates technology product roles and strengths within the project and locates appropriate technology providers based on results.
* Interprets relevant principles for technology architecture modeling requirements from the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST).

 Knowledge of the activities, tasks, practices and deliverables for assessing and documenting business opportunities; ability to assess the benefits, risks, and success factors of potential applications.
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Applies tools and techniques for gathering business requirements.
* Defines the activities, deliverables, and tools of a business assessment process.
* Documents best practices and techniques for assessing application opportunities.
* Participates in conducting and documenting business assessments.
* Participates in the preparation of risk assessment and benefits analysis.

 : Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Assists with current and planned integration initiatives.
* Explores major issues and considerations for successful system integration.
* Works with applications, data, technology bridges and a variety of platforms.
* Works with existing interfaces as well as integration and migration plans within own area.

f14e9ea9.title: Cloud, Data Science & AI Architect
f14e9ea9.description:
**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Define and own the end\-to\-end architecture for enterprise cloud, data, analytics, machine learning and Generative AI platforms.
* Architect and lead the development of scalable cloud and data platforms supporting digital transformation, business intelligence, advanced analytics and AI initiatives.
* Design cloud\-native, distributed and microservices\-based solution architectures on AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
* Define scalable data architectures for batch, streaming, event\-driven and real\-time processing workloads.
* Design enterprise data platforms covering data ingestion, transformation, storage, metadata management, governance, analytics and consumption.
* Architect data\-lake, data\-warehouse and lakehouse solutions using platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, BigQuery, Synapse or equivalent technologies.
* Design cloud\-native data products, APIs and reusable services that enable business intelligence, advanced analytics and AI applications.
* Lead the architecture and deployment of machine\-learning solutions, including model development, feature engineering, deployment, monitoring, retraining and lifecycle management.
* Define and implement MLOps architectures using platforms and tools such as MLflow, Azure Machine Learning, Amazon SageMaker or equivalent technologies.
* Lead the design of Generative AI solutions using large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, prompt engineering and agent\-based frameworks.
* Define AI orchestration patterns for intelligent assistants, copilots, autonomous agents and domain\-specific AI applications.
* Design and optimise enterprise\-grade data pipelines to ensure reliable, scalable and high\-quality data processing.
* Architect streaming and real\-time analytics solutions using Apache Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, Apache Pulsar, Apache Flink, Spark Streaming or equivalent technologies.
* Establish data\-modelling, indexing, partitioning, caching and performance\-optimisation standards for relational, NoSQL and analytical data stores.
* Design integration frameworks using APIs, event\-driven architectures, messaging platforms and enterprise data ecosystems.
* Work closely with data scientists, data engineers, cloud engineers, software architects, product teams and business stakeholders to deliver end\-to\-end solutions.
* Establish architecture standards and best practices for cloud engineering, data engineering, DataOps, MLOps, DevSecOps, security, governance and operational excellence.
* Define modern CI/CD, automated\-testing and Infrastructure\-as\-Code practices using Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep or equivalent technologies.
* Ensure that cloud, data and AI solutions comply with enterprise requirements for security, privacy, regulatory compliance, data sovereignty and responsible AI.
* Define observability, monitoring, reliability, high\-availability, disaster\-recovery and cost\-optimisation strategies.
* Evaluate emerging cloud, analytics, data science and AI technologies and recommend appropriate enterprise adoption strategies.
* Conduct architecture assessments, technology evaluations, proofs of concept and solution trade\-off analyses.
* Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to define technical roadmaps, target\-state architectures and phased implementation strategies.


**Job Description \- Grade Specific**
* Extensive experience designing scalable, secure and highly available enterprise solutions on AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of cloud\-native, distributed, event\-driven and microservices\-based architectures.
* Deep expertise in designing and implementing enterprise data platforms covering ingestion, processing, storage, governance, analytics and data consumption.
* Strong experience with data\-lake, data\-warehouse and lakehouse architecture patterns.
* Hands\-on experience with data\-engineering platforms such as Apache Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric or equivalent technologies.
* Strong experience with relational, NoSQL and analytical databases, including data modelling, indexing, partitioning and performance optimisation.
* Experience designing batch, near\-real\-time and real\-time data\-processing solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with streaming platforms such as Apache Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, Apache Pulsar, Apache Flink or Spark Streaming.
* Strong understanding of machine\-learning and AI lifecycle management, including data preparation, model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, retraining and governance.
* Experience designing and implementing enterprise MLOps platforms and practices.
* Hands\-on experience with tools such as MLflow, Azure Machine Learning, Amazon SageMaker or equivalent platforms.
* Strong experience building Generative AI applications using large language models and retrieval\-augmented generation architectures.
* Experience with prompt engineering, model orchestration, grounding, evaluation, guardrails and responsible\-AI practices.
* Experience designing agent\-based and multi\-agent AI solutions using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with vector databases and semantic\-search platforms such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Azure AI Search, OpenSearch, pgvector or equivalent technologies.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL, together with working knowledge of at least one additional language such as Java, Golang or Node.js.
* Experience developing and deploying cloud\-native APIs, microservices and data services.
* Strong understanding of API management, service integration and event\-driven integration patterns.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, serverless computing and container\-based deployment architectures.
* Familiarity with modern CI/CD, DataOps, MLOps, Infrastructure as Code and DevSecOps practices.
* Hands\-on experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep or equivalent automation technologies.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise data governance, metadata management, lineage, data quality, master\-data management and access controls.
* Experience with cloud and data security, including encryption, identity and access management, key management, network security and secure data sharing.
* Understanding of regulatory, privacy and compliance requirements applicable to enterprise data and AI platforms.
* Familiarity with business\-intelligence and visualisation platforms such as Power BI, Tableau or Looker.
* Experience in the energy, utilities, manufacturing, rail, industrial or other asset\-intensive industries would be advantageous.

43269442.title: Cloud PreSales Senior Architect
43269442.description:
**Company Description**
**About Sopra Steria**
 Sopra Steria, a major Tech player in Europe with 51,000 employees in nearly 30 countries, is recognised for its consulting, digital services and solutions. It helps its clients drive their digital transformation and obtain tangible and sustainable benefits. The Group provides end\-to\-end solutions to make large companies and organisations more competitive by combining in\-depth knowledge of a wide range of business sectors and innovative technologies with a collaborative approach. Sopra Steria places people at the heart of everything it does and is committed to putting digital to work for its clients in order to build a positive future for all. In 2025, the Group generated revenues of €5\.6 billion.
   

  

**Job Description**
**The world is how we shape it.**
**Role Overview**
 Cloud Technology Enthusiast who love solving business problems using technology. Candidate should have excellent experience with diverse customer and partner facing roles supported technical aspects of sales activities for the technology products and services such as Cloud –PaaS \& IaaS, Databases \& tools and Systems.
   

  

 You will be a key player in the pre\-sales process and be able to understand complex customer environments and be able to build close customer relationships.

* Develop and deliver high\-impact proposals, ensuring alignment with client needs and industry best practices.
* Conduct C\-level client interactions, technical workshops, and deep\-dive discussions to position solutions effectively.
* Uses their recognised expertise to resolve issues
* Act as a trusted advisor and technology thought leader, guiding clients through their cloud transformation journeys.
* Demonstrable experience leading teams and pitching to clients
* Identifies and controls risks
* Good command of the market in their domain: competitor products, trends, changes in regulations
* Internally and, where relevant, externally recognised expertise in one or more business domains
* Oversees performance (profitability, lead\-times, quality) within their scope
* Advises senior business representatives on choices and implementation of a product
* Is a key player in pre\-sales in Cloud offerings and helps identify sales opportunities
* Contributes to steering product developments in liaison with Practice Director


**Essential Skills And Experience**
* Demonstrable experience in Azure and or AWS with a technical background and experience in technology deployments
* Demonstrable knowledge of Microsoft solutions and their application to a clients cloud strategy
* Strong leadership in orals during RFPs, client executive briefings, and high\-stakes technical demonstrations.
* Demonstrable experience of leading engagements and managing client stakeholders
* Ability to engage and influence C\-level executives, technical leaders, and business stakeholders.
* Good command of the market in their domain: competitor products, trends, changes in regulations
* Internally and, where relevant, externally recognised expertise in one or more business domains
* Recognised in one or more business domains and recognised expertise with one or more products or product groups as a whole
* Expertise in workshop facilitation techniques, particularly the fundamentals of co\-design work
* Good command of the impacts of agility
* Good command of and transfers motivational management practices
* Demonstrated experience managing several complex product assessment tasks


**Attributes and Qualities**
* High level of written and oral communication
* Appetite for business challenge
* Ability to motivate and inspire colleagues
* Customer orientated approach
* Innovative
* Problem solving skills


 Total Experience Expected: 14\-18 years
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Microsoft Azure / AWS Solutions Architect Expert
* Azure IaaS (virtual machines, storage, networking, security).
* Azure Backup \& Recovery Services.
* Azure Governance (Blueprints, policies, tagging, cost management).
* Azure SQL Databases (Managed Instances, PaaS, IaaS).
* Azure Security (Zero Trust, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, Azure AD, AIP).
* Azure Serverless and integration (Batch, Function, Logic Apps, EventGrid).
* Azure Containers (AKS, ACI, ACR).
* Active Directory\\Entra ID (Azure AD, Azure AD DS, on premises AD DS).
* On premises infrastructure, virtualisation technologies or applications
* Experience with Windows Server\\Linux OS.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (ARM, Bicep, Terraform, PowerShell).


**Additional Information**
**Desirable skills and experience It would be great if they had…**
* An ability to see the bigger picture, understanding where activities are inter\-related while ensuring dependencies are clear and appropriately managed to achieve success
* Adaptable and flexible to new work requests and highly demanding priorities
* Honed abilities to motivate and support others to achieve a common business goal
* Good knowledge of at least one business domain


**Key performance indicators How will they be measured?**
* Feedback from customers and colleagues
* Growth of the Practice
* Knowledge acquisition of more junior members of the practice
* Utilisation

 All of our positions are open to people with disabilities.

* Strong proactive communicator and presenter, able to influence and collaborate at all levels of an organization to maximize problem resolution while effectively presenting information and responding to highly specialized functional questions

* Ability to work independently effectively and proactively

* Works with appropriate parties to ensure issues are resolved.
* Travel readiness based on business needs.

If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values

Job Summary
  
  

GRC \& BCP/DR Roles and Responsibilities Governance, Risk, Compliance, Business Continuity \& Disaster Recovery Role Snapshot Recommended JD Baseline Position Title GRC \& BCP/DR Specialist / Consultant Primary Scope Governance, Risk \& Compliance support; business continuity and disaster recovery oversight for Burlington Managed Network Services Delivery Context Managed Network Services, NOC resiliency, service governance, risk/issue management, audit evidence, reporting, and DR plan coordination Stakeholder Interfaces Service Delivery Lead, NOC Managers, PMO, Security Management, Burlington stakeholders, tools/automation leads, vendors/OEMs, and audit/compliance teams Operating Model Hybrid operating model aligned to 24x7 NOC services, dual delivery center resiliency, service reporting, governance reviews, and disaster recovery procedure/testing obligations Experience Guidance 6\-10 years for Specialist/Consultant; 10\+ years preferred for Lead/Manager alignment Certifications Preferred ITIL Foundation; ISO 22301/BCMS, ISO 27001, CRISC/CISA/CISM, CBCP/CBCI or equivalent certifications preferred 1\. Position Summary The GRC \& BCP/DR Specialist is responsible for coordinating governance, risk, compliance, business continuity, and disaster recovery activities for Burlington Managed Network Services. The role ensures that service governance, risk and issue logs, compliance evidence, audit readiness, disaster recovery plan integration, DR testing support, and continuity reporting are managed in a structured and auditable manner. The position works closely with service delivery, NOC leadership, PMO, security, tools/automation, and Burlington stakeholders to ensure risks, service continuity obligations, and compliance actions are visible, tracked, tested, and remediated. Note: This JD is written as a staffing/hiring baseline. Any account\-specific controls, legal clauses, or final RACI should be validated against the finalized MSA/SOW and Burlington\-approved operational manuals. 2\. Help ensure that services, processes, runbooks, testing, communications, and escalation practices are documented and continuously improved. 3\. Key Responsibilities A. Governance \& Service Management • Support account governance cadence across operational, service delivery, executive, and strategic forums. • Prepare governance materials covering open issues, SLA trends, service risks, improvement plans, DR status, audit findings, and action item progress. • Coordinate with PMO and service delivery leadership to maintain the Service Management and Operational Procedures Manual, RACI, contacts, escalation lists, communications plan, reporting formats, operational responsibilities, and ITIL process descriptions. • Track governance decisions, approvals, actions, owners, due dates, and closure evidence. • Escalate unresolved business, operational, technical, financial, or risk issues that cannot be resolved at the operational level. 7017fd66.title: M365 Architect
7017fd66.description:
**Details:**
 Job Description
   

  

 Role is part of Stefanini's Infrastructure Services Division, the Digital Workplace Platform (DWP) team continues to grow, and we are seeking a highly skilled and experienced
 **Microsoft 365 Technical Architect** 
 to join our Professional Services team.
   

  

 As a
 **Microsoft 365 Architect** 
 , you will be responsible for implementing and managing Microsoft 365 solutions for our clients. You will work closely with clients to understand their business requirements and provide technical expertise to ensure successful deployment and adoption of Microsoft 365 technologies.
   

  

 We are looking for a profile with a solid Microsoft 365 technical background combined with strong customer leadership skills. This role will require significant customer interaction. The candidate must have broad, multi\-discipline, Enterprise IT experience and must deliver customer\-centric solutions that improve the user experience.
   

  

 Job Requirements
   

  

**Details:**
**Job responsibilities:**
* Collaborate with clients to understand their technical and business needs and implement Microsoft 365 solutions that align with their goals and objectives.
* Be able to implement solutions for Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and other connected technologies (i.e., AD, AADConnect, ADFS, Azure AD, Identity Provider Solutions like i.e., Okta, Azure and other Automation Solutions, Exchange Server, mail relay and hygiene technologies and/or Migration Tools, etc.).
* Provide guidance and support to clients during the implementation and migration process, ensuring smooth and successful deployment of Microsoft 365 solutions. (i.e., working experience with one or more of the following migration tools: BitTitan, Quest, Sharegate, CloudiWay)
* Conduct technical assessments and audits to identify areas for improvement and optimization within existing Microsoft 365 environments.
* Stay up to date with the latest Microsoft 365 technologies, features, and best practices, and provide recommendations to clients for leveraging these advancements.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including developers, system administrators and project managers, to ensure seamless integration of Microsoft 365 solutions with existing systems and processes.
* Provide technical guidance and support to clients to promote adoption and maximize the benefits of Microsoft 365 technologies.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to Microsoft 365, including performance, connectivity, and security concerns.
* Be able to create and maintain documentation of technical architectures (HLDs, LLDs, Operations Manual, etc.), configurations (configuration checklist) and procedures (SOPs, etc.) related to Microsoft 365 solutions.

c20bb8cd.title: MS - IT Infra/Cloud -  Senior Associate - Service Level Manager- operate
c20bb8cd.description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a Senior Associate in IT Infrastructure and Cloud Operations, you will play a pivotal role in designing and implementing secure IT systems that support business operations. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will focus on managing and optimizing cloud infrastructure and services to enable seamless operations and availability for clients. You will be responsible for monitoring, troubleshooting, and implementing industry\-leading practices for cloud\-based systems.
   

  

 As a Senior Associate, you will build meaningful client connections and learn how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions. Embracing increased ambiguity, you will be comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, using these moments as opportunities to grow.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your skills to analyze complex problems and maintain professional standards. You will use a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems, developing a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Managing and optimizing cloud infrastructure to support seamless operations and availability
* Monitoring and troubleshooting cloud\-based systems to identify and resolve issues promptly
* Implementing industry\-leading practices for cloud service management and performance optimization
* Designing and executing cloud migration strategies to enhance infrastructure efficiency
* Collaborating with clients to understand their needs and deliver tailored cloud solutions

8b2cfaec.title: Customer Success Manager- Marketing cloud
8b2cfaec.description:
**Description**
 The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high\-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer's workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and
   

  

 advice to customer organizations. The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer priorities, projects, and problems. The CSM serving Marketing Cloud customers acts as the primary Marketing Cloud Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical and operational configuration and needs of the customer.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Customer Accountability and Value Alignment
   

  

* Single Point of Accountability: Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
* Signature Lifecycle Oversight: Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle.
* Value Delivery: Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
* Prioritization: Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
* Internal Resource Utilization: Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.


**Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management**
* Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive\-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer's business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
* Innovation Partnership: Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
* Customer Engagement: Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
* Collaborative Problem Solving: Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.


**Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management**
* AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
* Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural\-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
* AI Engagement Monitoring: Using AI\-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
* Collaborative Learning: Actively seeking out "Agentblazer" training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
* Learning \& Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask effective diagnosis questions and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
* Proactive Reviews: Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
* Incident Management: Act as the primary point of contact for major incidents, ensuring timely communications and resolution of issues.
* Cross\-functional Relationships: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
* Client Engagement Planning: Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision\-making.


**Minimum Requirements**
 Preferred/Mandatory Qualifications and Skills
   

  

* Experience (Mandatory): Experienced business professional with 9\+ years of relevant industry expertise, including a mandatory minimum of 2\+ years of direct, hands\-on experience working with the Salesforce Marketing Cloud platform (Marketing Cloud Engagement, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement / Pardot, or Marketing Cloud Next) in a customer success, administrator, consultant, or marketing operations capacity. Candidates without demonstrated Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience will not be considered for this role.
* Consulting Skills: Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C\-level conversations.
* Domain Expertise: Possess industry\-relevant expertise and begin honing skills in a relevant functional area. Should understand the broad impact of the industry on the customer's business.
* Communication: Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
* Learning \& Development: Actively seek out relevant learning activities, approach obstacles as growth opportunities, and seek experienced mentors to accelerate personal development.


**Cloud Specific Experience**
 Salesforce product certifications are required for this role. Recommended Marketing Cloud certifications:
   

  

* Marketing Cloud Engagement Administrator — hands\-on experience configuring Marketing Cloud products using industry and product best practices.
* Marketing Cloud Email Specialist — proven knowledge of email marketing best practices, message design, subscriber \& data management, and inbox delivery.
* Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist — skills in designing, building, and implementing marketing workflows through the Account Engagement (Pardot) platform.
* Marketing Cloud Engagement Consultant — ability to create multi\-channel campaign solutions using the full suite of Marketing Cloud tools.

a72d62bf.title: Localization Program Manager
a72d62bf.description:
**About the Role**  

  

The Localization team is looking for an experienced Localization Program Manager to help scale Uber's global localization efforts. In this role, you will partner cross\-functionally with Product, Design, Content, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, Regional Operations, and other teams to deliver high\-quality localized experiences that support global and regional product launches.  

  

You will own end\-to\-end localization programs, drive process improvements, and help shape the future of localization through automation and AI\-powered workflows.  

  

This is a hybrid role requiring employees to work from the office three days per week.  

  

**What You'll Do*** Manage end\-to\-end localization for Uber products and external\-facing content across all supported languages, including planning, stakeholder consultation, localization delivery, linguistic quality assurance (LQA), and localization bug management.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Design, and other cross\-functional teams to review and influence product requirements (PRDs/RFCs), ensuring globalization and localization needs are considered early in the development lifecycle.
* Lead localization for a wide range of content, including product UI, customer support content, legal documentation, marketing campaigns, websites, surveys, contracts, dashboards, and other customer\-facing assets.
* Drive cross\-functional initiatives to improve localization processes, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to enhance localization tools and workflows, partnering with Localization Technical Operations to implement improvements.
* Collaborate closely with external localization vendors and language service providers, ensuring high\-quality deliverables and on\-time execution across regional time zones.
* Monitor localization quality, timelines, budgets, and program health while identifying trends and opportunities for continuous improvement.

**Basic Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of localization project or program management experience within the technology industry, preferably on the client side.
* Strong understanding of localization, internationalization (i18n), and globalization (g11n) best practices.
* Experience leveraging modern localization technologies, including Machine Translation (MT), Large Language Models (LLMs), and Generative AI within localization workflows.
* Experience working with localization vendors supporting Fortune 100 companies or enterprise\-scale localization programs.
* Experience managing localization budgets and analyzing program metrics and trends.
* Proven ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, and drive complex programs across multiple stakeholders and regions.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate business objectives into actionable solutions.
* Exceptional attention to detail with a strong focus on quality and execution.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and align cross\-functional stakeholders across varying levels of the organization.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to quickly learn new tools, systems, and technologies.

**Preferred Qualifications*** Experience using Computer\-Assisted Translation (CAT) tools such as WorldServer, Phrase, Trados, or similar localization platforms.
* Experience managing localization across multiple content types, including product UI, Help Center/support content, marketing materials, and legal documentation.
* Experience designing or implementing GenAI\-enabled localization workflows, including AI quality evaluation and human\-in\-the\-loop review processes.

  

**Ready to Ride?**  

  

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.  

  

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
  

  

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  

  

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

**Overview**
 Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud\-enabled world.
   

  

 Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging \& real\-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data\-first applications and driving a data culture.
   

  

 Within Azure Data, the Microsoft Fabric platform team builds and maintains the operating system and provides customers a unified data stack to run an entire data estate. The platform provides a unified experience, unified governance, enables a unified business model and a unified architecture.
   

  

 We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to strengthen how Fabric Quality measures, reports, and acts on service health — a top organizational focus and a critical effort for the business. This role builds trusted reporting, automates the manual workflows behind the quality rhythm, and standardizes service\-health telemetry and metrics, so "healthy" means the same thing across teams and raw signal becomes insight leaders and engineering teams act on. The team moves quickly, and the role calls for comfort working in an agile, fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 The work is hands\-on and cross\-team: identifying gaps across scenarios, defining the success criteria and metrics that matter, and ensuring the telemetry behind them is complete and trustworthy. It suits a TPM who executes reliably across multiple workstreams, cares about data correctness and consistency, and is proficient with telemetry, reporting, and automation — Power BI / DAX, Kusto, and scripting to remove manual toil. Working through ambiguity, developing hypotheses and solutions, and coordinating across engineering and data teams to land defined problems end\-to\-end — with a bias toward repeatable, AI\- and automation\-assisted workflows — rounds out the profile.
   

  

 We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive end\-to\-end quality for Fabric scenarios, covering both performance (latency, regressions) and reliability (success rates, failures, and timeouts).
* Partner with engineering and data teams to onboard scenarios with complete, accurate telemetry, clear ownership, and measurable targets — and to refine the data pipelines, reporting models, and sampling strategies that keep signals consistent and accurate across environments.
* Identify monitoring gaps across key customer journeys, improving signal quality and ensuring issues are detected early with minimal noise.
* Support LiveSite by helping define alerting thresholds and partner with teams during incidents to investigate performance regressions and reliability issues, identify root causes, and drive follow\-up actions.
* Maintain and evolve the dashboards and reporting used in regular reviews — connecting performance and reliability signals into actionable insight tied to team commitments and end\-to\-end customer impact.
* Drive cross\-team coordination to unblock dependencies and align priorities, and create simple, repeatable documentation and onboarding paths so teams can adopt monitoring and alerting with minimal friction.


 Embody our culture and values
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's Degree AND 2\+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.
* 1\+ year(s) of experience managing cross\-functional and/or cross\-team projects.


**Other \& Additional**
 Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check:
   

  

 This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

* Experience in performance monitoring, reliability, or observability systems
* Experience with data analysis tools such as Kusto, SQL, or Power BI
* Experience working with distributed systems or cloud platforms
* Effective communication skills, with the ability to work across disciplines including engineering, product, and data engineering teams

edcc42b7.title: Sr Principal Program Manager
edcc42b7.description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
 Senior Principal Program Manager \- Interface Controllers
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 We are looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager who will be responsible for the overall coordination of R\&D Development Projects and Key Customer Engagements within the Design IP Group. The candidate must have solid, hands\-on experience with PCIe, UCIe and/or Ethernet controllers and implementation in SoC with a history in successfully leading or managing designs with end customers. We are looking for an individual with an entrepreneurial mindset with strong leadership skills and “assume ownership” to ensure flawless execution. Someone who is passionate, and enjoys and thrives on coordinating all the facets of the design project in a matrix organizational structure to deliver successful results. Ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate with R\&D and marketing in defining the scope, and ability to collaborate with teams with clear communication skills, are the must\-have attributes in this role.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a Program Manager you are responsible for driving the various internal teams to deliver Controller IP based products and services. You must be knowledgeable and proficient with Ethernet and PCIe standards, MAC and protocols. Additionally, proven experience to interpret the standard’s specification to understand Interoperability and Compliance test suites. This position is responsible for creating and executing project plan, proactively mitigating risks, and managing the Project life cycle from inception to project delivery and post\-production support. You will also be responsible for managing external stakeholders as customer facing Program Manager.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Work with internal \& external customers, stakeholders to define project objectives and requirements.
* Prioritize requirements and define scope to meet customer needs in a timely manner given available resources.
* Develop, maintain, and distribute (as appropriate) standard project management deliverables for the successful implementation of the project, including: implementation plan, project schedule, project budget and variances, issues \& action items log, meeting minutes, risks assessment and contingencies.
* Manage deliverables (including SOWs, change management, approval of deliverables).
* Partner with internal and external development teams to deliver on time and with the quality required.
* Serve as the project owner in development process; maintaining quality checklists, Jira tickets, schedule tracker etc.
* Manage each release through the quality checker process.
* Partner with various teams to identify areas in need of improvement to increase customer satisfaction and decrease support requests.
* Anticipate problems and complications and formulate solutions so as not to impede the progress of the project.
* Assume responsibility and drive ownership for issue resolution.
* Holding status update meetings with technical teams and updating higher management on the project progress.
* Create and maintain scorecards to track project performance.
* Accountable for on time project delivery, product quality, cost, and operations.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering from an accredited institution.
* 15\+ years of experience out of which at least 2\+ years of Program Management or Technical Product Management experience in a technology\-oriented organization.
* Physical Layer and Protocol layer experience on AT LEAST ONE High speed SERDES on Ethernet/PCIe/CXL/UCIe
* Experience in PCIe/UCIe LTSSM states / UCIe Interfaces / Ethernet standards
* Proficient with Ethernet, PCIe, UCIe standards and Protocols. Proven experience to interpret the standard’s specification reg. Protocol, Interoperability and Compliance test suites
* Strong project management skills with the ability to work on and track multiple projects simultaneously.
* Demonstrated ability to think creatively and strategically when executing the project and solving problems.
* Familiar with mixed\-signal IP design flow and methodologies, Verilog/RTL coding \& Verification


 Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to communicate effectively with both technical and nontechnical individuals.
   

  

**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

Join us as a Solution Architect \- VP, Liquidity Management at Barclays, where you will set the strategic direction and architectural vision for our Liquidity Management platform. You will spearhead the evolution of enterprise‑critical financial systems, driving platform modernization, regulatory robustness, and engineering excellence across the organization.You will harness modern architectural paradigms and cloud‑native technologies to design and govern highly resilient, scalable, and auditable solutions, ensuring accurate interest computation, regulatory compliance, and seamless integration across core banking, payments, finance and treasury ecosystems. You will act as a senior technology leader, influencing strategy, mentoring architects, and partnering closely with business, risk, and regulatory stakeholders.
   

  

 To be successful as a Solution Architect \-VP, Liquidity Management, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Deep liquidity management and interest calculation, including cash flow forecasting, intraday liquidity, Single \& Multi\-Currency Pooling and regulatory drivers.
* Enterprise‑scale solution architecture leadership, defining target architectures, design standards, and architectural governance for complex banking platforms.
* Complex integration and data architecture, integrating core banking, payments, APIs, and event‑driven platforms while managing high‑volume, mission‑critical transactional data.
* Cloud and platform transformation, leading large‑scale implementations on Azure, AWS, or GCP with strong focus on resilience, security, performance, and regulatory compliance.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Experience with financial instruments and balance‑sheet products impacting liquidity and interest, including deposits, loans, and derivatives.
* Strong data and database architecture expertise across enterprise relational and NoSQL platforms.
* Proven leadership in regulatory‑driven design, ensuring auditability, traceability, model transparency, and compliance (e.g., Basel III).
* Excellent senior stakeholder engagement and technology leadership, including mentoring architects, influencing roadmaps, and driving cross‑functional alignment.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To lead the portfolio management team in the delivery of successful projects, while ensuring that portfolio management processes and practices are aligned with controls and governance standards and that projects are aligned with the organisation’s strategic objectives.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Leading of portfolio management team, including setting of portfolio vision, management of portfolio performance, and provision of guidance and support to portfolio analysts.
* Monitoring of portfolio performance, including tracking of project progress, managing budgets, identification of thematic risks and issues, and reporting on portfolio status to senior management.
* Management of portfolio documentation, including aggregation of portfolio book of work, schedules, and budgets, and ensuring that portfolio documentation is up\-to\-date and accurate.
* Facilitation of portfolio governance, including ensuring that projects are aligned with the organisation’s strategic objectives, aligned with the controls and governance standards and that portfolio thematic risks and issues are managed effectively.
* Managing the portfolio Book of Work outlining the sequence and dependencies of change initiatives, considering factors like resource availability, stakeholder buy\-in, and potential risks.
* Facilitation of change management activities, to ensure that change initiatives are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.
* Continuous improvement of portfolio management practices, including identification of areas for improvement and implementation of changes to improve portfolio performance.
* Collaboration with stakeholders, including senior management, project teams, and external partners, to ensure that portfolio management practices are aligned with their needs and expectations.
* Development of portfolio management processes that are aligned with controls and governance standards and that support the delivery of successful projects.


**Vice President Expectations**
* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
