**About Zuora**
 At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage\-based pricing to AI\-driven and outcome\-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.
   

  

 We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI\-ready foundation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Partner Solution Architect is a key member of the Partner Delivery Success organization, responsible for helping partners successfully architect, plan, and deliver Zuora solutions. This role is the technical lead and trusted advisor to partners during partner\-led implementations, improving delivery quality, partner readiness, and technical adoption across the ecosystem.
   

  

 This person will work closely with Partners, Global Services, Sales, Customer, Product, and Support to guide solution design, validate technical approaches, mitigate delivery risk, and strengthen partner capability. The role is centered on the technical aspects of partner delivery and implementation success rather than account management.
   

  

**What You’ll Achieve**
* Enable partners to design and deliver scalable, high\-quality Zuora implementations.
* Improve partner implementation health, go\-live outcomes, and overall delivery quality.
* Increase partner technical capability through certification, enablement, and ongoing architecture guidance.
* Support technical governance across partner\-led projects by identifying risks early, guiding mitigation plans, and ensuring alignment to Zuora best practices.


**In This Role, You Will**
**Partner Solution Architecture \& Technical Guidance**
* Provide technical leadership to partners during scoping, discovery, solution design, and implementation planning.
* Design and validate solution architectures that meet stated and implied business requirements while aligning to Zuora best practices.
* Review partner technical deliverables to ensure compliance with architecture standards, integration patterns, and delivery guidelines.
* Produce and review architecture artifacts such as ecosystem and integration diagrams, process flows, swim lanes, ERDs, and related design documentation.


**Partner Implementation Oversight**
* Serve as a key technical point of contact for partner\-led implementations — supporting partner requirements, internal GS coordination, escalations, product and support alignment, and hypercare activities as needed.
* Help identify technical delivery risks and issues early, and work with partners and internal teams to define mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
* Support Areas of Complexity assessment and validation to ensure the right level of technical oversight is applied throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Provide technical guidance across design, build, test, deployment, UAT, and handoff stages of delivery.


**Partner Enablement \& Practice Development**
* Drive partner technical enablement by identifying capability gaps and supporting technical training, certification, and readiness programs.
* Conduct architecture reviews, office hours, and technical guidance sessions to support partner success on active and upcoming projects.
* Help partners strengthen their Zuora delivery practice through repeatable methods, best practices, and ongoing knowledge sharing.
* Share field feedback from partners and implementations with relevant Zuora teams to improve product adoption and delivery effectiveness.


**Opportunity \& Cross\-Functional Support**
* Partner with Sales, Partner Account Managers, and Global Services to assess partner fit for opportunities and support the right technical delivery model.
* Contribute technical insight during pre\-sales or early project phases to align partner capability with solution complexity and customer expectations.
* Support co\-delivery strategies that balance partner value, delivery quality, and successful customer outcomes.


**About You**
 You may be a great fit if you:
   

  

* Have enterprise\-level experience as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Technical Consultant, or Business Consultant in a professional services, partner delivery, or product\-led consulting environment.
* Have demonstrated experience delivering moderate to complex ERP, billing, revenue, procurement, CRM, or adjacent enterprise transformation solutions.
* Are strong in requirements gathering, business analysis, systems design, integration, implementation, and technical solution documentation.
* Have experience with data migration, interfaces, reporting, testing, and support across end\-to\-end implementations.
* Can simplify complex technical concepts and communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Bring strong executive presence, with the ability to influence partners and internal stakeholders from project teams through senior leadership.
* Are comfortable working across distributed teams and managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced delivery environment.
* Are comfortable working with Finance and business stakeholders, translating business goals into scalable technical solutions.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience working with System Integrators, consulting partners, or partner\-led delivery models.
* Familiarity with partner enablement, technical certification programs, or practice development.
* Experience in both Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Experience presenting architecture recommendations, trade\-offs, and implementation approaches to internal and external audiences.


**About The Team**
*Draft below — please review and edit, Sujith; I wrote this from context in the role details but you know the team's day\-to\-day best.*
 The Partner Delivery Success team sits within Global Services and is responsible for ensuring Zuora’s partner ecosystem can consistently plan, architect, and deliver high\-quality implementations. The team partners closely with Global Services, Sales, Product, Support, and Customer teams to guide solution design, reduce delivery risk, and raise partner technical capability across the ecosystem.
   

  

 Team members work across a distributed, global partner base, balancing hands\-on architecture guidance with enablement and governance. This role offers opportunities to expand technical scope, deepen partner relationships, and gain cross\-functional exposure with Product, Engineering, and senior Global Services leadership.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Zuora offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support ZEOs’ wellbeing, growth, and flexibility. While specific offerings may vary by country, we typically provide:
   

  

* Competitive compensation, variable bonus and performance\-based reward opportunities, and retirement programs
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Generous, flexible time off, plus paid holidays, wellness days, and a company\-wide year\-end break
* Paid parental leave (including fully paid leave for eligible ZEOs, subject to local policy)
* Learning \& development stipend to support ongoing growth
* Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation matching where available
* Mental wellbeing resources and support
* Benefits may vary by location; details will be shared during the interview process


**\#ZEOLife at Zuora**
 ZEOs (our employees) are empowered to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and make a real impact. We:
   

  

* Collaborate deeply across teams and regions
* Learn constantly and iterate often
* Build an inclusive, high\-performance culture where people feel inspired, connected, and valued


**Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace**
*Think, be and do you.*
 At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences, and contributions matter — everyone counts.
   

  

 Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of, and consider individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regard to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

533d2e8a.description:
**This role is for one of the Weekday's clients**
**Salary range: Rs 2200000 \- Rs 2500000 (ie INR 22 \- 25 LPA)**
 Min Experience: 4\+ years
   

  

 Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
   

  

 JobType: full\-time
   

  

 This is a hands\-on pre\-sales role for someone who opens the product and builds the thing rather than talking around it. You'll be the technical voice in the room on the most important deals—sitting across from CFOs, finance leaders, and engineering teams; understanding how a prospect's business actually works; and proving we solve problems most vendors can't crack. You'll write SQL, poke at REST APIs, map data flows, and configure real customer scenarios to own the technical win alongside the AE.
   

  

**Requirements**
****Key Responsibilities****
* Understand customer billing models and configure contracts, pricing, metering, and invoicing accurately
* Translate complex business requirements into clear, structured product workflows and setups for B2B SaaS products, focused on outcomes rather than features
* Run technical discovery with finance, RevOps, and engineering stakeholders — billing model, usage data, source systems, and rev rec requirements before anyone talks about features
* Partner with Sales on live demos, sandbox setups, and RFP responses, building demos tied to the prospect's real scenario: metered plans, usage ingestion, rated invoices, and revenue recognition
* Design the integration — map how usage flows from Postgres, Snowflake, or a warehouse into the platform, flagging idempotency, late\-arriving events, and reconciliation risks before they become implementation problems
* Own the technical win: qualify the deal, separate champion from economic buyer, multi\-thread to the CFO, and de\-risk the build so nothing falls apart post\-sale
* Prepare business case documents and fill RFPs, tying capability to a dollar saved or a risk removed
* Create customer\-specific solution documentation and clean handoff references when transitioning deals
* Act as the voice of the customer internally, feeding structured patterns from discovery back to Product and Engineering


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years total experience with meaningful time in a hands\-on technical role — solutions or sales engineering, forward\-deployed engineering, data engineering, or backend and integrations work. Actual building, not support tickets
* Comfortable writing real SQL (group by, window functions, date logic) and building or debugging REST API integrations; knows the difference between an API and a webhook without thinking about it
* Vendor\-side B2B SaaS product experience, ideally billing, payments, fintech, ERP, or data\-infrastructure adjacent
* Client\-facing in a technical capacity: discovery, PoCs, demos, or implementation calls with real customers
* Comfortable supporting enterprise\-grade deal cycles and multi\-stakeholder buying processes with US or international customers
* Can hold a credible conversation with a CFO and with an engineer on the same day
* CS or engineering degree, or demonstrable equivalent shipped work
* Willing to work US\-overlap hours, roughly 6:00 PM \- 2:00 AM IST on weekdays
* Bonus: Experience at a small company (under 100 people, seed to Series A)
* Bonus: A sense of humor and the ability to not take yourself too seriously


**Required Skills**
 SQL, REST API integrations, Webhooks, Usage\-based billing, Metering \& rating, Revenue recognition, Solution design, Technical discovery, Demo building, RFP responses, Data pipeline mapping, Enterprise sales cycles, Stakeholder management, Business case development, Technical documentation
   

  

**Benefits \& Perks**
* Own the technical win on the company's most important enterprise deals
* Meaningful ESOPs in a fast\-growing startup
* Hands\-on ownership — configure and build in the product, not just present slides
* Direct exposure to CFOs and senior finance leaders at US and international companies
* Direct line into Product and Engineering as the voice of the customer
* Hybrid setup with only 2 fixed office days per week

fc0789ae.title: Solutions Engineer
fc0789ae.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Solution Engineer, you will serve as the customer\-facing advocate for Razorpay suite of products, supporting prospects with technical implementation for large enterprises. This role reports to the Head of Integrations within the Business Engineering team at Razorpay. The individual will play a key role in ensuring the successful integration of Curlec’s platform with merchants, enabling seamless payment solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* This Individual should have a deep understanding of the entire product suite.
* Should be up\-to\-date in the technical knowledge and in\-depth understanding of any coding language is a must.
* Responsible to represent Razorpay from platform integration perspective with prospective merchants.
* Accountable to ensure successful implementation of platform integration between Curlec by Razorpay and merchants.
* Support the reactive queries and requests being raised by Merchants within an agreed turnaround time and quality standards.
* Read and respond to integration and platform documents shared by prospective customers.
* The individual will act as a key feedback channel for customer's product requirements/ expectations and will close the loop with the Product team on the same.
* In the case of product customisation requests from the clients, he/she would help validate the requirements.


**Requirements**
* 2\+ years of experience in product\-based payments or SaaS platform integrations, implementation, or solutions in a customer\-facing role.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
* Hands\-on experience with Java, .NET, PHP, Python, and JavaScript.
* Strong expertise in REST APIs.
* Strong ability to understand technical requirements and ensure seamless platform integration for enterprise clients.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong presentation abilities.
* Preferably from a Fintech background.


 Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.
   

  

 Follow us on LinkedIn \& Twitter

e3d0b607.title: AWS Solutions Architect
e3d0b607.description:
**Job Summary:**




  





 As an AWS Solution Architect, your primary responsibility will be to design and deploy secure, scalable, and highly available AWS cloud\-based solutions for clients. You will work closely with clients, understanding their business requirements, and architecting cost\-effective and efficient solutions that align with their goals. You will also collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including developers, engineers, and project managers, to ensure successful implementation and delivery of AWS solutions.
 



  





**Responsibilities:**




  





 · Design and architect AWS cloud\-based solutions that meet client requirements, ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and performance.
 



 · Collaborate with clients to understand their business needs and translate them into technical requirements and solution designs.
 



 · Assess existing infrastructure and systems, identify opportunities for migration or adoption of AWS services, and create migration plans.
 



 · Develop highly available and fault\-tolerant architecture patterns using AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and others.
 



 · Create technical documentation including solution architecture diagrams, design documents, and deployment guides.
 



 · Conduct code reviews and provide technical guidance to development teams to ensure adherence to AWS best practices and standards.
 



 · Implement and configure AWS services, infrastructure automation, and orchestration using tools like AWS Cloud Formation, Terraform, or Ansible.
 



 · Monitor and optimize AWS resources and services, identifying opportunities for cost optimization and performance improvements.
 



 · Collaborate with operations teams to ensure smooth deployment and ongoing management of AWS solutions.
 



 · Stay up\-to\-date with the latest AWS technologies, services, and best practices, sharing knowledge and insights with the team and clients.
 



  





**Requirements:**




  





 · Proven experience as an AWS Solution Architect or similar role, designing and implementing AWS cloud\-based solutions.
 



 · Strong understanding of AWS services and experience with core services like EC2, S3, VPC, RDS, Route 53, Lambda, and CloudFront.
 



 · Hands\-on experience with infrastructure automation and provisioning tools such as AWS CloudFormation, Terraform, or Ansible.
 



 · Proficient in scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
 



 · Familiarity with containerization technologies like Docker and orchestrators like Kubernetes.
 



 · Strong knowledge of network and security concepts within AWS, including IAM, Security Groups, VPC peering, and VPN.
 



 · Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment and collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
 



 · Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
 



  





 · AWS certifications, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect \- Associate or Professional.

c9e9d6fa.title: Associate Enterprise Architect
c9e9d6fa.description:
**About WSO2:** 




 Founded in 2005, WSO2 is the largest independent software vendor providing open\-source API management, integration, and identity and access management (IAM) to thousands of enterprises in over 90 countries. WSO2's products and platforms—including our next\-gen internal developer platform, Choreo—empower organizations to leverage the full potential of artificial intelligence and APIs for securely delivering the next generation of AI\-enabled digital services and applications. Our open\-source, AI\-driven, API\-first approach frees developers and architects from vendor lock\-in and enables rapid digital product creation. Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has more than 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with over USD100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit
 
 https://wso2\.com
 
 to learn more.
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




 Enterprise Architects are highly visible, enterprise\-grade technical consultants who engage directly with WSO2 prospects and customers. This role is fundamental to establishing definitive thought leadership by providing high\-level consultation and strategic guidance on addressing complex enterprise application challenges using the WSO2 platform.
 



 As an Enterprise Architect, you will be responsible for translating ambitious business goals into technically precise, implementable solutions, directly supporting high\-stakes sales and customer success initiatives.
 



  





**Responsibilities and Duties:** 



* Design custom demos and proof of concepts (POCs) that align with customer business needs. Evaluate RFP technical feasibility. Contribute to RFP responses by outlining technical and business capabilities.
* Map potential technologies to customer business and integration requirements.
* Clearly communicate technical and business benefits in presentations.
* Create high\-quality solution designs that meet customer expectations.
* Develop subject matter expertise in WSO2 products, architecture, industry verticals, and competitive offerings. Apply this knowledge to enhance your personal brand, advise customers, and share expertise with the team.
* Provide feedback to teams on customer feature usage and alignment with design, implementation, and integration. Share architect expectations based on industry standards and developer/DevOps best practices. Raise and follow up on critical product issues and features.
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of technology usage, including but not limited to WSO2 products, evolution, and future predictions within relevant domains and areas of specialization. Actively participate in discussions regarding technology, product features, direction, company vision, and process improvements.
* Lead technical aspects of project deliveries, collaborating closely with the delivery manager/PM. Take technical ownership, manage expectations, and communicate effectively with customers, the product team, service delivery personnel, and the internal team.
* Develop estimates and detailed schedules for complex projects, collaborating with product specialists.
* Communicate schedules clearly to customers and stakeholders, addressing assumptions, dependencies, and responsibilities.
* Conduct paid deployment reviews for customers, reviewing the solution and deployment architecture. Recommend best practices for using WSO2 products, aligning with customer requirements and use cases. Produce architectural review (AR) documents. Follow up on pending/future items with the customer and account manager (AM).
* Conduct technical workshops for customers, partners, and public users. Design workshop content tailored to diverse audiences, including CXOs, architects, developers, and DevOps engineers. Align content (slides, demos) with customer business problems and use cases.
* Assume primary or secondary technical ownership. Lead post\-sales expansions, architectural reviews, and customer engagements. Participate in account planning with AMs. Conduct workshops, webinars, and customer events. Follow up on all post\-sales activities. Build strong customer relationships and become a trusted advisor. Manage multiple accounts and prospects of varying size and complexity.
* Drive business and technical discussions with strategic accounts.
* Lead customer escalations. Collaborate with the support team to resolve critical production issues and conduct root cause analysis. Ensure issue resolution and customer satisfaction. Identify and address underlying problems, developing and implementing solutions.
* Lead and manage team members. Mentor new team members, ensuring role clarity and supporting their professional development.
* Write high\-quality articles, blogs, and content that position you as an expert and drive traffic to WSO2\. Focus on enterprise and business architecture content for CXOs and enterprise architects. Propose innovative concepts and patterns.
* Collaborate with marketing to deliver webinars, events, and public workshops. Design and lead sessions, ensuring market relevance.
* Leverage past experience to enhance team processes, individual skills (through knowledge sharing), and company vision. Adapt and implement successful strategies from previous roles within the WSO2 culture.
* Become an SME in a specific area, leveraging past experiences to improve WSO2\. If no prior experience, develop expertise in a domain, subject matter, or industry vertical.
* Lead technical discussions within the team, demonstrating strong WSO2 product knowledge and a broad understanding of related technologies. Continuously expand technical breadth and share knowledge with the team, WSO2, and the wider community through talks, blogs, and articles.
* Lead and implement practices to enhance team productivity and quality. Initiate, collaborate, and lead tasks to improve team functions across the team, WSO2, and your specific pod/region. Measure the impact of initiatives and ensure their adoption and implementation into business\-as\-usual (BAU) operations.
* Continuously learn and share new ideas, concepts, and technologies with WSO2 and the team. Expand learning beyond technology to encompass areas like architecture, leadership, and management.



  





**Requirements:** 



* BSc in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent.
* At least 8 to 10 years of solid industry experience, with at least 3 years as a Solution Architect or a similar role in Sales Engineering.
* Experience in business, system architecture principles, architecture patterns, processes, and frameworks.
* Exceptional client management and communication skills, ability to mentor team members, and negotiate technical decisions.
* Ability to travel on short notice for short\-term assignments.



  





**In addition, you should:** 



* Be willing to learn MSA, SOA, EDA, enterprise middleware, and cloud computing, while actively participating in the entire process, from design to implementation.
* Exhibit natural curiosity, an analytical mind, and a willingness to explore the unknown.
* Have an affinity for new challenges, a self\-starting attitude, and a willingness to work with a global team.
* Be able to take ownership of complex technical problems and drive them to resolution individually as well as work effectively through escalations with the engineering team.
* Possess an amicable personality and excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including sensitivity to the local cultures of WSO2’s global customer and employee base.
* Have the ability (e.g., passport) to travel overseas.



  





**Benefits:** 




 We want every team member to feel happy, cared for, and energized at WSO2\. That's why, in addition to our performance\-driven commission structure, we offer benefits and facilities designed to support your life and work.
 


* Flexible Leave Policy: We trust you to manage your time and performance. Enjoy a flexible vacation policy as long as you continue to demonstrate your commitment to shared goals.
* Comprehensive Healthcare: Your health is a priority. You are entitled to Health Benefits as detailed in the Company Healthcare plan.
* Essential Equipment: Start strong with a laptop provided as per standard company specifications. You can also request additional equipment like a mouse, keyboard, or monitor to build your ideal workspace.



  





**Diversity Drives Innovation:** 




 We’ve built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it’s important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual’s strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation; it also ensures that we can create superior experiences for our customers, partners and employees worldwide. We value the diversity of our team regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran or marital status, and we do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

c88d1fea.title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
c88d1fea.description:
Yext is the leading global enterprise agentic marketing platform. For over 15 years, the world's most recognized brands in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food have relied on us to keep their brand visible, accurate, and ahead of the competition across every search and AI surface that matters.
   

  

 We drive customer value through our technology, competitive intelligence, and agentic capabilities to win in an AI\-first world. Our partners count on us for strategic, proactive guidance and capabilities, and that distinction shapes everything we build.
   

  

 Our team takes ownership, challenges each other's thinking, and turns ideas into results without waiting for a playbook. Those who perform at Yext are rewarded with increased scope, opportunities to tackle complex challenges, broader responsibilities, and meaningful development that enables them to grow alongside a company expanding through both product innovation and strategic acquisitions. The market is racing to adapt to AI, and Yext is at the forefront of that shift. Our ambitions are big, our innovation is accelerating, and the opportunity in front of us is enormous. If you want to do the most important work of your career, come join us!
   

  

 Yext is actively seeking a
 **Senior Cloud Security Engineer** 
 reporting to the Manager of Product Security within the Cyber Security Office. This role will serve as a core pillar of our Product and Infrastructure Security program, shifting our focus toward robust Cloud Security automation, container security, and Security as Code. The role will enable product, engineering, IT, and security teams to make the right architectural decisions by implementing automated security controls, managing advanced cloud security tools, and leading security incident response efforts. In this role, you will also assist other Cyber Security leaders in driving a culture of security awareness within Yext, promote DevSecOps best practices, and champion cloud compliance initiatives.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Drive Cloud Security Maturity: Lead the maturity of our Cloud and Enterprise Security programs by proactively identifying architectural infrastructure gaps and developing optimized, automated solutions.
* Security as Code \& Guardrails: Design, deploy, and maintain immutable cloud security controls across AWS and GCP environments using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform.
* Container \& Orchestration Security: Define, implement, and monitor security baselines for containerized workloads and orchestration platforms, focusing on Docker and Kubernetes runtime security.
* CI/CD \& DevSecOps Automation: Integrate automated security testing tools (SAST, DAST, dependency, and secret scanning) directly into engineering deployment pipelines.
* Vulnerability \& Patch Management: Oversee the cloud vulnerability scanning program, prioritizing vulnerabilities based on runtime risk and coordinating comprehensive remediation processes across engineering teams.
* Threat Modeling \& Architecture Reviews: Lead comprehensive security architecture reviews and threat modeling sessions for cloud\-native applications, providing actionable technical recommendations to Product and Engineering partners.
* Policy \& Compliance: Author and contribute to cloud security policies, procedures, and standards while mapping technical controls to compliance frameworks like SOC2 and ISO 27001\.


**What You Have**
* Experience: 6\+ years of relevant work experience in Cloud Security Engineering or Product Security
* Cloud Infrastructure Expertise: Deep technical knowledge and hands\-on implementation experience managing security controls within AWS and/or GCP environments.
* Infrastructure as Code: Proven experience utilizing Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi to deploy and manage secure infrastructure.
* Container Security Proficiency: Practical experience securing Kubernetes environments, managing network policies, and scanning container images.
* Security Automation: High proficiency in security automation using Python, Go, PowerShell, or Bash scripting to eliminate manual tasks.
* Framework Familiarity: Strong alignment with security frameworks and standards such as NIST, ISO 27001, or CIS benchmarks.
* Communication \& Collaboration: Strong communication skills and a proven history of collaborating effectively with Engineering, IT, and Product stakeholders to build high\-trust partnerships.


**Nice To Have But Not Required**
* SIEM \& Log Analysis: Strong understanding of centralized logging architectures, SIEM platforms, and data analysis for identifying anomalies.
* DFIR \& Frameworks: Practical knowledge of cloud DFIR methodologies and advanced application of the MITRE ATT\&CK framework to detect and remediate modern threat vectors.
* Certifications: CCSP, AWS Certified Security \- Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, or equivalent cloud security certifications.


 In today's dynamic threat environment, software firms are increasingly acknowledged as a highly\-targeted industry for cyberattacks due to the confidentiality and sensitivity of customer data, as well as the immediacy in which that data is needed to perform their operational duties. Given Yext’s vital role within the software ecosystem, protection of data is paramount in ensuring high\-trust relationships with customers, partners, and vendors.
   

  

 Yext is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a results\-driven, engaging culture where every employee has the opportunity to contribute to the success of the Company, perform at the highest possible level, and grow their skills and capabilities. Yext welcomes employees and applicants of all backgrounds and demographics, and does not engage in discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic recognized under applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. The Company believes a broad variety of life experiences across the Yext team is critical to its mission to help every business in the world be visible everywhere customers search. By seeking out fresh perspectives and fostering a positive interview experience and employee experience, Yext can remain at the forefront of innovation, and better serve its customers.
   

  

 It is Yext’s policy to provide reasonable accommodations to people with disabilities as required by applicable law. If you have a disability that requires an accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, or participating in the employee selection process, please complete this form.
   

  

**Security Alert**
 All legitimate Yext communications come from @yext.com email addresses. Messages from other domains (for example, @yext.team) are not authorized and are likely fraudulent. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, do not share personal information, click on links, or provide payment. Instead, please report the communication to security@yext.com.

8fb73727.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
8fb73727.description:
**About Tekion:** 




 Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud\-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting\-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.
 



 Job Introduction
 



 We are seeking a Staff Technical Program Manager to own the cross\-team delivery machinery for a 20\-person AI native engineering organization. This is not a project coordination role — it is a technical program ownership role. You will maintain the master delivery plan across two Scrum teams and shared resources, track and resolve cross\-team dependencies (platform teams, ARC backend, OEM integrations), manage risk before it becomes a miss, and create the delivery transparency that allows Engineering, Product, and Executive leadership to make fast, informed decisions. The best TPMs are invisible when things go well and indispensable when they don't.
 



 Key Role \& Responsibilities
 


* Own the master delivery plan: maintain the integrated roadmap across both Scrum teams, shared resources (Architect, ML, SDET), and external platform dependencies — with milestone\-level clarity at all times.
* Track and resolve cross\-team dependencies: Agentic Engine, Core Platform (Temporal, MCP Gateway, Component Framework), ARC backend (Kafka event contracts, API dependencies), Design (component specs), and external vendors (email/SMS providers).
* Run the delivery rhythm: sprint review calendar, cross\-team sync cadence, dependency review meetings, and risk escalation forums — keeping the Director and VP Engineering informed without burying them in status updates.
* Identify, quantify, and manage delivery risks: surface blockers early, drive resolution with urgency, and maintain a live risk register with mitigation owners and timelines.
* Own cross\-team technical communication: translate engineering status into language that Product, Business, and Executive stakeholders can act on — and translate business urgency back into engineering trade\-off decisions.
* Drive the release process: define release criteria, coordinate go/no\-go decisions with Engineering, QA (Staff SDET), and Product, and manage production deployments across services.
* Manage the dependency interface to the T1 Agentic Engine team: track which Intent, Skill, Policy, and MCP tool registrations are ready, which are blocked, and what the critical path impact is.
* Continuously improve the delivery system: identify bottlenecks in the engineering process, drive retrospectives, and implement changes that sustainably increase throughput and quality.



 Basic Qualifications
 


* 12\+ years of technical program management experience, with at least 3 years at Staff level managing multi team programs at SaaS or platform companies.
* Strong technical depth: able to read architecture diagrams, understand Kafka dependency graphs, evaluate API contract blockers, and participate credibly in engineering design discussions.
* Proven experience managing complex, multi\-team delivery programs with many external dependencies — including platform dependencies outside your direct control.
* Expert facilitation of engineering delivery rituals: sprint planning, dependency reviews, release gates, post mortems, and architecture syncs.
* Deep understanding of AI\-native product delivery: what makes AI system delivery different from traditional software (eval requirements, model versioning, non\-deterministic outputs, golden dataset dependencies).
* Excellent written communication: can produce a crisp, executive\-readable status update that tells the truth clearly and drives decisions.
* Strong stakeholder management across Engineering, Product, Design, and Executive levels — comfortable managing up, across, and down.



 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Experience managing delivery programs that involve both Java microservices and Python AI/ML engineering teams simultaneously.
* Familiarity with agentic AI platform concepts: intent registries, MCP tools, skill/policy authoring, and eval frameworks — enough to track technical dependency status accurately.
* Background in automotive retail technology or dealer management systems.
* Prior experience working in a US\-India distributed engineering organization.



 Perks \& Benefits
 


* Opportunity to work with some of the smartest minds to solve complex challenges at scale.
* Impactful role in shaping and securing a global, cloud\-native \& AI driven platform.
* Innovative, collaborative, and fast\-paced culture.

1193152a.title: Technical Presales
1193152a.description:
**Job Overview** 




 We are seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented
 **Presales Engineer** 
 or
 **Solution Engineer** 
 to support our cybersecurity practice. The role involves engaging with prospective clients, understanding their security requirements, preparing tailored proposals, coordinating with internal technical teams, and ensuring timely delivery of engagement documentation.
 



 This position bridges the gap between technical delivery and business development, making it ideal for someone with strong communication skills, a good grasp of cybersecurity services, and a client\-centric mindset.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Collaborate with sales and delivery teams to prepare proposals, quotations, and engagement letters for cybersecurity services (e.g., VAPT, SOC 2, ISMS, configuration reviews).
* Understand client requirements, define scope, and map them to appropriate service offerings.
* Prepare project timelines, effort estimations, and commercial documents for client review.
* Participate in client meetings, client followups \& demos, and scoping discussions to support sales closure.
* Maintain a repository of proposal templates, case studies, and collateral for reuse.
* Coordinate with internal delivery teams for input on scope, methodology, and timelines \& preparing presentations.
* Support RFP/RFI responses by providing technical and commercial inputs.
* Track engagement status post\-proposal and assist in handover to the delivery team.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* 2–4 years of experience in presales, bid management, or client engagement in the IT or cybersecurity domain.
* Working knowledge of services such as Vulnerability Assessment \& Penetration Testing (VAPT), ISMS/ISO 27001, SOC 2, and IT GRC.
* Strong understanding of technical scoping and effort estimation concepts.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills (client\-facing experience preferred).
* Proficiency in MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and documentation best practices.
* Ability to coordinate across teams, manage multiple deliverables, and meet deadlines.
* Proactive \& Independent



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
* Certifications such as CEH, or CompTIA Security\+ (optional but preferred).
* Prior experience working with consulting or audit firms in cybersecurity or IT risk advisory.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Exposure to a wide range of cybersecurity domains and global clients.
* Opportunity to work closely with senior consultants and leadership.
* Dynamic and growth\-oriented environment with a focus on quality and innovation.

9be0b531.title: Senior Solution Engineer - Presales
9be0b531.description:
Location: Hyderabad, India
   

  

 Employment Type: Fulltime
   

  

 Compensation: Base Salary, Bonus, Benefits
   

  

**Job Description**
 About Innovapptive
   

  

 Innovapptive is an enterprise SaaS company building an AI\-powered Connected Worker Platform for industrial organizations. Our platform connects frontline workers, back\-office systems, and assets in real\-time to drive safety, reliability, and operational productivity.
   

  

 Leading global enterprises including Shell, Hess, Westlake Chemical, Kimberly\-Clark, Scott Miracle\-Gro, and Newmont Mining, rely on Innovapptive to transform how work gets done across plants and field operations.
   

  

 Our customers have achieved $50M\+ EBITDA savings at a single enterprise, 10× improvement in frontline productivity, and 15–20% reductions in maintenance costs.
   

  

 Innovapptive is recognized as a Leader in Frost \& Sullivan's “Frost Radar 2025 \- Augmented Connected Worker Platforms”, with acknowledgments from Gartner and LNS Research, and is backed by Vista Equity Partners and Tiger Global Management.
   

  

 With headquarters in Houston and an engineering center in Hyderabad, we have 300\+ employees across the U.S., India, and ANZ and are on a strong trajectory toward $100M ARR.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 Innovapptive’s Solution engineering team is made up of passionate group of individuals whose goal is to generate value through consultative selling of our products to our prospects and customers. Through their strong interpersonal and relationship building traits they become trusted advisors to our prospects and customers unearthing their key needs and propose the right solution fit through our platforms and solutions.
   

  

 The role brings exciting opportunities to the individual by providing a platform to be the face of Innovapptive to our clients. The selected candidate will get an opportunity to work as an equal partner along with our expert sales account executives and play an active role in revenue generation for Innovapptive.
   

  

**What You Bring To The Team**
* Bachelor’s degree / master’s in business administration (MBA/ PGDM
* Strong client\-facing communication and inter\-personal skills, with the ability to explain product functionality, technical design and limitations to various levels of prospect/ customer’s organization right from CXO level to Business SMEs, Program Managers and IT Teams
* Strong sales orientation with a consulting mindset
* Minimum of 7 years of strong Pre\-sales or Solution Engineering experience in Enterprise Asset Management or Supply Chain
* At\-least 3\+ years of relevant experience in CMMS Platforms like SAP PM, IBM Maximo etc. as a solution engineer/ functional expert
* Attention to detail, plus analytical and problem\-solving capabilities
* Ability to travel 25%


 Impact You’ll Make
   

  

* Assist the sales personnel in the qualification of Enterprise customer needs and performing pre\-demo needs analysis
* Demonstrations of the product, both standard and tailored to prospects and existing customers, both onsite and via web conference
* Capture prospect/customer requirements and work with sales to write solution proposals detailing how Innovapptive’s solutions will address business needs
* Create necessary documentation, presentations, and product demonstrations to teach clients about Innovapptive’s product functionality and its value proposition
* Participation in one or more strategic account pursuits either in support or as a lead.
* Provide mentoring and training to peers and other colleagues in the organization.
* Scoping and delivering Proof of Concept/Pilot engagements with prospects
* Responding to Request for Information/Proposal documents
* Supporting Marketing events – user conferences, trade shows, webinars etc.
* Staying current on competitive analyses and understanding differentiators between the company and its competitors
* In conjunction with Sales Personnel and Professional Services, conduct transition briefing \- communicate commitments, expectations etc. in preparation for deployment
* Act as the Innovapptive’s subject matter expert at Executive briefings/marketing events
* Understand sales process as it relates to Innovapptive’s overall strategies and objectives


**What We Offer**
* Competitive compensation and equity tied to measurable impact on AI accuracy and performance.
* A platform to shape the semantic intelligence layer of a category\-defining industrial SaaS company.
* Access to cutting\-edge AI, data, and observability toolchains for continuous learning and innovation.


 Innovapptive does not accept and will not review unsolicited resumes from search firms.
   

  

 Innovapptive is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or creed, alienage or citizenship status, political affiliation, marital or partnership status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, childbirth (or related medical conditions), sex, sexual orientation, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, genetic disorder, genetic predisposition, carrier status, military status, familial status, or domestic violence victim status and any other basis protected under federal, state, or local laws.

cc5bc8d5.title: Lead - Solution Engineer
cc5bc8d5.description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
   

  

  

  

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**
  

  

  

 At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise\-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And, over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.
   

  

  

  

***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***



**Job Description**

 We are looking for a passionate and technically skilled
 **Solution Engineer** 
 to be part of our SMBC Sales Support team for Freshservice. You will be instrumental in solving complex customer problems, designing tailored solutions — including AI\-driven use cases built on Freddy AI and Agent Studio — and delivering impactful demonstrations of the Freshworks platform. This role suits individuals with strong pre\-sales experience who thrive on customer interaction, solutioning, and collaborating with internal teams to drive business outcomes, and who are genuinely curious about applying AI to real customer problems rather than just talking about it.
   

  





**Pre\-Sales Engagement \& Customer Solutions:**



* Engage with SMB, mid\-market customers to understand their business and technical challenges.
* Conduct discovery sessions, architect solutions, and deliver tailored product demonstrations and Proofs of Concept (POCs).
* Address technical objections and ensure alignment with customer needs.



**AI Solutioning \& Positioning:**



* Understand and clearly explain core AI/LLM concepts (prompting, agents, model context/tooling) to both technical and business audiences without over\-selling or over\-simplifying.
* Position Freddy AI Copilot, Freddy AI Agent, and Agent Studio within customer discovery, tying AI capabilities to concrete outcomes (ticket deflection, resolution time, agent productivity) rather than generic AI messaging.
* Build and configure simple AI agents and automated workflows in Agent Studio (or comparable agent\-builder tools) to bring AI use cases to life in demos and POCs.
* Field technical AI questions on integration, data handling, and governance, looping in specialists for deeper architecture discussions when needed.



**Solution Design \& Documentation:**



* Participate in gathering requirements and scoping complex engagements.
* Create technical documentation including solution proposals, SoWs, and RFP/RFI responses.
* Evaluate opportunities from a technical feasibility standpoint and proactively mitigate risks.



**Collaboration \& Execution:**



* Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Implementation teams.
* Align technical strategies with sales initiatives to accelerate deal closures.
* Continuously improve pre\-sales tools, processes, and enablement assets.



**Customer Advocacy \& Product Evangelism:**



* Articulate the value and capabilities of the Freshworks platform to both technical and business audiences.
* Represent Freshworks at customer meetings, events, and forums as a trusted technical advisor.
* Keep abreast of product developments and industry trends to provide relevant, up\-to\-date guidance.


**Qualifications**
* **5–8 years** 
 of experience in pre\-sales/solution engineering, technical consulting, or a similar customer\-facing technical role.
* Strong background in SaaS, cloud technologies, APIs, and enterprise software environments.
* Proven experience designing and delivering technical demonstrations and POCs.
* Ability to work with mid\-market and enterprise customers, understand their pain points, and craft effective solutions.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Familiarity with ITSM products and market is a must.
* Solid conceptual understanding of AI/LLM technology — prompting, RAG, agentic workflows, and how AI features are typically integrated into SaaS products; hands\-on experience configuring or building AI agents/copilots (e.g., Agent Studio, similar low\-code agent builders, or LLM APIs) is strongly preferred.
* Ability to credibly position and sell AI value to both business and technical stakeholders, including addressing common AI concerns (accuracy, data privacy, change management).
* This is a Night Shift role only, prior North America Market experience is a must



**Key Skills:**



* Pre\-sales consulting \& technical storytelling
* Solution architecture \& demo delivery
* API, integrations, SaaS product understanding
* Discovery, qualification \& objection handling
* RFP/RFI response and technical documentation
* Stakeholder collaboration (Sales/Product/Engineering)
* Strong communication \& relationship\-building
* AI/LLM concepts (prompting, RAG, agentic workflows) \& positioning
* Hands\-on AI agent/copilot building (Agent Studio or equivalent)


**Additional Information**

 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
 **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

15d4409b.description:
**Location** 
 : Noida/ Bengaluru/ Chennai
 



**Department** 
 : Data \& AI Practice Presales
 



  





**Job Overview** 
 :
 



 HCLTech is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Data \& AI Presales to lead strategic pursuits and drive winning solutions across the Data \& AI portfolio.
 



  





 The role is responsible for leading end\-to\-end presales engagements, orchestrating solution development, collaborating with sales and practice teams, managing customer interactions, and ensuring the delivery of high\-quality, differentiated proposals. The ideal candidate should possess a strong understanding of Data \& AI technologies, consulting\-led solutioning, commercial models, and large\-scale enterprise transformation programs.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**

 :
 




**1\. End\-to\-End Presales Ownership** 



* Own the complete presales lifecycle from opportunity qualification through proposal submission, customer presentations, solution defense, and deal closure.
* Independently drive strategic pursuits without dedicated solution SMEs.
* Translate customer business objectives into scalable, differentiated Data \& AI solutions.
* Act as the single point of accountability for the technical solution throughout the pursuit lifecycle.



  





**2\. Solution Architecture** 



* Design end\-to\-end Data \& AI solution architectures aligned to customer business and technology objectives.
* Develop architecture across data ingestion, integration, engineering, analytics, AI/ML, GenAI, governance, cloud platforms, security, and operations.
* Select appropriate technologies and define reference architectures, implementation approaches, migration strategies, and operating models.
* Identify delivery risks, assumptions, dependencies, and mitigation strategies.



  





**3\. Technical Solutioning** 




 Develop solutions across areas including:
 


* Data Strategy \& Modernization
* Enterprise Data Platforms
* Data Engineering
* Data Governance
* Master Data Management
* Data Quality
* Data Migration
* Databricks
* Snowflake
* Business Intelligence
* Advanced Analytics
* Machine Learning
* Generative AI
* AI Agents / Agentic AI



  





**4\. Proposal Development** 



* Independently author technical proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs), solution documents, executive summaries, and customer presentations.
* Develop solution narratives, value propositions, implementation approaches, and transition strategies.
* Ensure technical accuracy, competitiveness, and alignment with customer requirements.



  





**5\. Estimation \& Commercials** 



* Develop effort estimates, staffing models, implementation plans, and pricing inputs.
* Work with delivery and finance teams to validate commercial assumptions.
* Ensure proposed solutions are technically feasible, commercially viable, and delivery ready.



  





**6\. Customer Consulting** 



* Lead discovery workshops, architecture sessions, and solution discussions with customer stakeholders.
* Conduct executive presentations, proposal walkthroughs, and solution defense sessions.
* Advise customers on Data \& AI transformation roadmaps and technology adoption strategies.
* Serve as a trusted advisor throughout the sales cycle.



  





**7\. Technical Leadership** 



* Stay abreast of emerging technologies and market trends across Data \& AI.
* Develop reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and solution assets.
* Mentor junior presales consultants and contribute to practice capability development.



  





**Experience** 



* 7\+ years of experience in Data \& AI consulting, solution architecture, or technical presales within an IT services organization.
* Demonstrated experience independently leading solutioning for medium to large, complex transformation pursuits.
* Hands\-on expertise in architecting enterprise Data \& AI solutions across cloud platforms.
* Strong experience in effort estimation, proposal development, and executive\-level customer presentations.
* Proven ability to engage directly with CXO and senior business stakeholders.



  





**Preferred Certifications** 



* Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate
* Databricks Data Engineer Professional
* Azure AI Engineer Associate



  





**Key Skills** 



* End\-to\-end solution architecture
* Technical pre\-sales and consulting
* Enterprise Data \& AI architecture
* Proposal writing and solution storytelling
* Estimation and commercial modeling
* Executive communication and presentation
* Customer workshops and solution defense
* Stakeholder management
* Problem\-solving and analytical thinking
* Ability to independently drive strategic pursuits

 of experience in pre\-sales/solution engineering, technical consulting, or a similar customer\-facing technical role.

* Ability to work with mid\-market and enterprise customers, understand their pain points, and craft effective solutions.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal.

* Solid conceptual understanding of AI/LLM technology — prompting, RAG, agentic workflows, and how AI features are typically integrated into SaaS products; hands\-on experience configuring or building AI agents/copilots (e.g., Agent Studio, similar low\-code agent builders, or LLM APIs) is strongly preferred.

**Key Skills:**
