cbefd59f.title: Solutions Architect
cbefd59f.description:
MoEngage is an insights\-led customer engagement platform, trusted by 1,200\+ global consumer brands. As a
 ***Great Place to Work Company,***
 we are a young, fast\-paced, and intelligent customer engagement platform that fosters a culture of innovation, ownership, freedom, and fun while building future\-ready technology products. Sitting at a conflux of diverse technologies like
 *Artificial Intelligence, Big Data, Web, and mobile platforms* 
 , MoEngage technology analyzes billions of data points generated by customers and their devices in order to predict their behaviour and engage them at every touchpoint throughout their lifecycle with personalised communication.
 



  





 In just eight years since our inception, we have worked with
 **leading Fortune 500 brands** 
 such as
 **Deutsche Telekom, Samsung, Ally Financial, Vodafone, and McAfee** 
 along with internet\-first brands such as
 **Flipkart, Ola, OYO, Bigbasket, and Tata Digital,** 
 with a global presence that encompasses
 **35 countries.** 
 We currently have offices in San Francisco, Boston, London, Dubai, Ho Chi Minh City, Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, Sydney, Vietnam, Berlin, Jakarta, and Bengaluru.
 



  





 The care we give to our customers is quite high! Our achievement of top service and support ratings in
 **Gartner's Magic Quadrant, Gartner Peer Insights, and G2 Summer Reports** 
 is a testament to that. Another commendable quality is our people\-centric culture, as we have recently been included in
 **Battery Ventures' top 25 private cloud computing companies** 
 . As recognized by the
 **DivHERsity** 
 Awards, we are one of the top 20 diversity companies in the world, while the
 **Economics Times** 
 names us as one of the Top Organizations for Women.
 



 Will you be able to thrive in a fast\-paced environment where innovation, speed, and customer\-centric thinking are the norm? Is it your passion to uncover opportunities others are unaware of and to champion them? Do you crave ownership and a chance to be a part of something that matters? If so, this may be a worthwhile opportunity for you!
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 As a Solutions Architect, you will be part of the Strategic Customer Success Team that owns the critical early and ongoing phases of the customer lifecycle.
 



  





 Your focus will be to own advising on campaign and reporting deployments of MoEngage’s product and act as the technical counterpoint between MoEngage and the client’s product and engineering team. Working alongside the Customer Onboarding \& Integrations Manager,Strategic Customer Success Manager, and Technical Support Team; you will be responsible for rapidly understanding each customer inquiry and request from a product SME, business, and technical requirements to drive adoption and training for our Strategic fast time\-to\-value.
 



  





 In addition, you will support established Strategic customers that have enterprise architectures and resourcing structures, customizing MoEngage’s product alongside their Strategic Customer Success Manager.
 



  





 This is an opportunity to bring your experience as a product and implementation expert, business analyst, technical support solutions, and customer success professional along with a high level of product and technical competence, delivering onsite engagements and training towards adoption. The role requires a fair amount of curiosity and focus.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 \* Facilitate and support product functionality inquiries and technical aspects of customer on\-boarding to ongoing to maximize TTV (Time to Value) for customers
 



 \* Support and advocate day\-to\-day inquiries and requests to support efficiency and value in the use of MoEngage from onboarding to ongoing
 



 \* Empower customer product and engineering teams to use our product independently and efficiently as possible.
 



 \* Communicate with customers and internal teams to explain products and adoption deployment schedules
 



 \* Document technical requirements, schedules, goals/metrics, and customer interactions
 



 \* Conduct validation for product use\-cases and technical feasibility for product launch
 



 \* Respond to technical concerns and problems, ensuring smooth implementation and launch
 



 \* Engage with customer marketing, product, and engineering teams to understand their goals for using MoEngage and how the platform will fit into their tech stack
 



 \* Support Strategic Onboarding Manager and Success Manager by providing tactical response and strategic solutions to use cases and translating these into actionable steps for customers; including delivering onsite trainings.
 



 \* Contributes to the design of technical and product adoption plans and scopes of work in partnership with the customer to suit their marketing requirements.
 



 \* Support new customers in achieving effective and efficient SDK and API integrations as well as overall deployment of campaigns with MoEngage
 



 \* Design and deliver marketing, product, and technically focused workshops to meet client needs and exceed expectations.
 



 \* Efficiently deliver enablement training and workshops, both online and onsite, to Clients.
 



 \* Troubleshoot technical issues reported by customers during the implementation and ongoing campaign deployment process and provide solutions
 



 \* Provide support to the wider Strategic Customer Success Organization by tackling day\-to\-day needs and responsiveness for functional product and technical use cases.
 



  





**Why Join Us!** 




 At MoEngage, we are passionate about our team and technology \- see below to know more about us.
 



 Life @MoEngage
 



 Tech @MoEngage
 



 Scale @MoEngage
 



 We handle more than a billion messages every day. Rest assured, you will be surrounded by really smart and passionate people as we scale much more to build a world\-class technology team.

6e81a301.title: Product and Solutions Development Manager
6e81a301.description:
**About the role**
==================


As our portfolio shifts toward cloud\-hosted, AI\-enabled, and data\-driven digital health solutions, Data management and AI must be engineered into every layer – from medical device software to multi\-tenant cloud platforms and the data pipelines that connect them.


We are looking for a Senior Expert who unites three dimensions in one profile: digital product software (software development of regulated medical software and SaaS platforms), data platforms(managing sensitive health data end\-to\-end), and AI (include AI in our SaaS platforms and digital services). You will act as a trusted advisor to development teams, product management, and R\&D leadership, and as the owner of the architecture for AI and data platforms, ensuring scalable, secure, reliable, and business\-aligned solutions that enable advanced analytics, machine learning, generative AI, and data driven design making for our digital and cloud portfolio.

**Your tasks and responsibilities**
===================================

**AI \& Data Architecture Strategy**

* Define the long\-term AI and data platform roadmap for one or more product lines and digital solutions
* Establish architecture standards, principles, and best practices and align AI and data initiatives with business objectives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend adoption strategies

**Data Platform Architecture**

* Design enterprise\-scale data platforms, include data lakes, data warehouses and lakehouses
* Define data ingestion, processing, storage and serving architectures
* Ensure scalability, product security, performance, reliability and cost efficiency and drive cloud\-native data platform adoption.

**AI/ML and Generative AI architecture**

* Lead AI solution architectural initiatives from experimentation to production
* Define the AI development lifecycle and provide expertise to different product teams

**Leadership \& collaboration**

* **Coach and mentor** development teams, security champions, and architects across locations, raising the security competence of the organization.
* **Collaborate** with digital functions across sites, product management, and R\&D leadership up to business\-line level to align strategy, standards, and investment priorities.

**Your qualifications and experience**
======================================

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field; a Master’s degree or equivalent advanced qualification is a plus.
* 12\+ years of overall experience in software/product development, with at least 6–8 years across enterprise\-wide technical strategy, data engineering, AI platform architecture, and cloud/digital\- native solutions– preferably in medical devices, healthcare IT, or other regulated industries.
* Experience in designing \& developing digital and medical solutions in Invitro diagnostics is a **MUST**
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience with data pipelines, AI, machine learning, analytics and data platforms. Deep expertise in designing enterprise data platforms, including Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, and Lakehouse architectures.
* Hands\-on experience with technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Databricks, Snowflake, Delta lake and related ecosystems. Experience with data governance, lineage, metadata management, and data quality frameworks.
* Experience designing and deploying machine learning platforms and production AI systems with strong understanding of MLOps and model lifecycle management.
* Experience integrating predictive analytics and machine learning into enterprise products
* Strong understanding of Kubernetes, Containerization, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and platform engineering principles.
* Experience working in Agile/SAFe environments and collaborating with distributed, cross\-functional R\&D teams.

**Your attributes and skills**
==============================

* You combine deep technical expertise with the ability to communicate risk in business terms to senior stakeholders, including R\&D and business leadership.
* You are a pragmatic, results\-driven leader who can balance rigor with product delivery timelines.
* You have a passion for mentoring and building a digital\-first engineering culture.

0cf34e08.title: Cloud Application Modernisation Architect (f/m/d)
0cf34e08.description:
Pune (IND)
  
Software Development
  
Fulltime
  
**Published:** 2026\-07\-29
  
What do we do?
  
Introducing Thinkproject Platform
  
  

Pioneering a new era and offering a cohesive alternative to the fragmented landscape of construction software, Thinkproject seamlessly integrates the most extensive portfolio of mature solutions with an innovative platform, providing unparalleled features, integrations, user experiences, and synergies.
  
  

By combining information management expertise and in\-depth knowledge of the building, infrastructure, and energy industries, Thinkproject empowers customers to efficiently deliver, operate, regenerate, and dispose of their built assets across their entire lifecycle through a Connected Data Ecosystem.
  
What your day will look like
  
  

About the Role
  
  

We are looking for two Cloud Application Modernisation \& Agentic Architects (f/m/d) to own the end\-to\-end refactoring of Thinkproject's application portfolio — 10 applications, 3 of which are major, mission\-critical products. You will work as a pair, splitting application ownership between you, and you are expected to move fast: full refactoring across the portfolio within 6–8 months.
  
  

This is not a design\-and\-delegate role. You will roll up your sleeves, conduct the refactoring hands\-on, and manage the project simultaneously. You are both the engineer and the project manager. You will consume the Service Catalog built by the Cloud Infrastructure \& Agentic Architect and the networking foundation laid by the GCP \& Network Agentic Architect — and turn them into modernised, cloud\-native applications that are more reliable, more scalable, fully observable, and cheaper to run.
  
  

**Time allocation (approximate):**  

\~50% hands\-on application refactoring \& migration \| \~25% project management, planning \& stakeholder coordination \| \~15% collaboration with DevOps, SecOps, Compliance \& SRE \| \~10% observability, testing \& validation
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Application Refactoring \& Modernisation
  
  

Own the end\-to\-end refactoring of your assigned applications — from assessment and design through implementation and validation
  
Apply 12\-factor app principles, event\-driven architecture patterns, and cloud\-native design to legacy codebases
  
Migrate workloads from on\-prem and legacy infrastructure to GCP\-native services: Cloud Run, GKE, serverless functions, managed databases, Pub/Sub
  
Design for scalability and on\-demand resource consumption — cost efficiency is a success metric, not an afterthought
  
Use LLM\-assisted tooling (Claude Code, OpenCode, or equivalent) to accelerate refactoring, code modernisation, and IaC generation
  
  

Project Management \& Delivery
  
  

**Own the migration plan for your applications:** timeline, milestones, dependencies, risks, and rollback strategy
  
Track and report progress with precision \- this is a time\-boxed programme (6–8 months); delays must be surfaced early
  
**Split application ownership with your paired architect:** clear DRI per application, shared standards
  
  

Resilience \& Rollback
  
  

Define and test rollback plans for every application before migration begins \- you have crisis experience and you use it
  
Handle incidents during migration with calm, methodical rollback and root cause analysis
  
Ensure every migrated application meets reliability and observability standards before handover
  
  

Collaboration
  
  

Work closely with DevOps to integrate migrated applications into CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows
  
Collaborate with SecOps and Compliance to ensure every migrated application meets security controls and certification requirements
  
Engage SRE teams to validate observability, SLO definitions, and alerting coverage post\-migration
  
Consume and provide feedback on the Service Catalog — you are one of its primary consumers
  
What you need to fulfill the role
  
  

Required Skills \& Qualifications
  
  

You have migrated complex, production applications from on\-prem to cloud at scale, under time pressure, and lived to tell the story. Specifically:
  
  

Proven on\-prem to cloud migration experience — at scale, under tight time constraints; you have delivered migrations, not just designed them
  
Strong proficiency across both Azure and Google Cloud Platform — networking, infrastructure, and PaaS layers
  
Deep hands\-on experience with Docker, VMs, GKE and AKS node management, and serverless design patterns (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Azure Functions)
  
Strong 12\-factor app knowledge — you apply it in code, not just reference it in presentations
  
Strong event\-driven architecture experience — Pub/Sub, event streaming, async decoupling patterns
  
Crisis and rollback experience — you have handled production incidents during migrations, executed rollbacks cleanly, and conducted honest post\-mortems
  
Proven focus on scalability and on\-demand resource design — your migrations reduce cost, not just shift it
  
**Proven hands\-on agentic experience:** must have used Claude Code, OpenCode, or equivalent LLM\-based coding agents in real engineering workflows
  
Comfortable operating in ambiguity — 10 applications, varying legacy states, evolving requirements; you create clarity
  
  

Nice\-to\-Have (Bonus Skills)
  
  

Strong cloud networking experience (VPCs, firewall rules, private connectivity)
  
FinOps awareness — cost attribution and rightsizing post\-migration
  
Experience with SecNumCloud or C5 compliance in a migration context
  
Prior experience as both engineer and delivery lead on the same programme
  
  

Soft Skills
  
  

Extreme ownership — you own the outcome for your applications, not just the tasks
  
**Strong project management discipline:** you track details, surface blockers early, and never let a deadline slip silently
  
Collaborative by default — you pair well with your counterpart architect and with DevOps, SecOps, SRE, and Compliance
  
**Crisis\-calm:** you have been in production incidents during migrations and know how to lead through them
  
Intense technical curiosity — you follow the market, test new tools, and bring relevant innovations into the refactoring programme
  
**Fact\-driven communicator:** you report progress with data, not narrative
  
  

What success looks like
  
  

**Month 2:** Application portfolio assessed; ownership split agreed with paired architect; migration plan per application documented with milestones, dependencies, and rollback strategy
  
**Month 4:** First 4 applications refactored and in production (2 major \+ 2 add\-on) — observable, scalable, cost\-attributed
  
**Month 6:** 7–8 applications fully migrated; third major application on confirmed migration path or complete; observability standard adopted across migrated apps
  
**Month 8:** All 10 applications refactored and live on GCP; full observability in place; reliability and scalability improvements measured and reported; FinOps baseline established per application
  
  

**Success is defined as:** more reliability, more scalability, full observability, lower cost — across all 10 applications.
  
  

You're probably NOT a fit if
  
  

You have designed cloud migrations but have not personally executed them in production
  
You need a stable architecture foundation before you start — legacy migration means working with what exists
  
You are a specialist in one cloud (Azure or GCP) but not both
  
You treat project management as someone else's job
  
You have not handled a production rollback under pressure
  
What we offer
  
Multicultural team across 7 countries (Germany, France, UK, UAE, Spain, New Zealand, Australia)
  
Hybrid\-first working
  
Continuous learning \& certification budget
  
Open, inclusive, and high\-ownership culture
  
Learning programmes \| Career growth \| Leadership access
  
At Thinkproject, we run feedback cycles that are honest and frequent. We believe the best engineering cultures are built on trust, transparency, and shared ownership — not hierarchy. Our Pune team is a core part of a global organisation, collaborating across time zones with colleagues in Germany, France, the UK, UAE, Spain, New Zealand, and Australia.
  
  

Hybrid working \| Work from abroad \| Flexible working hours \| Thinkproject Academy \| Free English lessons \| Unlimited learning \| Headspace community access \| Women's Network \| Corporate volunteering \| Social events
  
  

We are a passionate bunch here. To join Thinkproject is to shape what our company becomes. We take feedback from our staff very seriously and give them the tools they need to help us create our fantastic culture of mutual respect. We believe that investing in our staff is crucial to the success of our business.
  
  

**Your contact:**  

Mehal Mehta
  
  

How to apply
  
Submit your application at careers.thinkproject.com, including:
  
  

Salary expectations
  
Potential start date
  
A short write\-up (max 300 words) on the most complex on\-prem to cloud migration you have delivered \- what went wrong, how you handled it, and what the outcome was, this is the most important part of your application
  
  

Working at thinkproject.com \- think career. think ahead.

77d71a7f.title: Tech Lead – Automation Solutions (Power Platform, K2) - Husky (Guindy, Chennai)
77d71a7f.description:
At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.



Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state\-of\-the\-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.



Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

  


**Job Description**



Are you ready to shape the next generation of enterprise automation while keeping mission\-critical workflows running smoothly?



As Tech Lead for the Automation Team, you will play a pivotal role in Husky’s transition from legacy workflow platforms to a modern, scalable automation landscape centered on the Microsoft Power Platform. You’ll lead by example—guiding your team in designing, governing, and delivering Power Apps and Power Automate solutions—while also ensuring the reliability, continuity, and evolution of existing automation solutions such as K2\.



This role sits at the intersection of innovation and responsibility: driving modernization, setting technical standards, and mentoring engineers, while safeguarding the automation backbone that supports our global business operations.



If you enjoy combining hands\-on technical leadership, platform thinking, and pragmatic enterprise automation, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.


**Responsibilities**


**Technical Leadership**


* Understand the E2E high level architecture (big picture)
* Translate the HLD (high level design) into the LLD (low level design) in collaboration with architects and own the LLD
* Technical direction for the product area
* Contribute to coordinating cross\-team dependencies and integration points


**Delivery \& Execution Excellence**


* Contribute to the feature definition and review
* Generate concepts and facilitate the concept selection
* Breaking down complex features into actionable tasks
* Helping with estimation and sprint planning
* Addressing technical impediments
* Own production readiness (incl. non\-functional requirements)


**Quality, Governance \& Security**


* Ensuring quality
* Conducting meaningful reviews and ensuring adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) / DoD (Definition of Done) criteria
* Ensure adherence to applicable standards, policies, and practices (e.g. DevSecOps)


**Incident Response**


* Leading incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post\-mortems


**Mentorship \& Team Growth**


* Mentoring team members
* Documenting key design decisions
* Participate in interviews and hiring decisions
* Promoting engineering best practices and driving continuous improvement


**Collaboration \& Communication**


* Act as the primary technical point of contact across Product, Architecture, and Platform teams
* Clearly communicate technical decisions and trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.
* 10\+ years professional experience in software development, 5\+ years’ experience with Power Platform
* **Power Platform Expertise**
* Deep, hands\-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including: Power Apps (Canvas \& Model Driven)
* Power Automate (cloud flows, approvals, error handling)
* Dataverse (data modeling, security, performance)
* Proven ability to design enterprise\-scale Power Platform solutions
* Strong understanding of solution layering, Application Lifecycle Management, and environment strategies
* **Power Platform Governance**
* Hands\-on experience implementing Power Platform governance, including DLP policies, environment strategies, Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit
* Strong understanding of: Role\-based security in Dataverse
* Tenant\-level Power Platform administration
* Experience working in regulated or enterprise environments (e.g., GDPR, ISO, SOC)
* **Azure \& Microsoft Ecosystem**
* Solid experience in integrating Power Platform with Azure services (Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Entra AD) and Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive)
* Experience with authentication and authorization: Entra AD, OAuth, service principals, managed identities
* **DevOps \& ALM**
* Proven experience with Power Platform ALM, including: Managed vs unmanaged solutions
* Versioning and deployment strategies
* **Experience with:**
* Azure DevOps or GitHub
* CI/CD pipelines for Power Platform
* Automated testing strategies (where applicable)
* Familiarity with source control best practices for low\-code assets
* **Development \& Customization Skills**
* Strong proficiency in: Power Fx
* JavaScript (for model\-driven apps)
* Understanding data modeling best practices and normalization
* Experience working with web services / APIs (e.g., SOAP, REST)
* Working knowledge of Agile development practices
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team
* Fluency in English (spoken and written)
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Ability to adjust quickly to changing assignments, and priorities


**Assets**

74024fcc.description:
Job Title
   

  

 Solution Architect
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job title:** 
 IT Solution Architect
   

  

**Job Grade:** 
 60
   

  

**You Are Responsible For**
* Defining and governing solution and data platform architecture aligned with enterprise architecture principles, business strategy, and technology standards.
* Translating business, product, and data requirements into scalable end\-to\-end solution designs and target architectures.
* Designing data platforms and ecosystems including ingestion, integration, storage, processing, analytics, and consumption layers.
* Establish architecture patterns and standards for cloud\-native, event\-driven, API\-first, and data\-centric solutions.
* Define platform capabilities across data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouses, streaming, and real\-time processing environments.
* Ensure solution designs meet Non\-Functional Requirements including scalability, reliability, availability, performance, observability, and cost optimization.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Business SMEs, Engineering teams, Platform Architects, and DevSecOps teams to ensure successful implementation.
* Drive technology selection, architecture assessments, and proof\-of\-concept activities for new platform capabilities.
* Define integration patterns across enterprise applications, cloud services, APIs, and external platforms.
* Establish security, governance, compliance, and data protection controls aligned with enterprise policies.
* Lead architecture reviews and resolve cross\-team design conflicts, dependencies, and technical risks.
* Define reference architectures, reusable components, and implementation guardrails to accelerate delivery.
* Guide data management practices including data modeling, metadata, lineage, quality, and governance.
* Support CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and platform automation practices to enable reliable delivery.
* Own architecture roadmaps and transition plans from current\-state to target\-state platforms.
* Enable end\-to\-end observability and operational excellence across solution and data platforms.
* Support adoption of analytics, AI/ML, and self\-service data capabilities where applicable.
* Contribute to architecture communities and promote continuous improvement and engineering best practices.


**You Are Part Of**
* Services IT organization
* Data Insights \& Analytics team


**Data Insights \& Analytics team** 
 plays a critical role in enabling data\-driven decision\-making and accelerating digital transformation across the enterprise. The organization focuses on leveraging data, analytics, artificial intelligence, and automation technologies to improve operational efficiency, enhance customer experience, and drive business growth. By collaborating with cross\-functional teams, business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams, the organization delivers scalable and secure digital solutions aligned with strategic business objectives.
   

  

**To succeed in this role, you should have the following skills and experience**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in data engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data \& AI platform architecture, and digital transformation initiatives, preferably within the healthcare domain.
* Strong expertise in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines for enterprise data platforms, and for AI\-enabled solutions.
* Strong experience in defining enterprise data architecture, including conceptual, logical, and physical data models, data domains, canonical models, and data standards.
* Proven ability to design data architectures that support analytics, reporting, AI/ML, operational data products, master data management, and enterprise\-wide data reuse.
* Experience in establishing data governance, metadata management, lineage, data quality, access management, retention, and privacy\-by\-design principles across data platforms.
* Hands\-on knowledge of modern data architecture patterns such as lakehouse, domain\-oriented data products, and event\-driven data integration.
* Hands\-on experience in programming, scripting, database technologies, and data integration frameworks including ETL/ELT processes and big data technologies.
* Proven experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, deployment strategies
* Proficiency in Microsoft Azure cloud platforms
* Strong understanding of security, governance, compliance, vulnerability management, and secure software development lifecycle practices.
* Strong strategic thinking, systems thinking, problem\-solving, and innovation capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in both individual contributor and collaborative team environments.
* Strong project management, stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills with the ability to engage effectively with leadership and cross\-functional global teams.
* Proven experience working in cross\-cultural and global environments with strong collaboration skills across architects, business stakeholders, platform teams, and engineering teams.
* Demonstrated ability to drive automation, operational excellence, platform optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience in software validation and quality assurance processes is preferred.


**How We Work At Philips**
 Our newly adopted hybrid work concept fuses flexibility with collaboration to deliver great outcomes for our people and our customers. We are embracing an approach wherein we spend more time together than apart – which for full\-time employees translates to an average of at least 3 days working from the office and up to 2 days from home – for our hybrid roles.
   

  

 Hybrid work flexibility means people can meet the changing demands of work and home in the most balanced, productive, and healthy way.
   

  

**Why should you join Philips?**
 Working at Philips is more than a job. It’s a calling to create a healthier society through meaningful work, focused on innovative, customer\-first health technology solutions. Help us improve the health and well\-being of billions of people, every year. Ultimately creating a career that no one could have planned for. Even you.
   

  

 Visit our careers website to explore what it’s like working at Philips, read stories from our employee blog, find information about our recruitment process and answers to some frequently asked questions.
   

  

**About Philips**
 We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
   

  

* Learn more about our business.
* Discover our rich and exciting history.
* Learn more about our purpose.


 If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here.

Job Description:
  

Job Summary:  

The SAP Basis \& Cloud ALM Technical Engineer is responsible for operational support in SAP S/4HANA deployments and supporting, administering and optimizing SAP technical platforms and SAP Cloud ALM in a post go\-live application maintenance environment. Collaborates within a global team and works closely with business stakeholders, partners and cross\-functional teams to ensure stable, secure and high\-performing SAP landscapes. The role focuses on technical operations, monitoring, release management, transport management, system stability and continuous improvement. In addition to supporting SAP S/4HANA deployments, the role will also provide technical support for SAP ECC landscapes where required.
  

Key Areas of Responsibility
  

* Support SAP Basis and SAP Cloud ALM activities aligned to the global template and deploy the global SAP S/4HANA implementation on a local level while providing technical support for SAP ECC landscapes where required.
* Perform administration, monitoring and maintenance of SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP HANA Database and supporting technical components.
* Configure and support SAP Cloud ALM for Business Process Monitoring, Health Monitoring, Integration Monitoring, Job \& Automation Monitoring and Alert Management.
* Configure and support SAP Cloud ALM Change \& Deployment Management, including Release Calendar Management, Release Planning, Deployment Planning, Transport Management, Transport Orchestration, Deployment Tracking and Release Execution across SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA landscapes.
* Perform system installations, upgrades, kernel upgrades, support package implementation, client administration, system refreshes and transport management activities.
* Support SAP landscape maintenance activities including maintenance windows, transport sequencing, technical cutovers, production deployments and post\-deployment validation.
* Monitor and optimize SAP system performance, database growth, workload distribution, memory utilization and capacity planning.
* Support backup, recovery, disaster recovery, high availability and archiving activities.
* Support SAP S/4HANA deployment activities including technical readiness, system migrations, cutover planning, go\-live and hypercare support.
* Collaborate with Functional Consultants, Infrastructure, Security, Network, Database and AMS partners to ensure stable SAP operations.
* Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, monitoring dashboards and knowledge articles.

Critical Experiences and Skills
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree preferably in Engineering, Information Technology or a related technical field.
* Hands\-on experience in SAP Basis administration across SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA landscapes.
* Strong technical knowledge of SAP Basis Administration, SAP HANA Database, Transport Management System (TMS), Client Administration, Kernel Upgrades, Support Package implementation, Performance Tuning and System Administration.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP Cloud ALM, including Business Process Monitoring, Health Monitoring, Integration Monitoring, Job \& Automation Monitoring, Alert Management, Change \& Deployment Management, Release Calendar Management, Release Management, Transport Management and Transport Orchestration.
* Experience supporting SAP landscape maintenance activities including maintenance windows, transport sequencing, production deployments and technical cutovers.
* Experience working in a global application maintenance support environment.
* Good understanding of High Availability, Disaster Recovery, Backup \& Recovery, SAP Security and SAP system architecture.
* Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA deployment, technical migration and HANA database administration.
* Experience working with cloud\-hosted SAP environments (Azure, AWS or GCP) is an advantage.
* SAP Basis, SAP HANA Administration and/or SAP Cloud ALM certification is an advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, complex and highly integrated business environment.

Grading Differentiators
  

* Good knowledge of SAP Basis Administration, SAP Cloud ALM and SAP HANA platform.
* Operates independently within assigned technical scope and delivers with limited supervision.
* Able to resolve moderately complex technical issues across integrated SAP landscapes.
* Contributes effectively to support, enhancement and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**

**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 Are you an experienced Cloud architect/developer who can assist our customers in Application modernization, Design and development of cloud native applications and/or re\-engineering applications that can fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like to work on a variety of game changing projects, at the forefront of application development and cloud technology adoption? This role is open for Delhi/NCR.
   

  

 As an architect you would champion applications to be cloud optimized by making them well\-architected ,enabling them to reap the benefits of elasticity, horizontal scalability, automation and high availability. You should have a knack of GenAI tooling to driving application modernization at scale with GenAI tools.
   

  

 On the AWS platform services such as Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling, Elastic Load Balancing, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Amazon Elastic Container Services to name just a few, provide opportunities to design and build cloud ready applications.
   

  

 AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands on technical architects to help accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. This is an opportunity to join Amazon’s world class technical teams, working with some of the brightest engineers while also developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies.
   

  

 Professional Services engage in a wide variety of projects for internal customers and partners, providing collective experience from across the AWS customer base and are obsessed about success for the internal customers. Our team collaborates across the entire AWS organization to bring access to product and service teams, to get the right solution delivered and drive feature innovation based upon customer needs.
   

  

 Amazon aims to be the most customer centric company on earth. Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low\-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers critical applications for hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 We are looking for hands on Mig and Mod (MM) Architects with:
   

  

* Strong Consulting, client\-facing (CXO) level communication driving cloud solutioning and leading technical workshops
* Ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders into implementable solution adhering to well architected framework.
* Problem\-solving and analytical thinking driving envisioning , presales and be a thought leader in the domain driving Application discovery , Risk mitigation strategies, Performance testing and validation, Migration and Post\-migration optimization
* Deep expertise in large scale cloud migrations, and AWS infrastructure to drive complex cloud transformation journey from Onprem successfully modernizing them to help realize true value from cloud
* Deep expertise in VMware technologies having worked on vSphere administration, vCenter management, NSX networking, vSAN storage, HCX for migrations, VMware Cloud on AWS
* Ability to drive Migration discovery to Mobilize to lead and drive Migration and Modernization end to end.
* Strong experience on Cloud Infra, network, Security and cloud resiliency (DR)

* hand\-on experience in designing and developing web applications, APIs, microservices, and data integrations for cloud native applications
* Knowledge of cloud\-native design patterns, including microservices architecture and event\-driven systems.
* Demonstrated experience building scalable and highly available applications on AWS, leveraging services such as Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, etc.
* Preferred experience in optimizing cloud\-based architectures for scalability, security, and high performance.
* Experience working in Agile development environments, with a strong focus on iterative delivery and continuous improvement.
* Ability to advise on and implement AWS best practices across application development, deployment, and monitoring


**Additional Desired Skills**
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
* Scripting (Python, PowerShell)
* CI/CD pipelines
* Programming Skill with Java, .Net
* Container technologies

 Diverse Experiences

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**Preferred Qualifications**

b807a7a7.title: Client Engagement Manager
b807a7a7.description:
Join our dynamic Customer Engagement team as a Manager \- Client Engagement, where you'll drive measurable business outcomes, accelerate client adoption of GRAVTY®, and strengthen strategic relationships across our Global Key Accounts.!
 



  





 Loyalty Juggernaut (LJI) is a leading B2B SaaS company redefining how enterprises drive customer engagement and loyalty. Our flagship platform, GRAVTY®, enables global brands to transform loyalty programs into measurable, revenue\-generating growth engines.
 



 Built as an AI\-first, next\-generation solution, GRAVTY® empowers organizations to deliver highly personalized, real\-time experiences at scale—helping them increase customer lifetime value and deepen brand relationships.
 



 Headquartered in Palo Alto, California, LJI partners with leading enterprises across 16 major industries including airlines, retail, hospitality, financial services and telecommunications powering some of the most innovative loyalty ecosystems worldwide.
 



  





**Our Global Impact:** 



* 400\+ Million members connected through our platform.
* 100\+ Global Brands trust us to drive loyalty and brand devotion.
* 3\-Time Winner of “Best Technology Innovation in Loyalty”.
* Global recognitions for Excellence in Loyalty Management under numerous categories.
* Recognized as a ‘Strong performer’ in The Forrester Wave™ Loyalty Platforms, Q4 2025\.



  





 Explore more about us at www.lji.io.
 



  





**The OPPORTUNITY** 




 As the Manager – Client Engagement, you will take end\-to\-end ownership of account strategy, client engagement, relationship continuity, value realization, governance, account health, renewals, and expansion for a portfolio of enterprise customers. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will build long\-term strategic relationships while ensuring customers achieve measurable business outcomes from the GRAVTY® platform.
 



  





 In this role, you will play a pivotal role in driving Net Revenue Retention (NRR), accelerating AI adoption, and maximizing Client Lifetime Value (CLTV). You will ensure that enterprise customers realize the full value of GRAVTY®, proactively identify opportunities for growth and innovation, and partner closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences and sustained business success.
 



  





**What will you DO:** 




  





**Client Leadership \& Strategic Ownership** 



* Own and manage engagement for Global strategic and Key accounts, ensuring program success and maximizing GRAVTY® adoption
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, aligning their business objectives with GRAVTY®’s capabilities.
* Develop and execute strategic account plans, ensuring alignment with LJI’s Client Engagement OKRs
* Drive governance, executive alignment, and client advocacy, ensuring long\-term partnerships



  





**Governance \& Execution Excellence** 



* Oversee governance models to ensure all client requests, program roadmaps, and deliverables remain on track.
* Work cross\-functionally with Client Delivery, Product, and Sales/Presales to ensure seamless execution.
* Monitor client engagement outcomes across the portfolio i.e. product adoption, retention (GRR/NRR), expansion ARR, CSAT, and customer advocacy.
* Drive engagement discipline through account hygiene, account health trends, renewal risk signals, expansion pipeline coverage, QBR and executive connect cadence etc.



  





**Account Ownership and Orchestration** 



* Act as the voice of the client inside Loyalty Juggernaut
* Translate client priorities into internal actions and ensure executive discussions become tracked execution
* Support adoption readiness, success validation, feedback capture, and transition to steady\-state
* Maintain stakeholder alignment, communication, risk visibility, and the value narrative
* Own Partnership plan, Recurrence cadence, Health Baseline, QBRs, Executive connects, Adoption analysis, Renewal readiness, Expansion signals, and Account strategy



  





**Innovation \& Transformation** 



* Drive AI and product expansion, positioning GRAVTY® as an essential platform for client success.
* Identify and address gaps in client engagement strategies, ensuring a proactive approach to risk and opportunity.
* Influence the product roadmap based on client insights and market trends.



  





**You will be a GREAT FIT if you have:** 




**Experience \& Expertise** 



* 5\+ years in Client Engagement, Account Management, or Client Services, ideally within CRM, loyalty, SaaS AI or technology\-driven industries
* A strong track record of managing enterprise accounts, driving growth, and achieving measurable success.








**Strategic \& Commercial Acumen** 



* Proven ability to align client needs with commercial objectives, driving NRR, CLTV growth, and AI adoption.
* Experience managing C\-level and senior stakeholders, with strong influencing skills.








**Operational \& Governance Mastery** 



* Experience or familiarity with project management methodologies such as Agile, SAFe, and SCRUM.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, ensuring focus on strategic objectives.








**Communication \& Relationship Building** 



* A confident and articulate communicator who can build trust and credibility with both mid\-level and senior stakeholders within client organizations.
* Strong ability to manage complex client relationships, ensuring alignment between LJI’s solutions and client business objectives.
* Adept at navigating cross\-functional discussions, collaborating with internal teams such as Client Delivery, Product, and Engineering to ensure seamless execution.
* Proactive in identifying potential risks or concerns, ensuring that issues are addressed before they escalate.
* Skilled at delivering clear, structured client communications, whether through formal presentations, business reviews, or day\-to\-day account management.








**Self\-Starter \& Problem Solver** 



* A highly motivated, independent thinker who takes initiative and ownership of client engagements without needing constant direction.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving, high\-growth SaaS environment, balancing multiple priorities while maintaining strategic focus.
* Ability to assess challenges critically, offering practical, data\-driven solutions that drive results for both the client and LJI.
* Proactively seeks out efficiencies and process improvements, ensuring that account management remains structured and effective.
* Resilient in managing client demands, internal challenges, and operational hurdles, ensuring that momentum is sustained across all client interactions.



  





**Why should you consider US?** 



* Work with top\-tier global brands, shaping their loyalty strategies and driving industry innovation.
* Lead high\-impact client engagements in a fast\-scaling, empowered work environment.
* Collaborate with world\-class teams on cutting\-edge AI and loyalty solutions.
* Make a real impact—this is not just account management; this is strategic leadership.

19616465.title: Software Engineer, Full Stack, Cloud
19616465.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
* 2 years of experience with full stack development, across back\-end such as Java, Python and front\-end experience including Angular, JavaScript or TypeScript or equivalent.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.
* Experience integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into enterprise products, building agentic workflows, orchestrating tools, or leveraging semantic frameworks like Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Experience building scalable data pipelines (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow) and working with semantic data layers.
* Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM), role\-based access control (RBAC), and resolving system vulnerabilities.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



Google Cloud accelerates global digital transformation by delivering enterprise\-grade solutions that help organizations grow and solve their most critical business problems at Google scale. As Google Cloud marches toward becoming a $100B\+ business, our primary objective at the Google Cloud Business Platform (GCBP)—the product and engineering organization that builds the platforms driving Cloud Marketing, Sales, Partners, Support, and Finance—is to enable this massive scale. Because over 70% of enterprise purchasing decisions are influenced or delivered by partners, the Partner Engineering organization is a key contributor to this growth, managing the entire partner journey. This organization ensures partners can securely onboard, map complex corporate hierarchies, and govern sensitive data access, while also building the public discovery and search engines that connect Google's customers with certified partners.  

  

Within this lifecycle, the Partner Program and Platform Team owns the central portals, automated evaluation engines, and performance metrics that drive partner growth. On the external side, we build the unified portal that serves as the single digital front door for all Google Cloud partner interactions. Through this portal, our platforms programmatically evaluate and deliver the tiering levels and technical credentials that serve as our partners' commercial livelihood—credentials that directly dictate their profit margins, financial rebates, market credibility, and eligibility for Google\-led sales leads. We also track their technical solutions and customer deployment plans, serving transparent performance scorecards that allow resellers, service providers, and software builders, as well as internal partner development managers, to easily monitor their business health. On the internal side, we unify disparate data sources to provide a single, consistent version of truth, powering the management dashboards and strategy tools used by Google's own sales and operations leaders. By transforming complex business telemetry into clean, searchable concepts and deploying conversational AI assistants for both external partners and internal Googlers, we empower both audiences to query data safely and make better, faster decisions to accelerate global growth.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Write product or system development code.
* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

Manages multiple projects collaboratively. Works with HR in recruitment and performance appraisal process. Mentor the team members and layout their growth path.**Role Summary**

Ensure AI solutions move from concept to pilot to scaled deployment, and ultimately to sustained adoption. Own delivery outcomes across initiatives, including scope, timelines, and measurable business impact.

**2\) Program \& Portfolio Delivery:** Lead a portfolio of AI use cases and programs across the enterprise. Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and translate into practical application.

**5\) Adoption, Change \& Value Realization:** Drive business adoption of AI solutions, not just delivery. Define metrics and success measures and track realization of expected outcomes. Partner with HR / change / comms teams to support workflow integration and behavior change. aa4e4d2c.title: Technical Program Manager II - GRC Modernization & Governance Process
aa4e4d2c.description:
**About Us** 




  





**slice** 




 A new bank for a new India
 



  





 slice’s purpose is to make the world better at using money and time, with a major focus on building the best consumer experience for your money. We’ve all felt how slow, confusing, and complicated banking can be. So, we’re reimagining it. We’re building every product from scratch to be fast, transparent, and feel good, because we believe that the best products transcend demographics, like how great music touches most of us.
 



  





 Our cornerstone products and services: slice savings account, slice UPI credit card, slice UPI, and slice business are designed to be simple, rewarding, and completely in your control. At slice, you’ll get to build things you’d use yourself and shape the future of banking in India. We tailor our working experience with the belief that the present moment is the only real thing in life. And we have harmony in the present the most when we feel happy and successful together.
 



  





 We’re backed by some of the world’s leading investors, including Tiger Global, Insight Partners, Advent International, Blume Ventures, and Gunosy Capital.
 



  





  





**About the role** 




  





 If you’re a TPM who builds systems, drives decisions at senior levels, and wants real ownership over
 



 something that actually matters in a fast\-scaling regulated fintech \- this role was written for you.
 



  





**You will own two things at once:** 



* Modernize how GRC operates at slice \- replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual workflows with scalable, platform\-grade systems. Drive tooling selection, automation, and integrations across GRC.
* Run our most critical governance programs \- own the operating cadence for ITSC, FMC, board reviews, regulatory submissions, policy lifecycle, and executive reporting.



  





  





**What You will do** 




  





**GRC Platform Modernization** 



* Design the target\-state for how GRC operates at slice \- what gets automated, platformed, and why
* Drive evaluation and onboarding of GRC tooling (policy lifecycle, risk registers, evidence management, audit workflows)
* Build integrations between GRC platforms and engineering systems (Jira, Confluence, SIEM, cloud security) \- single source of truth
* Replace spreadsheets and email threads with automated, auditable, scalable workflows
* Define data models for risk, controls, and policy linkage \- powering real\-time CISO, VPs and board dashboards
* Automate evidence collection, policy review reminders, action tracking, and SLA enforcement



  





**Governance Forums \& Operating Cadence** 



* Own the full cadence for ITSC, FMC, CAB, and board\-level reviews \- agenda, pre\-reads, decision logging, action closure
* Drive decision velocity: surface the right risks, trade\-offs, and dependencies to the right leaders at the right time
* Own program rigor (RAG, RAID, escalation paths) as a system \- not a spreadsheet



  





**Regulatory \& Risk Program Execution** 



* Translate regulatory expectations (RBI, ISO 27001, SOC) into execution plans with clear owners, milestones, and evidence maps
* Build evidence\-readiness infrastructure so the team is never caught off\-guard in an audit
* Coordinate across Tech, InfoSec, Risk, Legal, and Finance to deliver cross\-functional programs at speed



  





**Policy \& Control Lifecycle as a Product** 



* Run the annual policy review workflow like a product: intake, versioning, reviews, approvals, publication \- automated where possible
* Map policies to risk taxonomies and regulatory control frameworks
* Build dashboards showing coverage gaps, aging reviews, and control effectiveness trends



  





  





**What You will need** 




  





**Must Have:** 



* 5\-10 years of Technical Program Management \- owning complex, cross\-functional programs end\-to\- end
* Experience in or adjacent to security, risk, compliance, IT audit, or regulated tech environments
* Track record of process modernization: you’ve identified broken workflows and rebuilt them as scalable systems
* Proven ability to drive decisions across senior engineering and business stakeholders
* Executive communication: crisp decks, clear narratives, complexity translated into decisions
* High ownership mindset \- proactive, follows through, pushes programs to closure



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Hands\-on experience evaluating or implementing GRC tools (ServiceNow GRC, MetricStream, Archer, or similar)
* Experience in fintech, banking, or deeply regulated tech environments
* Familiarity with ISO 27001, SOC 2, or RBI framework alignment
* Experience building dashboards or automation workflows (Power BI, Looker, Python, Jira
* automation)



  





  





**Why this role stands out** 




  




* Most GRC roles hand you a spreadsheet and a compliance calendar. This one hands you a greenfield build problem.
* Real Ownership \- you own programs end\-to\-end, not coordinate tasks for someone else’s agenda
* Greenfield Opportunity \- GRC modernization at slice is being built from scratch; you define the architecture
* Executive Visibility \- work directly with the CTO, CISO, and CRO; present to board\-level forums
* Rare Domain Combination \- tech TPM skills \+ regulatory fluency \+ executive storytelling in one role
* Visible Impact \- when you build it right, every audit, board review, and regulatory submission runs better



  





  





**Life at slice** 




  





 Life so good, you’d think we’re kidding:
 



  




* Competitive salaries. Period.
* An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees \& their dependents. We’ll love you and take care of you, our promise.
* Flexible working hours. Just don’t call us at 3AM, we like our sleep schedule.
* Tailored vacation \& leave policies so that you enjoy every important moment in your life.
* A reward system that celebrates hard work and milestones throughout the year. Expect a gift coming your way anytime you kill it here.
* Learning and upskilling opportunities. Seriously, not kidding.
* Good food, games, and a cool office to make you feel at home. An environment so good, you’ll forget the term “colleagues can’t be your friends”.

* Knowledge of database monitoring tools and techniques

**Job Title: Java Architect – Integration Engineering**
**Location:** 
 Pune, India
   

  

**Team:**

**About Anchanto**
 Anchanto is a global SaaS technology company powering eCommerce automation and logistics solutions for enterprises and 3PLs. Our Integration Engineering team builds scalable, robust, and high\-performance integrations connecting our products with marketplaces, ERPs, WMS, OMS, and other enterprise systems worldwide.

 **Java Architect**

 **driving AI adoption in our development processes** 
 , leveraging emerging tools and techniques to enhance productivity and code quality.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a
 **Java Architect – Integration Engineering** 
 , you will:
   

  

* Define and enforce integration architecture standards, design patterns, and development best practices for the team.
* Lead the end\-to\-end design and development of integrations with diverse internal and external systems using Spring Boot and modern Java frameworks.
* Engage directly with customers to understand their integration requirements, processes, and business objectives.
* Collaborate with solution team to define, document, and finalize integration design, architecture, and data mapping.
* Champion AI\-driven development practices, integrating tools like Cursor AI and other AI\-assisted coding solutions into the team’s workflow.
* Partner with Product Management, Pre\-Sales, and Implementation teams to translate business needs into scalable technical designs.
* Guide and mentor engineers, fostering technical excellence, innovation, and AI adoption within the integration team.
* Be hands\-on in building Proof\-of\-Concepts (POCs), solving complex integration challenges, and driving mission\-critical deliveries.
* Collaborate with leadership to shape the roadmap for integration products and platform capabilities.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect and oversee the implementation of integration solutions leveraging Spring Boot, REST APIs, messaging, and event\-driven architectures.
* Establish integration design patterns (e.g., EAI, ESB, SOA, pub/sub, ETL) to ensure reusability, scalability, and maintainability.
* Lead technical discovery sessions with customers to gather integration requirements and define clear solution blueprints.
* Coordinate with internal solution architects, product managers, and customer success teams to ensure integration feasibility and alignment with business goals.
* Introduce, evaluate, and integrate AI\-powered development tools into the engineering process to improve efficiency, testing, and documentation.
* Promote a culture of AI\-first problem solving in architecture design, code reviews, and automation.
* Set up frameworks and automation to accelerate onboarding of new integrations.
* Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and cloud services (primarily AWS) to optimize integration performance.
* Review solution designs and code to ensure adherence to architectural principles and coding standards.
* Support pre\-sales with architecture diagrams, integration approaches, and technical feasibility assessments.
* Lead technical discussions with external partners, vendors, and enterprise customers.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 15\+ years of software development experience, with at least 3\+ years as an Architect.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Java (Java 8\+), Spring Boot, and microservices architecture.
* Solid understanding of integration patterns, enterprise architecture concepts, and middleware solutions.
* Experience with REST APIs, messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ), and data transformation (JSON, XML, CSV).
* Knowledge of AWS cloud services relevant to integration (API Gateway, Lambda, SQS/SNS, ECS, RDS, etc.).
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, branching/merging strategies, and code quality tools.
* Proficiency in Linux environments and shell scripting.
* Experience with building connectors/adapters for ERP, WMS, OMS, CRM, or eCommerce platforms is a plus.
* Exposure to products like TIBCO, Informatica, SnapLogic, WebMethods, or MuleSoft is advantageous.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, ability to think “out\-of\-the\-box”, and adapt to fast\-changing priorities.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence across teams.


**Bonus / Good to Have**
* Experience in AI\-assisted development, particularly using tools like Cursor AI, GitHub Copilot, Tabnine, or similar.
* Knowledge of prompt engineering and integrating AI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) into developer tooling or backend services.
* Understanding of ML Ops principles and how AI models can be integrated into enterprise applications.
* Track record of evangelizing AI adoption in engineering teams to improve productivity and innovation.


**Why Join Anchanto?**
* Build integrations for a global SaaS platform serving leading retailers, brands, and logistics companies.
* Lead impactful projects with cutting\-edge Java, Spring Boot, AWS, and AI\-assisted development tools.
* Collaborate with a high\-energy, globally distributed product and engineering team.
* Opportunity to innovate and define the future of Anchanto’s integration platform.


 Engage directly with enterprise customers to
 **design real\-world solutions** 
 that power global eCommerce.

3ee3f10b.title: Consultant, Info Security, App, Data, Cloud Security
3ee3f10b.description:
Job Purpose and Impact
   

  

* The Cloud Security Engineer will contribute to strengthening the security foundation for Cargill’s modern cloud\-based applications and platforms. In this role, you will apply cybersecurity and cloud security engineering expertise to secure, operate, and scale Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) and Platform as a Service (PaaS) environments across AWS and Azure.


 You will contribute to security design, adopt automation\-first approaches, and help ensure security is embedded by design into cloud platforms and engineering workflows. You will also leverage AI\-assisted engineering practices to improve cloud security operations, engineering productivity, and delivery efficiency.
   

  

 Key Accountabilities
   

  

* Design, implement, and maintain the security and resiliency of enterprise\-grade cloud services in support of Cargill’s mission.
* Implement and operate cloud security solutions across AWS and Azure.
* Develop and automate security policies, controls, and workflows using Infrastructure as Code, scripting, cloud\-native security services, and AI\-assisted engineering capabilities.
* Partner with Enterprise IT, Cloud platforms, DevSecOps, Software Engineering, and Compliance teams to embed security into cloud architectures, CI/CD pipelines, and migration workflows.
* Support cloud security incident investigations, remediation activities, and continuous security improvements.
* Contribute to cloud security engineering standards, reusable automation, documentation, and operational best practices.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve cloud security engineering and operations through automation and AI\-driven capabilities.


**Required Qualifications**
* 
+ Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.
+ 4–8 years of experience in cloud engineering and cloud security roles.
+ Strong hands\-on experience securing AWS and/or Azure cloud environments.
+ Experience with cloud security services and platforms, including Cloud IAM, Wiz, or equivalent CSPM tools.
+ Strong understanding of AWS networking and security constructs, including security groups, network firewalls, and segmentation.
+ Experience designing and securing container platforms (Kubernetes, EKS, ECS, Docker, etc.).
+ Strong skills in Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform and scripting languages such as Python, Golang, or PowerShell.
+ Good understanding of DevOps and CI/CD practices, application resiliency, and security\-by\-design principles.
+ Ability to analyze cloud security data, metrics, and logs to drive risk reduction and operational improvements.
+ Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering teams and contribute to technical solutions.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Cloud certifications in AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud (Associate, Professional, or Specialty).
* Cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, GSEC, CEH, or equivalent.
* Experience supporting cloud migrations or enterprise cloud platforms.
* Experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q, ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude, Cursor, etc.) to improve engineering productivity, automation, and software development.
* Good understanding of AI security concepts, including AI governance, AI workload security, prompt injection, data protection, and secure AI adoption in enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated ability to contribute technical solutions and collaborate across teams without direct authority.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* Cloud security controls are consistent, automated, and scalable across environments.
* Security risks are addressed early through design, automation, and AI\-assisted engineering practices rather than reactive fixes.
* Cloud security platforms (e.g., Wiz) provide clear, prioritized, and actionable insights.
* Engineering teams move faster with confidence due to strong security foundations and reusable automation.
* AI capabilities are effectively leveraged to improve cloud security engineering, operational efficiency, and security outcomes.

9d988901.title: Senior Google Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
9d988901.description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**
 Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward\-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
   

  

 At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose – always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping future of business.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a Senior GCP Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to design, implement, and operate enterprise\-grade infrastructure on Google Cloud. The role combines hands\-on engineering with solution ownership — building automation, enforcing governance and security standards, mentoring junior engineers, and contributing to landing zone and platform design with limited supervision.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Design, deploy, and manage GCP infrastructure at scale — Compute Engine / Managed Instance Groups, persistent disks/File store, Cloud Storage, VPCs, and Cloud Load Balancing — across multiple projects.
* Own Infrastructure\-as\-Code delivery using Terraform (preferred) or Deployment Manager/Config Connector, including reusable modules and CI/CD integration.
* Contribute to landing zone, project vending, and governance design using the GCP resource hierarchy, Organization Policies, and the Cloud Architecture Framework.
* Implement and manage IAM roles/policies, service accounts, Cloud Identity, Cloud KMS, Secret Manager, and VPC Service Controls.
* Design and operate networking — Shared VPC, VPC peering, Cloud VPN/Interconnect, Cloud Router, Cloud NAT, Cloud DNS, and Private Service Connect — within platform service limits.
* Build and maintain monitoring, logging, and observability using the Cloud Operations suite; drive reliability improvements.
* Lead operational activities — patching strategy, backup/DR, capacity planning, cost optimization (FinOps), and resource governance.
* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, connectivity, and security issues; perform root\-cause analysis.
* Manage GCP quotas and limits, raising increase requests and designing scalable, limit\-aware architectures.
* Mentor junior engineers, review IaaC and designs, and contribute to standards and runbooks.
* Collaborate with architecture, security, networking, and application teams on solution delivery.


**What You Must Have To Be Considered**
* 4–6 years of hands\-on GCP infrastructure experience with independent solution delivery.
* Strong command of GCP core services — Compute, Storage, VPC networking, IAM, Cloud KMS, and key managed services.
* Proven Infrastructure\-as\-Code experience (Terraform preferred) with module design and CI/CD integration.
* Solid scripting skills (Python, gcloud CLI; Bash a plus).
* Strong networking knowledge — TCP/IP, DNS, routing, BGP basics, hybrid connectivity (Cloud VPN/Interconnect), and segmentation.
* Working knowledge of GCP governance — resource hierarchy, Organization Policies, Cloud Asset Inventory, labels, and security baselines.
* Understanding of GCP quotas/limits and capacity/cost planning.
* Experience with monitoring, DR/backup, and operational best practices.


**These will help you succeed**
* Exposure to landing zone implementation, multi\-project governance, or security foundations blueprint.
* Familiarity with containers (GKE), and secondary exposure to Azure or AWS.
* Awareness of egress control / SASE tooling (e.g., Zscaler) and zero\-trust networking.
* Certifications: Google Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Cloud Network Engineer, or Associate Cloud Engineer.


**Work Model**
 We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 2\-3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Pune/Hyderabad/Kolkata/Bangalore/Coimbatore. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.
   

  

 The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
   

  

 We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

* This position is with an Infrastructure Management team.
